job.title: Research Engineer
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join our Data Analytics team, embedded directly with the Men’s First Team Analysis department, and play a key role in working with Analytics and Analysis colleagues to plan, implement, and deploy end-to-end internal products supporting the Men’s First Team.

In this exciting role, you'll be entrusted to work directly with a variety of colleagues across our club, such as Analysts and Coaching staff, on building data-driven applications and tooling for football analysis, driving the adoption of proprietary, state-of-the-art technology in coaching and analysis workflows, and identifying opportunities for furthering our applied research capabilities.

The role is accountable directly to the Head of Software & Analytics and Men’s First Team Head of Analysis to gather requirements from stakeholders at Sobha Realty Training Centre and collaborate with colleagues within the department to ensure appropriate prioritisation and delivery of relevant applications and tooling

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Design and develop full-stack applications - you will collaborate with colleagues to design, develop, and maintain full-stack data-driven applications tailored for use by our club stakeholders, ensuring solutions are efficient, reliable, and scalable

  • Streamline critical processes - you'll help automate and streamline select football analysis tasks and processes using a combination of full-stack software engineering and applied ML

  • Collaborate with our Football Analysis department - you will work closely with Football Analysts to deeply understand their processes and proactively plan and implement technical solutions to augment, refine and improve those processes

  • Act as an applied AI specialist - you'll be a subject matter expert in the application of AI techniques in football analysis, driving and contributing to projects that sit at the intersection of the two domains

  • Maximise the impact of our applied research - you will be integral in helping us to maximise the impact of our applied research work by ensuring it is (a) grounded in concrete coaching/analysis needs, and (b) accounts for real-world football analysis constraints

 

What we are looking for

  • Proven quantitative background - you hold an advanced qualification in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, data visualisation), or a related field with proven expertise in building technical, data-driven solutions

  • Solid foundation in software engineering and machine learning principles - you've got the ability to reason from first principles about research ideas and engineering trade-offs, and you have a willingness to build working full-stack applications

  • Eye for design - you have the ability to design and critique the presentation of data-driven insights and interfaces

  • Engineering mindset - you have a track record of designing and developing scalable data-driven applications

  • Experience with key programming languages - you're well-versed in using Python, SQL, and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • PyData tech stack fluency - you are comfortable with numpy, Pandas/Polars, matplotlib/seaborn/Altair, and similar tooling

  • Excellent communicator - you communicate confidently and effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and you're able to understand the requirements of stakeholders, with an ability to critically evaluate requests and project proposals

  • Adaptable and proactive approach - you can operate in a high-intensity environment and maintain some schedule flexibility, accommodating the need to collaborate with our Men's First Team staff on the training and matchday schedule when required

  • Highly independent and self-motivated individual - you're able to work independently and you thrive when you're in situations with ambiguity, where close collaboration with others is required to drive clarity

  • Experience with deep learning frameworks - you have worked with PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

  • Knowledge of our game - you've got a good knowledge of and passion for football and are motivated to help our club win on and off the pitch


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Thursday 6th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Event Operations Executive
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for an Event Operations Executive to play a key role in delivering world-class matchday and event experiences at Emirates Stadium.

Working across planning and live delivery, you'll support the operational delivery of our fixtures and major events while helping create memorable supporter experiences that bring our club's vision and brand to life.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Support matchday planning and delivery - you’ll work closely with our Event Operations Manager to coordinate the planning and execution of matchdays, ensuring seamless delivery through effective stakeholder management

  • Enhance the supporter experience - you will help deliver engaging matchday experiences at Emirates Stadium through activations, live entertainment, production support, and innovative fan engagement initiatives

  • Manage matchday programmes and staffing - you’ll oversee the casual matchday workforce, ball squad programme, mascot programme, and Gunnersaurus operations, ensuring exceptional experiences and smooth event delivery

  • Coordinate community and special events - you will work with internal teams to create bespoke community experiences and support the delivery of major events, including cup finals and related activations

  • Maintain stakeholder and governing body relationships - you’ll liaise with key football authorities, clubs, suppliers, and partners to ensure matchday activities meet operational and regulatory requirements

  • Oversee accreditation and compliance processes - you will manage supplier accreditation, risk assessments, and health & safety documentation to support safe and compliant event operations

  • Champion supporter engagement - you’ll act as an advocate for our supporters, using audience insights to shape experiences, communications, and matchday messaging

  • Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement - you will review supporter feedback, operational performance, and industry best practice to identify opportunities to enhance matchday operations and supporter experiences

 

What we are looking for

  • Experienced event operations professional - you bring proven experience supporting the planning and delivery of major events or projects, with a focus on operational excellence and stakeholder coordination

  • Commercially aware and brand focused - you have experience working within fast-paced, customer-centric environments, ideally within sport, entertainment, or other high-profile organisations where supporter experience is paramount

  • Confident stakeholder manager - you’re effectively building and maintaining positive relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, adapting your communication style to achieve successful outcomes

  • Knowledgeable in event delivery and compliance - you have a solid understanding of event operations, including planning processes, health & safety requirements, safeguarding responsibilities, and operational best practice

  • Analytical and solutions focused - you demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills, using initiative to respond quickly and effectively to operational challenges

  • Highly organised and adaptable - you thrive in fast-paced environments, successfully managing multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and high standards of delivery

  • Innovative and proactive in approach - you constantly seek opportunities to improve processes, enhance supporter experiences, and implement new ideas

  • Values driven team player - you act with integrity, professionalism, and respect, demonstrating a collaborative approach, commitment to teamwork, and passion for achieving collective success


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Sunday 9th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Partnerships Sales Manager
job.location: Arsenal Football Club, London, N5 1BU, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Partnerships Sales Manager to take responsibility for the generation of revenues through the acquisition of commercial partners. As well as taking an active role across the team to help nurture and develop a high-performing commercial sales function at our club.

In this exciting role, you'll understand the business strategy of potential partners, initiate contact at senior levels at these organisations, and you will work collaboratively with the Senior Manager to form compelling sales arguments based on our brand’s objectives to showcase ROI and efficiency of a partnership with us.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Shape partnership strategy - you'll work closely with the Senior Sales Manager to identify target categories and territories, maximise commercial opportunities, and contribute to the wider Partnerships strategy

  • Develop tailored proposals - you will create bespoke partnership packages by collaborating with teams across Marketing, Ticketing, Hospitality and other areas of our club

  • Drive new business growth - you'll secure revenue-generating partnership deals that align with our club's brand, values and strategic objectives

  • Manage and grow sales opportunities - you will proactively manage your sales pipeline, identify new prospects, and apply best practice to maximise sales performance

  • Build senior stakeholder relationships - you'll develop and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, using market and industry insight to create meaningful opportunities

  • Deliver compelling partnership presentations - you will present and showcase our club's offering and host prospective partners at matches to bring opportunities to life

  • Lead negotiations and close deals - you'll negotiate commercial terms and work with the Senior Sales Manager and Legal team to successfully conclude partnership agreements

  • Support long-term partnership success - you will ensure smooth handovers to Partner Services and play a key role in renewal discussions to maximise partner value and retention

 

What we are looking for

  • Track record in Sales Management - you come with experience in leading commercial proposals and negotiations, ideally in sports or sponsorship

  • Pipeline-focused approach - you take a methodical and proactive approach to developing, managing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline, ensuring opportunities are effectively progressed to deliver commercial results

  • Meticulous relationship management - you're diligent in following up leads and nurturing prospects, building trusted relationships through consistent engagement and attention to detail

  • Commitment to continuous development - you actively seek opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge, embracing feedback to enhance performance

  • Inclusive team player - you promote an environment where people feel respected, valued and included, championing diversity and fostering a culture of collaboration

  • Results-driven and reflective - you're able to objectively review performance against targets, applying lessons learned to continuously improve individual and team outcomes

  • Resilient and adaptable - you maintain focus on priorities under pressure, embrace new ways of working and view challenges as opportunities to learn and grow

  • Inspiring communicator - you communicate strategic priorities with clarity and enthusiasm, creating engagement and helping others understand their contribution to our club's success

  • High standards and accountability - you set exceptional standards for yourself and others, demonstrating ownership, professionalism and a proactive approach to achieving shared goals and commercial success


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Friday 7th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for an Academy Driver on a casual basis to provide travel support to our Academy players and staff.

We are committed to supporting the growth and development of our Academy players and staff by providing safe, reliable, and professional travel services. Our Academy plays a key role in nurturing talent and ensuring everyone can focus on their performance and duties.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Provide regular player transport - you'll carry out minibus journeys as required to ensure safe and prompt travel for our players

  • Support the wider Academy operation - you'll work alongside our Kit team to help with occasional transport of training/match kit and equipment

  • Handle ad-hoc travel - you will host minibus travel services for staff as and when required

  • Uphold our high standards - you will take responsibility for ensuring our Academy travel equipment is efficiently managed and looked after

  • Build positive working relationships - you'll engage and collaborate with players, parents/guardians and our wider team

  • Abide by critical policies - you will keep important policies related to Safeguarding, and Health and Safety always at the forefront of your mind

Please note: You'll be based at Sobha Realty Training Centre and this role will include evening and weekend work.

 

What we are looking for

  • Hold relevant qualifications - you must hold a valid UK driving licence with an acceptable driving record, a valid Driver CPC and a full UK PCV driving licence (Category D1 or Category D)

  • Experience in a similar role - you are confident with driving in Greater London and surrounding areas

  • Safeguarding champion - you have the completed the FA Safeguarding accreditation (or willing to undertake)

  • Trusted ambassador for our club - you recognise your responsibility as a representative of our club and maintain exceptional standards of professional behaviour towards colleagues, players and the wider public

  • Proud team player - you're able to display the integrity and discretion that's needed to be a trusted team player

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Arsenal for Everyone

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Monday 10th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

job.title: Matchday and Events Assistant (Casual Role)
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a number of Matchday and Events Assistants on a casual basis. Reporting into the Supporter Experience team, this role will support the execution of our Women’s and Men’s fixtures and key activations at Emirates Stadium, ensuring an outstanding matchday atmosphere and positive supporter experience.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Oversee matchday production preparation - you'll support the execution of the matchday in-bowl production, including assisting the delivery of the matchday show, as well as internal and external activations

  • Support with scheduling and matchday operations - you will work alongside various matchday teams to ensure successful delivery of all matchday operations

  • Strive for continuous improvement - you'll seek to add value where possible to improve the end-to-end supporter experience

  • Bring a fresh perspective  - you will help to shape key club moments which resonate with our global supporter base

  • Deliver  across key touchpoints - you'll assist the Supporter Experience team in delivering best in class touchpoints for supporters and other groups

  • Have a positive impact for stakeholders - you will communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders

  • Keep a safety conscious mindset - you'll understand internal protocols and processes, such as Health & Safety and Safeguarding processes in events

  • Provide exceptional customer service - you will provide excellent customer service to those attending matchdays and events

 
Please note:  This casual role will require working evenings and weekends, as per the requirements of matchdays at Emirates Stadium, and other venues as and when required.

 

What we are looking for

  • Track record in a similar hospitality and customer service role - you've previously thrived in a proactive hospitality and events role within a customer service focused environment

  • Background in major events - you have a history of planning and delivering major events which drive significant external impact within sport or entertainment

  • Best-in-class organisational skills - you have proven experience in managing a varied workload in a fast-paced operational environment

  • Passion for customer service - you take pride in providing excellent customer service and you thrive in a customer-centric environment

  • Flexible and adaptable approach - you are available to work across evenings, weekdays and weekends


Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Friday 14th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Football Development Coordinator - Teacher Development (FTC)
job.html_description:
The Role

We're looking for a Football Development Coordinator - Teacher Development to join our Community team and lead our teacher development programme through Premier League Primary Stars.

This role combines teacher development, school engagement and football delivery, giving you the opportunity to work closely with teachers, school leaders and young people across our local communities. Through mentoring, team teaching, professional learning and CPD opportunities, you'll help create lasting improvements in PE provision and positive outcomes for pupils.

As part of our wider Football Development team, you'll also contribute to community football programmes, coach development initiatives and impact reporting, helping us deliver meaningful opportunities both in schools and across the wider community.

This is a 24-month fixed-term contract

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead our teacher development programme - you'll deliver high-quality PE and football-based learning through Premier League Primary Stars that supports both pupils and teachers

  • Support teachers to grow their practice - you will plan and deliver structured learning journeys through mentoring, observation, co-delivery, feedback and reflection

  • Create learning resources - you'll develop and maintain teacher workbooks, digital resources and learning materials that support ongoing development

  • Build effective school partnerships - you will develop relationships with teachers, school leaders and education partners while creating opportunities to share best practice

  • Deliver professional learning opportunities - you'll facilitate CPD sessions and workshops that strengthen PE provision across partner schools

  • Contribute to football development programmes - you will support the delivery of competitions, festivals, holiday provision and community football activities

  • Support coach development - you'll mentor coaches, observe delivery and share feedback and resources that enhance coaching quality

  • Measure programme impact - you will maintain accurate records, support monitoring and evaluation processes, and help capture programme outcomes through reporting and case studies

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

What we are looking for

  • Experience delivering PE within primary school settings - you can draw upon a competent understanding of high-quality PE delivery and physical literacy principles

  • Experience supporting adult learners - you have mentored, coached or developed teachers and can help others improve their practice

  • Knowledge of the National Curriculum for PE - you're confident applying PE best practice within educational environments

  • Experience delivering workshops or CPD sessions - you're comfortable facilitating engaging learning experiences for groups of professionals

  • Football coaching experience - you bring experience from community football or player development environments and hold a UEFA C Coaching Qualification as a minimum

  • Effective relationship-building skills - you communicate effectively with teachers, school leaders, colleagues and external partners

  • Experience monitoring programme outcomes - you understand how to collect, evaluate and report on impact against programme objectives

  • Commitment to inclusion and safeguarding - you believe in creating positive, safe and welcoming environments for all participants

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Friday 7th August 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

job.title: Academy Player Care Manager (U18)
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We're looking for an Academy Player Care Manager (U18) to join our Academy Operations team and play an important role in supporting the wellbeing and development of our young players.

Working closely with players, parents, host families and multidisciplinary colleagues, you'll provide individual player care support for the Under 18 age group while helping to create a challenging and caring environment. You'll also take ownership of key programmes including the Lifelong Learner Programme and Host Family Programme, ensuring players receive the support they need throughout their Academy journey.

As part of our wider Player Care team, you'll contribute to the Academy's wellbeing strategy, build effective relationships across the Academy, and help young people develop both personally and professionally.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Support our young players and families - you'll build positive relationships with Under 18 players and their parents, providing tailored support and acting as a key point of contact when required

  • Deliver the Lifelong Learner Programme - you will manage and coordinate engaging life skills and personal development activities that are age-appropriate, relevant and aligned to Premier League requirements

  • Lead the Host Family Programme - you'll support host family recruitment, coordinate player placements for all hosted players, including those in the Full Time Training programme, oversee monthly processes and maintain regular contact with host families

  • Contribute to player wellbeing - you will support the Academy Mental Health & Wellbeing Strategy, including player wellbeing screening and transition support initiatives

  • Maintain accurate player care records - you'll ensure information relating to Under 18 player care is organised, up to date and managed with discretion

  • Connect players with the right support - you will work closely with families, colleagues and relevant departments to help resolve issues and support each player's development

  • Collaborate across the Academy - you'll contribute to multidisciplinary meetings, share insights and work alongside colleagues to support player progress

  • Assist Academy events and programmes - you will support with tours, tournaments and wider player care initiatives across the Academy when required

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

What we are looking for

  • Experience supporting children, young people and families - you can draw upon previous experience, ideally in a similar player care role, providing guidance, support and welfare-focused care

  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment - you're comfortable managing a varied workload and responding to changing priorities

  • Outstanding stakeholder management skills - you build positive relationships and communicate effectively with a range of internal and external contacts

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams - you're confident collaborating with different specialists to achieve shared objectives

  • Excellent organisational skills - you can coordinate programmes, manage records and balance multiple responsibilities effectively

  • Knowledge of safeguarding practices - you understand the importance of safeguarding legislation, policies and processes when working with young people

  • Confident IT skills - you're confident using Microsoft Office 365 and maintaining accurate administrative records

  • A caring, approachable and trustworthy approach - you build trust quickly, handle sensitive matters discreetly and contribute positively to team culture

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

job.plain_text_description:
The Role
We're looking for an Academy Player Care Manager (U18) to join our Academy Operations team and play an important role in supporting the wellbeing and development of our young players.
Working closely with players, parents, host families and multidisciplinary colleagues, you'll provide individual player care support for the Under 18 age group while helping to create a challenging and caring environment. You'll also take ownership of key programmes including the Lifelong Learner Programme and Host Family Programme, ensuring players receive the support they need throughout their Academy journey.
As part of our wider Player Care team, you'll contribute to the Academy's wellbeing strategy, build effective relationships across the Academy, and help young people develop both personally and professionally.
Who we are
We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.
Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).
Our Commitment to Safeguarding
We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.
Your day-to-day
- Support our young players and families - you'll build positive relationships with Under 18 players and their parents, providing tailored support and acting as a key point of contact when required - Deliver the Lifelong Learner Programme - you will manage and coordinate engaging life skills and personal development activities that are age-appropriate, relevant and aligned to Premier League requirements - Lead the Host Family Programme - you'll support host family recruitment, coordinate player placements for all hosted players, including those in the Full Time Training programme, oversee monthly processes and maintain regular contact with host families - Contribute to player wellbeing - you will support the Academy Mental Health & Wellbeing Strategy, including player wellbeing screening and transition support initiatives - Maintain accurate player care records - you'll ensure information relating to Under 18 player care is organised, up to date and managed with discretion - Connect players with the right support - you will work closely with families, colleagues and relevant departments to help resolve issues and support each player's development - Collaborate across the Academy - you'll contribute to multidisciplinary meetings, share insights and work alongside colleagues to support player progress - Assist Academy events and programmes - you will support with tours, tournaments and wider player care initiatives across the Academy when required
Position of Trust- As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education
What we are looking for
- Experience supporting children, young people and families - you can draw upon previous experience, ideally in a similar player care role, providing guidance, support and welfare-focused care - Experience working in a fast-paced environment - you're comfortable managing a varied workload and responding to changing priorities - Outstanding stakeholder management skills - you build positive relationships and communicate effectively with a range of internal and external contacts - Experience working within multidisciplinary teams - you're confident collaborating with different specialists to achieve shared objectives - Excellent organisational skills - you can coordinate programmes, manage records and balance multiple responsibilities effectively - Knowledge of safeguarding practices - you understand the importance of safeguarding legislation, policies and processes when working with young people - Confident IT skills - you're confident using Microsoft Office 365 and maintaining accurate administrative records - A caring, approachable and trustworthy approach - you build trust quickly, handle sensitive matters discreetly and contribute positively to team culture
Why choose us
At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:
- An exciting reward and recognition scheme - Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service - Great internal learning and development programmes - A flexible hybrid working model - Priority access to apply for match tickets - A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package - A leading Employee Assistance Programme - Great discounts with some of our Partners - An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks
Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team -view their stories here.
Arsenal for Everyone
Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

job.title: Casual Grassroots Scouts (U12-U16) - London & Kent
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a number of Casual Grassroots Scouts to join us on a casual basis and operate in North, West, East or South London/Kent, to identify players for our Academy with potential to develop in the Youth Development Phase (12-16).

You'll diligently attend football matches and record the necessary information on potential players in our Academy's online club database and you'll passionately attend weekly meetings lead by Phase Coordinators to feedback your insight and findings.

We're looking for Grassroots Scouts in multiple regions, please indicate which region you'd like to be considered for in your application below.


 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.


Your day-to-day

  • Operate as a key member of our Academy talent ID network - you'll proactively identify and report on the most talented young players with the potential to join our Academy

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of our players - you will passionately report on players monitored on our database and build and cultivate your knowledge of players in the selected phase at our club and beyond

  • Act as a proud ambassador for our club - you'll take pride in protecting our image and upholding our reputation in the public domain and work within the PL/EFL Youth Development rules

  • Attend relevant events - you will attend CPD events relevant to Talent ID held at our Academy

  • Stay available to attend matches - you'll ensure you're flexible and available to attend grassroots matches selected by our Phase Coordinator

  • Abide by critical policies - you will keep important policies related to Safeguarding, Equality and Health and Safety front of mind at all times

What we are looking for

  • Credible expertise - you hold an FA Talent ID Level 2 and an FA Safeguarding Certificate

  • Empathetic and supportive approach - you're naturally sensitive to the needs of young players, parents/guardians and grassroots clubs

  • Competent IT skills - you're confident writing detailed reports and keeping databases up to date

  • Valid driving licence - you can get yourself to fixtures, events and meetings with ease

  • Collaborative team player - you're a personable and enthusiastic individual with a competitive work ethic and you work efficiently as part of a team

  • Flexible mindset - you have a willingness to work weekends, along with some evenings in the week

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

job.title: Community Draw Seller (Casual)
job.html_description:
As a Community Draw ticket seller, you will play a vital role in raising funds for the Cherries Community Fund by selling Community Draw tickets at each home matchday. The Cherries Community Fund is dedicated to providing financial assistance to projects that support young people and vulnerable groups in Bournemouth, Dorset, and Hampshire. 
  • Engage with fans at the stadium prior to kick-off. 
  • Promote awareness of the AFC Bournemouth Community Draw. 
  • Proactively sell Community Draw tickets in designated areas, including outside the stadium and in corporate suites. 
  • Handle payment transactions using card machines. 
  • Collaborate with the Community Matchday Draw Supervisor for any queries or assistance.  
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Highly motivated and energetic seller.
  • Ability to positively interact with AFC Bournemouth supporters and fans of the visiting team. 
  • Availability to work weekday evenings, weekends, and Bank Holidays. 
  • Each home matchday 
  • 1.5 hours up to kick-off

job.title: Commercial Graphic Designer
job.html_description:
The Commercial Graphic Designer is responsible for delivering creative solutions that support AFC Bournemouth's commercial objectives and drive revenue. Working closely with the Commercial Director and wider Commercial team, the role holder will create high-quality visual content across sponsorship proposals, pitch presentations, Digideck, commercial marketing materials, partner activations, stadium branding and matchday assets. 

The role requires someone with strong commercial design experience who can manage multiple projects independently, collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners, and produce creative work that enhances the club's commercial offering. 

Based at Vitality Stadium, this role reports directly to the Commercial Director and offers the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, live-event environment at the heart of a Premier League football club. 
  • Design sponsorship proposals, pitch decks and Digideck presentations.  
  • Produce creative assets for commercial campaigns, partner activations and marketing.  
  • Create mockups, visualisations and branding concepts for prospective and existing partners.  
  • Design stadium branding, signage, print collateral and matchday assets.  
  • Prepare artwork for print and digital production.  
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring work is delivered to a high standard and within deadlines.  
  • Maintain brand consistency across all commercial creative output. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Degree-level qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communications or a related discipline (preferred).  
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud skills, with experience producing high-quality commercial design work.  
  • Strong presentation design capabilities, including experience creating proposals, pitch decks and Digideck presentations.  
  • Understanding of print production and artwork preparation for both digital and physical assets.  
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.  
  • Excellent organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills.  
  • An understanding of sponsorship, partnerships and commercial marketing within sport or a similar industry is beneficial.  
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal departments and external partners.  
  • A proactive, creative mindset with a strong focus on delivering innovative and commercially effective design solutions. 
  • Commercial graphic design experience (sport, agency or in-house).  
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design and commercial projects.  
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud skills.  
  • Experience creating presentations in PowerPoint or Digideck.  
  • Strong understanding of print production and artwork.  
  • Excellent organisation, communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Commercial design experience.  
  • Strong presentation design.  
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.  
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.  
  • Strong Adobe Creative Suite skills. 

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To transport Academy players to and from all Academy activity, around Bournemouth and nationally.

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care. 
  • Togetherness: working in a prosocial manner as part of a wider team – willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions in a manner which allows learning, growth and reflection. 

  • Transport Academy Players from various pick-up points in the Bournemouth area to and from AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre. Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation.  
  • Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. 
  • To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. 
  • Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers.  
  • Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. 
  • Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport.  
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.

  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Valid UK Driving Licence, including D1 
  • Experience in driving 17-seater minibuses

job.title: First Team Scout - Italy
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
Location: Must reside in Italy and show proficiency in both English and Italian.

To provide scouting coverage of designated regions and leagues through live and video observation, in order to provide AFC Bournemouth with potential future targets for recruitment. 
  • Be proactive and resourceful in identifying and assessing high potential players and relevant targets within your designated region 
  • Provide efficient and in-depth assessments of all players assigned to you by the Head of Recruitment Operations or Head of Scouting 
  • Be proactive in highlighting and attending high value live fixtures within your region 
  • Undertake research and provide market insights on players of interest that can contribute to final dossiers in the latter stages of the recruitment process 
  • Compile video clips to highlight the Strengths, Areas for Development and Considerations for any player on a Shortlist recommendation and above from within your allocated region 
  • Maintain and develop a network of contacts that can support the identification and recruitment of targeted players 
  • Engage with and maintain strong relationships with player agents to make sure all relevant transfer information is up to date 
  • Support the observation of international tournaments and fixtures as assigned by the Head of Recruitment Operations or Head of Scouting 
  • Ensure that relevant targets are identified and elevated efficiently, and up-to-date positional shortlists are maintained 
  • Develop strong relationships with counterparts in regions outside of your own to allow efficient information sharing across the department 
  • Play a supporting role in identifying high potential players and market opportunities for clubs in the Black Knight group 
  • Support the cross referencing of players of interest across regions outside of your own 
  • Contribute positively within individual and group recruitment meetings 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
Essential 
  • Must reside in Italy and show proficiency in both English and Italian 
  • Have held a Scouting & Recruitment role at an elite club, within the defined region 
  • Be an expert across all relevant levels of football within your allocated region and expertise in identifying talent 
  • Have access to a strong network of key agents and club contacts within your designated region
  • Demonstrate excellent knowledge of internal players and the level of the Premier League 
  • Be computer literate and have a level of proficiency in the use of appropriate platforms and video software such as Wyscout, Scoutastic, Hudl and Sportscode 
  • Show an understanding of the transfer market and associated regulations 
  • Proficient in English and the native language of your designated region
Desired 
  • Completed the FA Talent ID Level 3 or Above 
Person Specification
  • Demonstrate a drive and an enthusiasm to uncover footballing talents in your designated region before our competitors 
  • Have high level report writing skills and the ability to clearly convey opinions and provide detailed assessments on players
  • Show an upbeat and positive outlook to tasks and a willingness to go the extra mile
  • Be a confident and effective communicator across all levels 
  • Be comfortable independently managing busy schedules and workloads 
  • Remain adaptable to work within a rapidly changing environment 
  • Represent AFC Bournemouth in a positive and professional light in all settings

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

The stadium is very busy on a match day but there is a good atmosphere within the team and you get to know the supporters.

Experience is a bonus, but not essential as full training given onsite.
  • Duties include using tills, recording information, replenishing stock, ensuring your work area is clean and tidy.
  •  You will also be expected to handle food this can include an element of cooking.
  •  You will be expected to work as part of a team as there are 22 concourse bars and kiosk around the stadium.
  • Customer care is very important to us, so you will be expected to be polite and helpful to all individual customers..
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.

  • Waiting Staff
  • Food Runners
  • Glass Collectors
  • Matchday Restaurant Supervisors (previous experience in a similar role essential)
  • Matchday Bar Supervisors (previous experience in a similar role essential)

Previous experience within a quality, fast-paced catering environment is preferable as staff members are required to display initiative and calmness under pressure. A strong work ethic and a can-do attitude are also prerequisites.

  • Be self-motivated with a proven track record of working well within a team environment.

job.title: Superstore Assistant (Casual)
job.html_description:
AFC Bournemouth is a family and community club. We strive to deliver a professional, friendly and welcoming approach in all areas of the club. We pride ourselves on hard work, passion and togetherness. 

The retail team have an exciting opportunity for multiple roles to be filled within its retail and superstore team on matchday.  You will help our customer’s/supporters find the right products to enhance their enjoyment of supporting AFC Bournemouth through the provision of exceptional customer service.

  • To personally provide excellent standards of customer service by: 
  • Displaying good listening skills to identify customer needs and meeting those needs with the right product advice. 
  • Provide relevant and comprehensive key product information to customers. 
  • Demonstrating appropriate body language - friendly, open, helpful and approachable. 
  • Confidently engaging with customers and closing sales. 
  • Looking for link selling and till add on opportunities which will increase spend per head. 
  • Understanding the importance of product presentation and general store/ retail area standards.  
  • Confident in solving customer problems quickly and effectively. 
  • Maintaining good working relationships with ‘internal stakeholders’ such as; Commercial team, Ticketing team, Accounts team, Operations Director, Chief Executive and Chairman. 
  • Providing our customers with the right products and experience so that every customer leaves inspired to enjoy supporting AFC Bournemouth. 
  • Replenish stock and maintain high standards of merchandising by ensuring that products are attractively displayed, correctly barcoded and priced with relevant Point of Sale (POS) applied. 
  • Conduct till point operations in line with guidelines. 
  • Conduct shirt printing where applicable (following training). 
  • Understanding and operation of the Touch Office EPOS system. 
  • Conduct Stock Checks as requested. 
  • Maintain vigilance in store and awareness of security issues including for example, fraudulent bank notes, credit cards, theft and suspicious behaviour; escalate security concerns to management as and when required.  
  • Demonstrating commitment to the team, supporting and helping other colleagues with tasks. 
  • Displaying a genuine and positive attitude to help team and Superstore achieve its objectives. 
  • Getting behind Retail initiatives. 
  • Carrying out additional duties as when required. 
  • Commitment to undertaking identified training requirements and putting into place learnings. 
  • Ability and willingness to acquire job related skills and knowledge through self-development and by learning from others. 
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Enjoy helping others 
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced and busy environment  
  • Experience in customer service or sales 
  • Experience in retail (not essential) 
  • Good verbal and written communication 
  • Punctual and effective time keeping
