job.title: Director of Security
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.
 
As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.
 
Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.
 
Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 
 
At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.
 
If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
 
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Chicago Fire FC is seeking an experienced, strategic, and forward-thinking Director of Security to lead a unique opportunity: building and scaling the Club’s safety and security function during a transformational period of growth.
 
Reporting to the McDonald’s Park General Manager, this leader will be responsible for developing and overseeing integrated safety, security, emergency preparedness, and risk management operations across Chicago Fire FC. The role will safeguard the well-being of staff, coaches, players, guests, and key stakeholders across all Club facilities and events, including the Endeavor Health Performance Center, Soldier Field, Fire Pitch, the Wrigley Building office space, and the Club’s future downtown stadium, McDonald’s Park. This individual will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing innovative, scalable security solutions for McDonald’s Park, a state-of-the-art professional soccer and major events venue, while also supporting day-to-day operations across the Club’s broader footprint.
 
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of safety and security for one of Major League Soccer’s most ambitious organizations. The successful candidate will build and lead a best-in-class function, ultimately serving as the long-term safety and security leader for both Chicago Fire FC and McDonald’s Park.
 
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
 
General & McDonald’s Park
Provide strategic leadership for security operations for Chicago Fire FC, including players, coaches, team personnel, and Club facilities such as the Endeavor Health Performance Center, Soldier Field, Fire Pitch, Wrigley Building office space, club warehouse, and McDonald’s Park
  • Build and lead the Club’s security department, including hiring, training, scheduling, and deployment of personnel to ensure comprehensive security coverage and operational readiness leading up to the opening of McDonald’s Park
  • Develop and implement comprehensive safety and security strategies, policies, and standard operating procedures across all Chicago Fire FC locations, facilities, and events.
  • Evaluate, maintain, and regularly drill emergency action plans (EAPs), incident response protocols, crisis management procedures, for a wide range of scenarios including medical emergencies, active threat, severe weather, fire, etc., for all Chicago Fire FC locations 
  • Partner with stadium development, architects, consultants, and project teams to shape security and life safety design elements for McDonald’s Park.
  • Provide operational input into CCTV, access control, credentials, perimeter security, command center design, ingress and egress planning, and emergency management infrastructure for McDonald’s Park.
  • Support safety and security readiness planning for McDonald’s Park commissioning, testing, and opening, including coordination of stakeholders, procedures, and operational response capabilities.
  • Create short- and long-term security roadmaps aligned with Club growth, league requirements, and best-in-class security standards
  • Serve as the Club’s subject-matter expert on safety, security, emergency preparedness, and incident response
  • Develop and maintain strong and effective relationships with local law enforcement, local emergency service organizations, Soldier Field, security vendors, and league partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Football Operations, IT, People & Culture, Legal, the property team, and tenants to deliver security training and foster a culture of awareness, preparedness, and accountability
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, MLS policies and security requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Accurately document, investigate, and record all safety and security incidents and conduct post-incident analysis to strengthen protocols and continuous improvement efforts
  • Serve as the lead planner and security responder for events across locations, such as the Endeavor Health Performance Center and Soldier Field, including security coordination, law enforcement support, medical needs, staffing plans, and incident command readiness.
  • Develop, manage, and monitor the department budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and fiscal accountability.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and maintain accurate records of incidents, investigations, and corrective actions 
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all law enforcement and security relationships 
  • Help build a culture of safety awareness throughout the Club and at each location
  • Ensure all Fire facilities meet applicable local, state, and federal safety codes as well as MLS facility standards 
  • Complete other duties as assigned in the best interest of Chicago Fire FC
 
Sporting Operations 
  • Establish and maintain stadium and facility safety and security policies and procedures, including access control plans and systems, CCTV and related surveillance technologies, life safety protocols, emergency action plans, drills, emergency messaging systems, and event action plans.
  •  Evaluate, implement, and maintain all physical security protocols for the training facility, including credentialing systems, access control, perimeter control, and surveillance infrastructure for all staff, players, vendors, and media.
  • Create and implement effective crowd management and crowd control measures to ensure the safety of all attendees, guests, staff, and participants.
  • Oversee access control systems to ensure appropriate personnel receive the correct access while maintaining the integrity of secure and restricted areas
  • Lead all aspects of travel safety and security planning and risk mitigation, including travel with the team as needed, to support the well-being of players, coaches, and team personnel
  • Develop protocols for player privacy, anti-paparazzi measures, and public-facing interactions at the facility and during travel 
  • Manage security logistics for high-profile arrivals, departures, and visits
  • Manage relationships with and oversee integration with third-party security vendors at the facility. 
  • Advise on personal security matters for players and staff as needed 
  • Conduct regular risk assessments and facility safety audits and address any identified gaps

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience overseeing security operations.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience managing internal and external security teams.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey information effectively to a variety of stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to make quick, informed decisions, assess situations accurately, and act promptly with speed and efficiency.
  • Proven ability to lead in a team environment with a focus on collaboration, communication, and achieving departmental goals.
  • Experience exercising sound judgment, discretion in managing sensitive or confidential interactions and matters, and flexibility in shifting priorities.
  • Ability to conduct oneself in a calm and professional manner and de-escalate conflict when dealing with the public and/or difficult situations.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to think strategically and be resourceful, innovative, and forward-thinking.
  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and patrol facilities for extended periods of time
  • Ability to travel and work weekends and flexible hours as required.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours in non-traditional settings, including all home games, traveling for away games (as needed), or other work events that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays.
 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Facilities Management, Police Academy, or a related field 
  • Law enforcement, military, public safety, venue security, and/or corporate security leadership experience 
  • Experience in major league sports, entertainment, public assembly, or venue environment, including stadium or large-scale event operations, strongly preferred
  • Technical knowledge of CCTV and access control systems
  • Conversational Spanish language fluency
  • CPR/First Aid certification
 
COMPENSATION:
  • This role offers a salary range of $150,000.00 - $200,000.00
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on Club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers
 
PLEASE NOTE:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.  
    • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.    
MLS Privacy Policy: 
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Maintenance Associate, Chicago Fire Pitch
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a Maintenance Associate for Chicago Fire Pitch, the Club’s premier indoor/outdoor community soccer facility. Located on the north side of Chicago, Fire Pitch welcomes 300,000+ visitors each year, providing year-round playing opportunities for youth and adult players of all skill levels.

We aim to provide the best possible experience for our guests, and we are excited to welcome a Maintenance Associate to our team. With oversight and support from the Facility Manager, the focus for this position will be placed on delivering a safe, clean, friendly, soccer-first atmosphere on a daily basis.

 
Job Responsibilities:
The Maintenance Associate will work with the Facility Manager to execute the facility’s maintenance and operations plan. Specific duties include, but are not limited to:
  •  Oversee trash removal around the facility, maintaining a litter-free environment on the playing fields, in the parking lots, and all public-facing areas.
  •  Supplement work of vendors to ensure all aspects of the facility meet our high standard for cleanliness and safety.
  •  Perform general equipment maintenance, ensuring equipment is kept in good working order, reporting all significant mechanical issues to the Operations Manager.
  • Refill supplies throughout the facility as needed, including the restrooms, locker rooms, front desk, and office areas. Coordinate re-order needs with Facility Manager.
  •  Ensure closets, shed, off-site storage, and dumpster enclosure are kept clean and organized.
  • Assist snow removal process around seasonal dome, supporting Operations Manager and external snow removal team to ensure snow removal standards are met.
  • Perform all aspects of field maintenance, inclusive of grooming, line painting, and turf repairs.
  •  Participate in semi-annual dome conversion process, transitioning facility from outdoor-to-indoor in November, and from indoor-to-outdoor in April.
  •  Support all event operations efforts, including assistance with set-up, tear-down, and clean-up.
  •  Fulfill weekly Manager on Duty responsibilities, ensuring the facility runs in a smooth, professional, and safe manner during programming hours. MOD responsibilities require an ability to engage and interact with visitors throughout the facility.
  • Serve as Club ambassador, delivering passion for soccer and the Chicago Fire Football Club on a daily basis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years’ experience conducting maintenance and operation-oriented tasks preferred, previous experience working as a janitor/handyman a plus.
  •  Basic mechanical knowledge and enthusiasm for learning new skills.
  • Strong attention to detail is a must.
  •  Proactive self-starter, with a demonstrated history of problem solving.
  • No job is too big or too small – unafraid to get hands dirty, able to wear multiple hats, and at times work outside the job description.
  • Comfortable using power tools and machinery.
  •  Good communication skills and ability to quickly build relationships.
  •  Proven ability to interact and work within a team setting.
  • Well-organized with an ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Punctuality, reliability, and flexibility are important in this fast-paced work environment.
  •  Comfortable in customer-facing situations, providing friendly customer service to both children and adults.
  • Desire to create an inclusive and cooperative work environment.
  • Passion for the Chicago Fire Football Club, MLS, and soccer as a whole.

Requirements
  • Must be able to work flexible hours - nights, weekends, and holidays are required.
  • This job consists of manual labor. Must have physical ability to lift 50 pounds and spend long hours on feet. Frequent bending, sitting, standing, exposure to elements (cold/heat), climbing ladders, walking, and carrying items.
  • Must have driver’s license. Access to vehicle strongly preferred.
  •  Forklift Certification or willingness to gain certification within specified time.

Compensation:
  • This role offers an hourly rate range of $20/hour 
  •  This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on individual and club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers

Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Director, Partnership Strategy
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire FC is seeking an innovative, strategic, and data-driven Director of Corporate Partnership Strategy to lead the Club's partnership strategy function and help shape the future of commercial partnerships as we prepare for the opening of McDonald's Park.

Reporting to the Vice President of Partnership Marketing & Strategy, this leadership role will oversee the development of integrated partnership strategies that drive new business revenue, support partner renewals and upsells, and position Chicago Fire FC as an industry leader in sports partnerships.

The Director will lead a team of two while collaborating across the organization to develop compelling partnership narratives, create innovative partnership assets, build best-in-class sales materials, and leverage research and analytics to tell impactful commercial stories. This role will play a critical part in the commercialization of McDonald's Park by helping define new inventory, developing scalable partnership platforms, and creating innovative opportunities that maximize long-term revenue growth.

Job Responsibilities: 
Partnership Strategy & Commercial Development
  • Lead the Club's partnership strategy function, developing innovative sponsorship solutions that drive new business, renewals, and long-term revenue growth.
  • Drive the commercialization of McDonald's Park by developing new partnership assets, entitlement opportunities, and scalable sponsorship platforms.
  • Oversee the creation of compelling sales presentations, partnership proposals, and strategic storytelling that effectively communicate the value of Chicago Fire FC partnerships.
  • Partner with senior leadership to identify, package, and position premium partnership opportunities that maximize commercial value.

Asset Strategy & Insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to create innovative, sellable partnership assets while balancing fan experience and business objectives.
  • Leverage market research, fan insights, and partnership analytics to inform partnership strategy and strengthen sales efforts.
  • Oversee partnership inventory management, valuation recommendations, rate cards, and performance reporting to support revenue growth.

Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Partnership Strategy team while establishing processes and best practices that drive collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Corporate Partnerships leadership team, helping shape the Club's long-term commercial vision.

Required Qualifications:  
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Sports Management, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in corporate partnerships, sponsorship strategy, sports marketing, or a related commercial role.
  •  3+ years of leadership experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
  • Proven experience developing partnership strategies, sponsorship packages, and sales presentations that drive revenue.
  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate research, data, and business objectives into compelling partnership solutions.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  •  Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and work non-traditional hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:  
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and design tools for mockups and presentations (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva).
  • Experience working with data analysis platforms (e.g., Kore, Salesforce, YouGov, Blinkfire)
  • Understanding of the sports, entertainment, or event sponsorship industry

Compensation: 
  • This role offers a base salary of $100,000
  • This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  •  This role is bonus eligible based on club wide goals · Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire FC is seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and highly organized Creative Presentation Designer to support the Club's Corporate Partnerships team. This role will be responsible for developing compelling visual materials that bring partnership ideas to life and help drive new business, renewals, and upsell opportunities. The Creative Presentation Designer will create best-in-class sales presentations, sponsorship proposals, mockups, renderings, and branded marketing materials that effectively communicate the value of Chicago Fire FC partnerships. This role will play an important part in the commercialization of McDonald's Park, helping visualize new partnership opportunities and enhance the Club's storytelling.

Job Responsibilities: 
  •  Design high-quality sales presentations, partnership proposals, one-sheets, and marketing materials that support new business, renewals, and upsell opportunities.
  • Create compelling sponsorship mockups, renderings, signage concepts, and branded assets that help partners visualize opportunities.
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling that elevate Chicago Fire FC's partnership presentations and commercial brand.
  • Translate partnership ideas into polished, client-facing materials under tight deadlines.
  • Maintain design consistency across all partnership materials while adhering to Chicago Fire FC brand standards.
  • Collaborate closely with the Partnership Strategy, Partnership Marketing, Partnership Sales, Marketing, and Creative teams to bring partnership ideas to life.
  • Support the commercialization of McDonald's Park by designing creative materials that showcase new sponsorship inventory and partnership opportunities.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and meeting project deadlines.
  • Develop templates, graphics, and creative resources that improve efficiency and consistency across the Corporate Partnerships department.
  • Translate research, fan insights, sponsorship analytics, and valuation data into visually compelling graphics, infographics, and presentations that strengthen partnership storytelling.
  • Stay current on design trends, emerging technologies, and creative best practices to continually enhance the Club's partnership materials.

Required Qualifications:  
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of graphic design experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, marketing, or agency environments.
  •  Exceptional proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) and Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • Experience designing client-facing presentations and marketing materials.
  •  Strong understanding of layout, typography, branding, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.
  •  Excellent communication, organization, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:  
  • Experience creating sponsorship mockups, venue renderings, environmental graphics, or branded experiential concepts.
  • Experience with presentation and visualization tools.
  •  Knowledge of sports sponsorship, live events, or the sports and entertainment industry.
  • Motion graphics or video editing experience is a plus

Compensation: 
  •  This role offers a base salary of $65,000
  • This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club wide goals 
  • Additional benefits and perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers.

- Design high-quality sales presentations, partnership proposals, one-sheets, and marketing materials that support new business, renewals, and upsell opportunities. - Create compelling sponsorship mockups, renderings, signage concepts, and branded assets that help partners visualize opportunities. - Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling that elevate Chicago Fire FC's partnership presentations and commercial brand. - Translate partnership ideas into polished, client-facing materials under tight deadlines. - Maintain design consistency across all partnership materials while adhering to Chicago Fire FC brand standards. - Collaborate closely with the Partnership Strategy, Partnership Marketing, Partnership Sales, Marketing, and Creative teams to bring partnership ideas to life. - Support the commercialization of McDonald's Park by designing creative materials that showcase new sponsorship inventory and partnership opportunities. - Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and meeting project deadlines. - Develop templates, graphics, and creative resources that improve efficiency and consistency across the Corporate Partnerships department. - Translate research, fan insights, sponsorship analytics, and valuation data into visually compelling graphics, infographics, and presentations that strengthen partnership storytelling. - Stay current on design trends, emerging technologies, and creative best practices to continually enhance the Club's partnership materials.
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. - 2+ years of graphic design experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, marketing, or agency environments. - Exceptional proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) and Microsoft PowerPoint. - Experience designing client-facing presentations and marketing materials. - Strong understanding of layout, typography, branding, and visual storytelling. - Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines. - Excellent communication, organization, and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications:

job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club seeks a Coordinator, League Operations, to join our team. Reporting to the Director of League Operations, this individual will play a key role in delivering a best-in-class experience for players, coaches and club partners while ensuring the successful execution of league operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized and customer focused. By providing exceptional service, supporting day-to-day league administration, and building strong relationships with participants and stakeholders, this role will help drive the continued growth, quality, and operational excellence of Chicagoland Indoor Soccer League. 

Job Responsibilities:  
  • Support league operations, including scheduling, registration, communication, and game-day management on site during the weekends (December-March). 
  • Organize registration and administrative requirements to ensure a seamless participant experience for league of over 1000 teams and 14,000 participants.
  • Collaborate with director of league operations to ensure league and tournaments are appropriately staffed and operationally supported.  
  • Ensure all programs operate within club risk management standards while maintaining strong relationships with clubs, league partners, and external organizations.
  • Manage new and existing partnerships with key youth and community soccer stakeholders. 
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications: 
  • 2+ years of relevant youth soccer work experience. 
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. 
  • Superior organizational skills.  
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including weekends from late November through mid-March.

Preferred Qualifications:  
  • Bachelor’s degree in sports, recreation or similar field of study. 
  • Knowledge of the U.S. youth soccer landscape, particularly in Chicagoland.
  • Knowledge of youth sports registration software (LeagueApps). 

Compensation: 
  • This role offers an hourly range rate of $20.00- $22.00.
  • This role is classified as Part-time, non-exempt.
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience.

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Ticket Operations Manager (SeatGeek)
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of ticket operations at Chicago Fire FC. As the club transitions to SeatGeek Unify and prepares to open McDonald's Park in Summer 2028, the Ticket Operations Manager will serve as the Senior Director of Ticket Operations' right hand in executing one of the most significant ticketing transformations in professional sports. This role will serve as the club's primary SeatGeek Unify specialist, leading event builds, inventory management, reporting, ticketing integrations, and system optimization while supporting Ticketmaster Archtics during the club's remaining events at Soldier Field and SeatGeek Stadium. Along the way, you'll gain broad experience across the industry's two leading ticketing platforms, helping build a well-rounded ticket operations skill set that will serve you throughout your career.

Working cross-functionally with Ticket Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance, Stadium Operations, and Box Office teams, this individual will help deliver a seamless ticketing experience for fans while developing scalable operational processes that support the club's next era. The role will also oversee matchday ticket operations, including the management of box office staff and temporary event personnel, ensuring exceptional execution and customer service across every event.

Job Responsibilities: 
  • Partner with the Senior Director of Ticket Operations and Revenue teams to support the phased sales campaign for McDonald's Park, optimizing inventory strategy, pricing configurations, and system readiness to deliver a best-in-class purchasing experience for fans and maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Build and develop a strong working relationship with SeatGeek Client Support Staff as Chicago Fire FC makes the transition to SeatGeek Unify at McDonald’s Park.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Ticketmaster Client Support staff regarding software management, troubleshooting system issues, event creation, event marketing and financial reporting as Chicago Fire FC continues to play at Soldier Field and SeatGeek Stadium.
  • Build and maintain a positive working relationship with all promoters for special events at McDonald’s Park.
  • Develop, automate and maintain operational, financial and business intelligence reports that support Ticket Sales, Service, Finance, Stadium Operations and MLS reporting requirements.Facilitate a complex network of payment plans, investigate and respond to any chargebacks related to ticket payments and work closely with the Ticket Services department to ensure account compliance.
  • Assist with the building of price codes, plans, promo codes, and other programming needs in SeatGeek Unify and Ticketmaster Archtics.
  • Assist in the set-up, trouble shooting and maintaining of events in SeatGeek Unify and Ticketmaster Archtics.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all 3rd party ticket relationships, including but not limited to Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, various parking operators, Fevo, Vet Tix and more.
  • Oversee the implementation of new 3rd party ticketing integrations and maximizing the potential of all new sales campaigns.
  • Serve as a resource for all departments as it relates to SeatGeek and Ticketmaster products.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows through automation, system enhancements and cross-functional process improvements.
  • Help maintain a culture that’s focused on a high standard of speed, efficiency and customer service.
  •  Maintain a positive, high-performance culture in the Ticket Operations department, while building a positive rapport with all other departments on a daily basis.
  • Act as a higher point of contact for all elevated customer service occurrences on match day.
  • Schedule and coordinate all event day box office staff with the local ticketing union.
  • Completion of other duties as assigned with a team-player mindset.  

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 4+ years of professional ticket operations experience, with demonstrated expertise in SeatGeek Unify strongly preferred.Advanced proficiency of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
  •  Experience with high level, time sensitive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build strong cross-functional relationships across multiple departments and external partners.Must have the ability to work independently without supervision, be self-directed and demonstrate initiative.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and meeting critical deadlines.
  • Strong leadership skills, specifically working with sales teams, promoters and box office staff.
  • Experience working with promotors and special events.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

Compensation: 
  • This role offers a salary range of $60,000 - $70,000 
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt.
  • This role is commission and bonus eligible based on individual and club-wide goals. 
  • Additional benefits and perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers. 

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Position Overview: 
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated First Team Administrator to join our team full time, fixed-term position beginning on August 2026 and ending on December 2026. You will be responsible for all aspects of team operations including but not limited to staff and player communication, budgeting, player registration, & trip planning. We are searching for someone with the ability to work independently and in a team/collaborative work environment as required along with strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and planning skills. The First Team Administrator will report to the General Manager.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • Organize & coordinate all aspects of home game operations for the First Team (meals, credentials, match coordination meetings, locker room countdowns, etc) and communicate accordingly
  • Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of MLS and all other relevant competitions’ (US Open Cup, Leagues Cup, etc)  away trip travel which includes organizing hotels, buses, flights, credentials, DMR, etc and communicate accordingly
  • Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of First Team preseason trips
  • Manage daily / weekly / monthly communication via Teamworks with players and staff regarding training & travel schedules & important information as needed
  • Support with execution of team events and First Team family events
  • Manage player registrations for all competitions to adhere to all rules & regulations
  • Collaborate with Second Team and Academy team operations staff to organize player movement across teams
  • Collaborate with the Federations for players call-ups
  • Support management of First Team operations budget in collaboration with the General Manager
  • Completion of other duties as assigned
 
Qualifications: 
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Team Operations or a similar role 
  • Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration 
  • Conversational Spanish language fluency preferred
  • Must display a strong work ethic and desire to build a career in professional sports
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) communication skills preferred
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $75,000.00 - $82,500.00 annually (prorated over the duration of employment)
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt.
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals.
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values, Communication, Get Better, Joyful Purpose, Own the Outcome, Selfless, and We Compete.
If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated First Team Administrator to join our team full time, fixed-term position beginning on August 2026 and ending on December 2026. You will be responsible for all aspects of team operations including but not limited to staff and player communication, budgeting, player registration, & trip planning. We are searching for someone with the ability to work independently and in a team/collaborative work environment as required along with strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and planning skills. The First Team Administrator will report to the General Manager.
Job Responsibilities:
- Organize & coordinate all aspects of home game operations for the First Team (meals, credentials, match coordination meetings, locker room countdowns, etc) and communicate accordingly - Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of MLS and all other relevant competitions’ (US Open Cup, Leagues Cup, etc) away trip travel which includes organizing hotels, buses, flights, credentials, DMR, etc and communicate accordingly - Budget for, organize, & coordinate all aspects of First Team preseason trips - Manage daily / weekly / monthly communication via Teamworks with players and staff regarding training & travel schedules & important information as needed - Support with execution of team events and First Team family events - Manage player registrations for all competitions to adhere to all rules & regulations - Collaborate with Second Team and Academy team operations staff to organize player movement across teams - Collaborate with the Federations for players call-ups - Support management of First Team operations budget in collaboration with the General Manager - Completion of other duties as assigned
Qualifications:
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in Team Operations or a similar role - Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration - Conversational Spanish language fluency preferred - Must display a strong work ethic and desire to build a career in professional sports - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills - Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment - Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required - Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays
Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong proven experience in Team Operations/Administration - Bilingual (English/Spanish) communication skills preferred
Compensation:
- This role offers a salary range of $75,000.00 - $82,500.00 annually (prorated over the duration of employment) - Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. Position Overview:
Chicago Fire FC is seeking a Community Relations / Chicago Fire Foundation Intern! This role, reporting to the Director, Community Relations, will support the planning and implementation of Chicago Fire Foundation programs and community development initiatives. This internship will run from March through August.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Assist in development and execution of present and future community relations programs
  • Assist with operational execution of the Foundation's proprietary P.L.A.Y.S. program including all logistics, securing new school and equipment, and program scheduling
  • Assist with Foundation marquee fundraisers including Marathon Charity Team, Locker Room Sale, Season Kickoff Luncheon, and others
  • Organize monthly autograph sessions and send out donation requests
  • Assist with administrative tasks, participant surveys and tracking, recaps, and grant writing
  • Other duties as assigned by Manager

  •  Previous community service experience or heart to serve others
  •  Self-starter with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to work autonomously and use excellent judgment in escalating issues to supervisors
  • Proven ability to work on simultaneous projects while maintaining attention to detail
  • Willingness to learn in a fast-paced, high-performing work environment
  •  Knowledgeable of the Chicagoland Area
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends when needed

job.title: Manager, Accounting
job.html_description:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (Chicago Fire FC) is an American professional soccer club that competes in Major League Soccer (MLS), the top U.S. domestic league. Founded on October 8, 1997, on the 126th anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire, the Club began play in 1998 as one of the League’s first expansion franchises. The Fire have won six major domestic titles, including the 1998 MLS Cup; the 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2006 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cups; as well as the 2003 MLS Supporters’ Shield.

The Club recently announced plans to build a $750M+ privately financed downtown stadium in Chicago in 2028. The stadium will anchor Chicago’s newest neighborhood, the 78, a 62-acre development and entertainment district located along the Chicago River just south of Roosevelt Road. For more information on our bold plans, visit DearChicago.com.

Additionally, the Club recently opened the state-of-the-art $100M Endeavor Health Performance Center in March 2025 that has set the standard for North American training facilities. With tremendous growth and expansion, the Club is laying the foundation for an audacious and ambitious vision that will transform the brand and the company in the coming years.

At Chicago Fire FC, we’re on a mission to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago by delivering excellence on and off the pitch to ensure a world-class experience. As a club we let our values guide everything we do: we uphold uncompromising integrity, show respect for all at all times, never settle for less, constantly innovate, and hold ourselves relentlessly accountable.

Position Overview:
The Accounting Manager will be a key member of the Finance and Accounting team and be responsible for the execution of the accounting functions and operations for Chicago Fire Football Holdings, LLC, its various subsidiaries and related not-for-profit entities. They will take the lead in review and close procedures for monthly and annual closes, oversee the accounts payable and accounts receivable processes and be heavily involved in annual audits and tax preparation.

This role will report directly to the Controller and be responsible for managing a Staff Accountant. The right candidate is personable, diligent, and effective at finding solutions and is an outstanding communicator.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • Lead the month end close process by efficiently assigning and reviewing work and providing hands on preparation/review of the financial statement consolidation
  • Responsible for the scheduling and supervision of day-to-day duties of a staff accountant, as well as assessing and conducting annual performance reviews, quarterly performance check-ins and providing coaching and mentoring to accounting staff as needed
  • Ensures proper revenue and expense recognition
  • Responsible for the review and approval of adjusting and general journal entries before posting to the general and subsidiary ledger accounts
  • Responsible for the analysis of balance sheet accounts and related account reconciliations
  • Work with accounting staff and department stakeholders to manage open accruals
  • Maintain and monitor policies and procedures for accounting and finance functions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable standards and regulations
  • Evaluate, identify, and improve areas of potential exposure and internal control weakness
  • Proficient in accounting and finance research; providing updates and recommendations on necessary treatment and reporting changes as rules and regulations change
  • Support the annual audit process and assist with tax preparation activities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion
  • This role requires being on-site 4-5 days per week
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting and/or finance or relevant experience 
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Prior managerial or staff oversight experience
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, specific to Excel and Outlook
  • Very strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to establish and maintain interdepartmental relationships
  • High level of initiative with ability to prioritize, multitask, and manage projects
  •  Experience with financial statement consolidations and not-for-profit accounting is preferred, but not required
  • NetSuite or similar cloud-based ERP software experience is a plus
  •  CPA license a plus

Compensation: 
  • This role offers a salary range of $80,000-$95,000
  • The final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club wide goals 
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers 

Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
    • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.    

 MLS Privacy Policy: 
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Director, Strategy and Special Projects
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

 Job Overview:
The Director of Special Projects serves as a strategic partner and execution lead for the Club’s executive leadership team, driving high-impact initiatives across every aspect of the business, including operations, stadium development, finance, commercial strategy, ticketing, marketing, corporate partnerships, and organizational planning. Rather than advising from the outside, this role is responsible for turning ideas into action, leading cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring the organization's most important priorities move forward. The successful candidate will have significant exposure to senior leadership and take ownership of projects that directly influence the future of Chicago Fire FC and McDonald’s Park.
 
The Club operates in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and new opportunities emerge regularly. The Director must be highly adaptable, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and detailed execution, and willing to take ownership of work well beyond a traditional job description. This candidate is also highly analytical, exercises sound business judgment, has exceptional communication skills and executive presence, and has a relentless bias for execution. Additionally, it is critical that the individual respects and maintains strict confidentiality standards, as they will be getting access to the Club’s most sensitive information. This is a rare opportunity for someone looking to transition from consulting or another analytical environment into an operating role with broad impact and future leadership potential.
  
Job Responsibilities:
Enterprise Projects
  • Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. 
  • Translate executive priorities into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability structures. 
  • Drive accountability across departments to ensure initiatives remain on schedule. 
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and key decision points while proactively removing obstacles. 
  • Develop key performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against organizational priorities. 
  • Evaluate strategic, operational, and financial risks associated with key business decisions and provide recommendations to leadership. 
  • Identify root causes of organizational challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions that improve business performance. 
  • Step into emerging priorities requiring immediate analysis, leadership, or execution. 
Strategic Analysis
  • Build financial models, business cases, operating plans, and executive analyses. 
  • Develop strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making. 
  • Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, dashboards, and analytical tools. 
  • Distill complex or incomplete information into concise, actionable recommendations. 
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and emerging opportunities. 
Executive Partnership
  • Partner directly with senior executives on many of the Club's highest priority initiatives. 
  • Increase the capacity of the executive leadership team by independently leading complex projects and coordinating cross-functional execution. 
  • Prepare executive presentations and briefing materials for leadership meetings, ownership updates, Board of Governors meetings, and other high-profile internal and external engagements. 
  • Build alignment across departments with differing priorities while maintaining momentum toward organizational objectives. 
  • Translate executive decisions into actionable next steps and ensure consistent follow-through. 
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner by bringing well-reasoned perspectives, thoughtful recommendations, and sound judgment to strategic discussions. 
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism while working on confidential or highly sensitive initiatives. 
Stadium & Organizational Initiatives
  • Lead initiatives supporting the development, opening, and long-term operation of McDonald's Park.
  • Assist with organizational planning, operating models, vendor evaluations, business planning, and new strategic initiatives. 
  • Support enterprise-wide initiatives that improve how the organization operates and scales. 
  • Take ownership of additional special projects as organizational priorities evolve.
 
 Qualifications:
  • 2-5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, investment banking, project management, or another highly analytical environment. 
  • Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, Bain, or BCG, is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to build executive-level presentations, financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools with minimal direction.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to distill complex analyses into concise, compelling recommendations for executive leadership and ownership.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to quickly build credibility and trust with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities.
  • High degree of adaptability and comfort taking on unfamiliar or loosely defined assignments.
  • Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership well beyond a traditional job description.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality while working on sensitive business matters.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile:
The Club is looking for someone who thrives in an ambitious, collaborative, and highly dynamic environment. The successful candidate is someone who:
  • Thrives in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and no two days look the same. 
  • Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems that do not have obvious answers and comfortable operating without complete information.
  • Demonstrates maturity, humility, and sound judgment when working with senior leaders on confidential or high-profile initiatives. 
  • Is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. 
  • Can influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
  • Operates with urgency while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. 
  • Is intellectually curious and eager to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, industries, and functions. 
  • Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction and proactively identifies opportunities to improve the organization. 
  • Passion for professional sports and interest in building an operating career within the industry.
  
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $90,000 - $100,000. Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as full-time, exempt.
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals.
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website.
 
 Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.  
    • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
