Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special.
At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.
If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
Job Overview:
The Director of Special Projects serves as a strategic partner and execution lead for the Club’s executive leadership team, driving high-impact initiatives across every aspect of the business, including operations, stadium development, finance, commercial strategy, ticketing, marketing, corporate partnerships, and organizational planning. Rather than advising from the outside, this role is responsible for turning ideas into action, leading cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring the organization's most important priorities move forward. The successful candidate will have significant exposure to senior leadership and take ownership of projects that directly influence the future of Chicago Fire FC and McDonald’s Park.
The Club operates in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and new opportunities emerge regularly. The Director must be highly adaptable, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and detailed execution, and willing to take ownership of work well beyond a traditional job description. This candidate is also highly analytical, exercises sound business judgment, has exceptional communication skills and executive presence, and has a relentless bias for execution. Additionally, it is critical that the individual respects and maintains strict confidentiality standards, as they will be getting access to the Club’s most sensitive information. This is a rare opportunity for someone looking to transition from consulting or another analytical environment into an operating role with broad impact and future leadership potential.
Job Responsibilities:
Enterprise Projects
- Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. - Translate executive priorities into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability structures. - Drive accountability across departments to ensure initiatives remain on schedule. - Identify risks, dependencies, and key decision points while proactively removing obstacles. - Develop key performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against organizational priorities. - Evaluate strategic, operational, and financial risks associated with key business decisions and provide recommendations to leadership. - Identify root causes of organizational challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions that improve business performance. - Step into emerging priorities requiring immediate analysis, leadership, or execution.
Strategic Analysis
- Build financial models, business cases, operating plans, and executive analyses. - Develop strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making. - Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, dashboards, and analytical tools. - Distill complex or incomplete information into concise, actionable recommendations. - Conduct research on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and emerging opportunities.
Executive Partnership
- Partner directly with senior executives on many of the Club's highest priority initiatives. - Increase the capacity of the executive leadership team by independently leading complex projects and coordinating cross-functional execution. - Prepare executive presentations and briefing materials for leadership meetings, ownership updates, Board of Governors meetings, and other high-profile internal and external engagements. - Build alignment across departments with differing priorities while maintaining momentum toward organizational objectives. - Translate executive decisions into actionable next steps and ensure consistent follow-through. - Serve as a trusted thought partner by bringing well-reasoned perspectives, thoughtful recommendations, and sound judgment to strategic discussions. - Exercise discretion and professionalism while working on confidential or highly sensitive initiatives.
Stadium & Organizational Initiatives
- Lead initiatives supporting the development, opening, and long-term operation of McDonald's Park. - Assist with organizational planning, operating models, vendor evaluations, business planning, and new strategic initiatives. - Support enterprise-wide initiatives that improve how the organization operates and scales. - Take ownership of additional special projects as organizational priorities evolve.
Qualifications:
- 2-5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, investment banking, project management, or another highly analytical environment. - Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, Bain, or BCG, is strongly preferred. - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders. - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. - Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to build executive-level presentations, financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools with minimal direction. - Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills. - Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail. - Ability to distill complex analyses into concise, compelling recommendations for executive leadership and ownership. - Strong executive presence with the ability to quickly build credibility and trust with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities. - High degree of adaptability and comfort taking on unfamiliar or loosely defined assignments. - Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership well beyond a traditional job description. - Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality while working on sensitive business matters. - Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
The Club is looking for someone who thrives in an ambitious, collaborative, and highly dynamic environment. The successful candidate is someone who:
- Thrives in a very fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and no two days look the same. - Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems that do not have obvious answers and comfortable operating without complete information. - Demonstrates maturity, humility, and sound judgment when working with senior leaders on confidential or high-profile initiatives. - Is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. - Can influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority. - Operates with urgency while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. - Is intellectually curious and eager to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, industries, and functions. - Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction and proactively identifies opportunities to improve the organization. - Passion for professional sports and interest in building an operating career within the industry.
Compensation:
- This role offers a salary range of $90,000 - $100,000. Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as full-time, exempt. - This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals. - Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website.
Please note:
- Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. - CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

- By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Host Family - Boys Academy
job.html_description:
Please note: To apply for the Host Family role, please paste the link into your browser and complete the form: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=u1MfgQQtD0CM5sCDlvGdlQ1SoUggxfREg516k7It6GtURVUyR1BNWFdTNzlaMjBaNDQwSUtCMEdOSyQlQCN0PWcu

 

Manchester City Football Club is looking for warm, welcoming host families to provide safe, supportive accommodation for Boys Academy players aged 11 to 18. This paid host-family opportunity is based in homes with good transport links to the City Football Academy and partner education sites, with accommodation needs ranging from full-time to part-time across the football season. Short-term, ad hoc accommodation may also be needed during the season.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Academy supports talented young players as they develop on and off the pitch. Host families play an important part in that journey, offering a stable home environment that helps young people balance football, education, independence and everyday family life.

 

The Role

 

As a host parent or host family, you will provide a homely, safe and welcoming environment for young players living away from home. You will support their wellbeing by offering nutritious meals, emotional encouragement and day-to-day guidance as they manage training, education and life in a new setting.

 

You will help players build essential life skills, including doing laundry, preparing meals and maintaining a clean living space, while including them in family life as much as they feel comfortable with. The home environment should offer respite from formal development programmes and help safeguard each player’s physical and emotional welfare.

 

Accommodation requirements can vary from full-time to part-time across the football season. Ideally, host families should be able to accommodate at least two players, each with their own room, and a willingness to provide short-term ad hoc accommodation during the season is also desirable.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Ability to provide a warm, safe, non-smoking household for Boys Academy players aged 11 to 18.
  • Capacity, ideally, to accommodate at least two players, each with their own room.
  • High-quality accommodation, including a spacious single or double bedroom, sufficient clothes storage, a desk, WiFi, suitable access to a bathroom and laundry facilities.
  • Ability to provide high-quality, nutritious meals in line with Academy guidance, generally evening meals on training days and breakfast, lunch, evening meal and snacks on rest days.
  • Accommodation with access to public and local amenities and good transport links to City Football Academy (M11 4TQ) and partner education sites.
  • Commitment to safeguarding, safer recruitment and ongoing Academy requirements, including DBS checks, home visits, references, training, and communication with the Performance Lifestyle and Safeguarding Teams and the player’s family.

 

Safeguarding and Safer Recruitment

 

Manchester City Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and young people, and expects host families to share this commitment. Host family providers will be subject to an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check and risk assessments before a placement begins.

 

The application and screening process is comprehensive and follows our Safer Recruitment policy. This includes DBS checks for anyone living in the home aged 16 or over, home visits and references. Any other person over the age of 18 who resides in the household or has regular contact with the player will also be required to complete an enhanced DBS check.

 

Host families will be required to complete safeguarding training and workshops arranged by the Academy. The Club will provide further guidance and training to host families, young people and their parents, explaining what is expected of everyone involved. Host families will also need to adhere to further and ongoing requirements outlined during the application process, including home visits from our Performance Lifestyle and Safeguarding Teams.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Being a Manchester City host family is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to a young player’s development, wellbeing and confidence. You will help create the stable, caring environment that allows players to feel supported while they pursue their football and education.

 

Host families are supported by the Academy through guidance, training and ongoing communication. You will work with the Performance Lifestyle and Safeguarding Teams at Manchester City Football Club, as well as the young player’s family, so that each placement is supported clearly and responsibly.

 

Host families are paid monthly, with host fees calculated on a per-night basis when a player is placed with them (£42 per night).

 

How to Apply

 

To apply for the Host Family role, please paste the link into your browser and complete the form: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=u1MfgQQtD0CM5sCDlvGdlQ1SoUggxfREg516k7It6GtURVUyR1BNWFdTNzlaMjBaNDQwSUtCMEdOSyQlQCN0PWcu

 

A member of the team will then be in touch with you.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time permanent role plays a key part in growing Manchester City's seasonal hospitality revenue through proactive sales activity and relationship building. You will develop opportunities across inbound and outbound channels, work with a domestic and international client base, and help turn interest into bookings that deliver an outstanding matchday experience.

Who We Are

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

Within our Hospitality Sales team, we create memorable experiences for clients while supporting the commercial growth of the Club. Our focus is on thoughtful relationship building, high service standards and close collaboration across the business so we can deliver for guests and for the wider organisation.

The Role

As Business Development Manager, you will play a key part in growing Manchester City's seasonal hospitality revenue by identifying, developing and converting opportunities across inbound and outbound sales channels. The role is centred on building a healthy pipeline, nurturing relationships and turning interest into bookings that support the Club's commercial goals.

You will manage day-to-day sales activity with care and consistency, from prospecting, networking and lead generation through to accurate pipeline management and reporting. You will also host prospects on matchdays, support face-to-face meetings and bring a professional, informed approach to every customer interaction.

Success in the role will come from combining commercial instinct with strong organisation and consistent follow-through. You will work closely with colleagues across Hospitality and wider commercial teams to shape ideas, test new approaches and help deliver a high-quality experience for domestic and international clients.

What You'll Bring

⚽ Experience in business development or sales, ideally selling high-value products, premium services or hospitality offerings.
⚽ Ability to build, manage and convert a sales pipeline through outbound and inbound activity.
⚽ Confidence in face-to-face selling, including hosting prospects and representing the Club professionally on matchdays.
⚽ Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships with a wide range of clients.
⚽ A proactive, organised approach to prospecting, networking, lead generation, data capture and CRM or database management.
⚽ Strategic thinking, teamwork and a clear focus on delivering revenue targets and excellent service.

Why Choose Us

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days' annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Sunday 9 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Football Coach - Manchester City Football Education
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual role offers the chance to support Manchester City Football Education by delivering high-quality coaching sessions for players of diverse ages and abilities. You will help create a positive, organised and development-focused environment while building your experience with support from senior coaches.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Football Education, we create engaging coaching experiences that support player development and inspire a lifelong love of the game. Our coaching environment is built on high standards, positive relationships and continuous learning, with a shared focus on helping players enjoy quality sessions and progress with confidence.

 

The Role

 

In this casual coaching role, you will support the preparation, delivery and review of sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching curriculum and methodology. You will work with players of different ages and abilities, helping to create an environment that is welcoming, professional and focused on development.

 

You will deliver sessions across weekends, evenings and school holidays, while receiving mentoring and training that supports your own growth as a coach. You will also contribute to quality assurance by maintaining high standards of delivery, communication and session preparation.

 

This is a role for those who enjoy working independently and as part of a wider coaching team, with a clear focus on positive player experiences, consistency and professional conduct. You will act as a positive role model and ambassador for Manchester City, helping to ensure players, parents and colleagues receive a high-quality experience at every session.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Minimum UEFA C or equivalent coaching qualification
⚽ Experience coaching in education, community or club settings
⚽ A relevant higher education qualification, or equivalent professional experience
⚽ Commitment to ongoing CPD, including safeguarding awareness and DBS compliance
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills with players, parents, coaches and stakeholders
⚽ Proven ability to plan, deliver and review coaching sessions that support player development across age groups

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As a casual coach, you will also benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing mentoring and training, and the chance to build on your experience in a supportive coaching environment.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Tuesday 4 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an assessment on Saturday 8 August 2026, 8am-1pm, at City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: HVAC Maintenance Technician
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role plays an important part in keeping our campus facilities running safely, reliably and to a high standard. You will help maintain and support the mechanical and HVAC systems that underpin day-to-day operations, contributing to a well-managed environment for colleagues and visitors across Manchester City. Please note this role involves occasional weekend/evening work to cover football fixtures and events. 

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our maintenance team, we look after the systems and spaces that help the site operate smoothly every day. We work with care, pace and accountability, bringing together practical expertise and collaboration to support a safe, reliable and high-quality environment across the campus.

 

The Role

 

At Manchester City, the maintenance team plays a vital part in keeping our buildings and plant in excellent working order. As HVAC Maintenance Technician, you will help deliver the maintenance services that support safe, efficient operations across all sites on campus, with a clear focus on standards, safety and reliability.

 

Your work will cover planned preventive maintenance, reactive maintenance and day-to-day inspection of heating, ventilation and air conditioning assets. You will respond promptly to breakdowns, fault-find carefully and support minor installation, upgrade and adaptation works where needed.

 

Working closely with other trades and Maintenance Managers, you will contribute to planned maintenance and life cycle schedules for the buildings on site. This is a hands-on role where good judgement, teamwork and a consistent approach all help keep the campus operating at its best.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ NVQ Level 3 in HVAC, Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification

⚽ Experience working in a complex maintenance environment

⚽ Sound knowledge of AHUs, chilled water, water systems and air conditioning units

⚽ Experience carrying out planned preventive maintenance and reactive maintenance

⚽ Ability to diagnose faults and respond safely to breakdowns 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview.

 

Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Head of Sports Medicine - Manchester City Academy
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role leads Academy sports medicine provision and helps shape the medical standards, governance and day-to-day support that keep players safe, well cared for and ready to perform. You will work across the Academy pathway, bringing clinical judgement, calm leadership and joined-up thinking to a role with real impact on player health and development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Medical team, we support the health, wellbeing and availability of players across the pathway. Our work is closely connected with performance, physiotherapy, coaching and operations colleagues, with a shared focus on evidence-based care, clear standards and an environment where young players can develop safely and consistently.

 

The Role

 

We are looking for a medical doctor to become our Head of Sports Medicine at Manchester City Academy. Working alongside our Head of Academy Physiotherapy, this role leads sports medicine provision across the Academy, with responsibility for medical governance, clinical quality and risk management. You will set the tone for how care is planned, delivered and reviewed, making sure the Academy benefits from a coherent approach to diagnosis, treatment, referral and ongoing player welfare.

 

Working closely with Academy physiotherapists, doctors and wider multidisciplinary colleagues, you will oversee injury and illness management, quality assure clinical decision making and coordinate match-day medical support. You will also line manage, mentor and support permanent and casual doctors, helping ensure provision remains consistent, responsive and aligned to the needs of the pathway.

 

As part of the Academy Performance Management Team, you will contribute to strategic and operational planning across the performance support environment, including budget oversight and system-wide collaboration with wider sports medicine colleagues. The role suits someone who combines high standards with humility, clear communication and a genuine commitment to collaborative working in a safeguarding-led environment.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Full registration with the General Medical Council.
  • Demonstrated advanced competency in clinical examination, functional assessment and medical management of sports injury and illness.
  • Experience working within a multidisciplinary team delivering medical services in high performance sport.
  • Significant experience of providing medical services to high performance athletes.
  • Experience working with young adults in elite sport.
  • Ability to lead collaboratively, mentor others and adapt practice when clinical or operational needs change.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 12 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: Studio Operator
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this full-time fixed-term role for the 2026/27 season sits at the centre of our studio production workflow, supporting the delivery of live and pre-recorded content to a consistently high broadcast standard. You will combine camera operation, VT playback and ingest, sound, autocue, editing and hands-on studio support to help keep productions running smoothly and reduce reliance on freelance cover.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Digital team, we support the creation and delivery of video content across our studios and wider channels. The team works closely with producers, studio managers, editors and engineers to deliver reliable, high-quality output that reflects the Club’s standards.

 

The Role

 

You will play a hands-on part in the day-to-day running of the studios, helping deliver smooth live and pre-recorded productions from setup through to strike. Working closely with the Studio Lead, you will help make sure each shoot is prepared properly, operated professionally and supported by the right kit, systems and processes.

 

Your work will span camera operation, VT playback and ingest, sound support, autocue and editing, so this is a role for someone who enjoys variety and can move confidently between technical and creative tasks. You will also help maintain equipment, keep studio trackers up to date, manage kit between spaces and support testing and innovation as new workflows are introduced.

 

Alongside the practical production work, you will play an important part in keeping the studios organised, reliable and ready for use. You will work with colleagues across production, engineering and wider Digital teams to troubleshoot issues, support continuity and contribute to a positive, solutions-focused studio environment.

 

What You’ll Bring

 Experience in a multi-camera studio or live broadcast environment.

 Experience operating autocue systems in live or recorded productions.

 Working knowledge of non-linear editing software such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar.

Why Choose Us

job.title: Facilities Supervisor (Etihad Stadium)
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this 12-month fixed term contract Facilities Supervisor role plays a key part in keeping the site safe, welcoming and operating to a high standard for colleagues, partners and visitors. Working on a 5 days over 7 pattern with regular evenings and weekends, you will help deliver excellent facilities support across a busy multi-use environment. This is an exciting opportunity that will include the delivery of Premier League, UEFA fixtures and concerts at the Etihad Stadium.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Facilities Management team helps keep the Etihad Stadium and wider site ready for the many different demands of each day and each season. From maintaining safe, clean and welcoming spaces to supporting matchday preparation, contractor coordination and guest standards, the team plays an important part in creating a professional environment that works for everyone who uses it.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of day-to-day site operations, helping to make sure facilities services are delivered to a high standard and that the building environment supports colleagues, partners and customers. You will help maintain the quality, safety and consistency of the site, bringing a practical and thoughtful approach to the work that keeps everything running smoothly.

 

Your focus will include daily checks and operational support across cleaning, health and safety, building maintenance, grounds, security and energy management. You will also help coordinate planning and day-to-day use of the site, support accommodation standards, contribute to audits and inspections, and work alongside others to make sure facilities meet the needs of a varied and busy environment.

 

You will work closely with colleagues, partners and contractors, helping to build positive relationships and support continuous improvement across the site. The role also involves supporting the wider Facilities Management team on meetings, events, infrastructure projects and matchday or safety-related activity when required, so flexibility, good judgement and clear communication are important throughout.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in facilities management or a similar supervisory role within a multi-faceted building or operational environment.

⚽ Ability to supervise and support cleaning, security or other site service teams to maintain high standards.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to influence colleagues, contractors and stakeholders.

⚽ Good computer literacy, with the ability to maintain records, complete administration and produce reports accurately.

⚽ Ability to manage day-to-day operations, follow procedures and contribute to continuous improvement.

⚽ A good standard of education or relevant qualifications, with the flexibility to work a 5 days over 7 pattern including regular evenings and weekends.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The selection process is expected to include TA screening and CV review, an initial informal introductory call, and a second-stage task-based assessment and face-to-face interview. If required, a final validation interview may also take place. First-stage interviews are planned online in the week commencing 24 August 2026, with second-stage interviews face to face in the week commencing 31 August 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: MCWFC Academy Therapist
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time permanent role offers the chance to deliver best-practice physiotherapy support across the Manchester City Women Academy. You will work across all phases of the pathway, helping young players stay healthy, recover well and progress in a high-performance environment that values collaboration, detail and long-term development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Women Academy, our medical and sports science team works closely together to give players the best possible support across every phase of the pathway. We aim to create an environment where evidence-based care, clear communication and long-term development sit side by side.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the centre of the MCWFC Academy medical offer, helping to deliver best-practice physiotherapy across the pathway. You will play an important part in assessing, diagnosing and supporting rehabilitation plans, while contributing to the wider performance and wellbeing of players across the Academy.

 

A key focus of the role is helping shape and deliver evidence-based injury prevention and physiotherapy protocols, with particular attention to growth-related complaints and the changing needs of young female athletes. You will also stay close to current research and professional regulation, while maintaining accurate records and working in line with relevant legislation, policies and departmental procedures.

 

Working closely with the Head of Physiotherapy, coaches, parents and wider club stakeholders, you will bring a calm, adaptable and collaborative approach to the role. The position requires flexibility to support all phases of the Academy as needed, including evenings and weekends, and at home and away fixtures.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy, with HCPC registration & Membership to the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP) - OR

⚽  BSc (Hons) Sports Therapy or equivalent qualification with associated accreditation.

⚽ Experience delivering physiotherapy within injury prevention, assessment and rehabilitation programmes.

⚽ Excellent understanding of paediatric and adolescent growth-related injuries and the principles of managing them.

⚽ Evidence of ongoing CPD, with postgraduate learning across relevant clinical skills such as manual therapy, soft tissue mobilisation or acute injury management.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment, communicate clearly with coaches and parents, and adapt to evening, weekend, home and away fixture demands.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted about the next stage of the process.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Medical Coordinator
job.html_description:
This part-time, 30 hours per week role offers the chance to shape and assure medical provision across our Manchester campus, covering Etihad Stadium, Joie Stadium and Co-op Live Arena. You will help make sure every football match, concert and major event is supported by proportionate, compliant and well-planned medical arrangements, with occasional attendance at live events to review delivery and keep standards working in practice.

 

Who We Are

 

City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

This role sits at the centre of a busy, multi-venue environment, working closely with safety, event operations, medical suppliers and colleagues across City Football Group and Oak View Group. It is a chance to help keep people safe across a wide range of events while supporting a culture of consistency, assurance and continuous improvement.

 

The Role

 

You will lead the planning and coordination of medical provision across the campus, bringing together venue needs, supplier capability and regulatory requirements to make sure arrangements are appropriate for each event. The focus is on proportionate advice, clear governance and practical assurance, rather than a one-size-fits-all model.

 

A key part of the role is maintaining the Medical Needs Assessment, shaping event medical plans and chairing the Medical Coordination Group so that risks, actions and responsibilities are clear. You will also help ensure facilities, equipment, training and operating procedures remain fit for purpose across both event days and quieter periods, supporting consistency across the wider campus.

 

Working closely with suppliers, safety teams, emergency services and internal stakeholders, you will support procurement, deployment, audits, exercises and post-event reviews. The role includes occasional attendance at live events to review arrangements on the ground and keep medical response standards consistent across the campus.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Significant experience in pre-hospital emergency care or a senior clinical role, ideally with experience of event or mass-gathering environments.
⚽ Current professional registration as a paramedic or equivalent registered healthcare professional, plus a full UK driving licence.
⚽ Experience advising on, planning or reviewing medical provision, with a sound understanding of the Green Guide, event safety and multi-agency working.

⚽ Ability to assess risk, maintain accurate records and use information to support compliant planning and assurance.

⚽ Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across suppliers, venue teams and emergency services.

⚽ Experience chairing or contributing to governance groups, exercises, audits or incident reviews in a busy operational setting.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site before the 16th August 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

This part-time, 30 hours per week role offers the chance to shape and assure medical provision across our Manchester campus, covering Etihad Stadium, Joie Stadium and Co-op Live Arena. You will help make sure every football match, concert and major event is supported by proportionate, compliant and well-planned medical arrangements, with occasional attendance at live events to review delivery and keep standards working in practice.
Who We Are
City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.
This role sits at the centre of a busy, multi-venue environment, working closely with safety, event operations, medical suppliers and colleagues across City Football Group and Oak View Group. It is a chance to help keep people safe across a wide range of events while supporting a culture of consistency, assurance and continuous improvement.
The Role
You will lead the planning and coordination of medical provision across the campus, bringing together venue needs, supplier capability and regulatory requirements to make sure arrangements are appropriate for each event. The focus is on proportionate advice, clear governance and practical assurance, rather than a one-size-fits-all model.
A key part of the role is maintaining the Medical Needs Assessment, shaping event medical plans and chairing the Medical Coordination Group so that risks, actions and responsibilities are clear. You will also help ensure facilities, equipment, training and operating procedures remain fit for purpose across both event days and quieter periods, supporting consistency across the wider campus.
Working closely with suppliers, safety teams, emergency services and internal stakeholders, you will support procurement, deployment, audits, exercises and post-event reviews. The role includes occasional attendance at live events to review arrangements on the ground and keep medical response standards consistent across the campus.
What You’ll Bring
⚽ Significant experience in pre-hospital emergency care or a senior clinical role, ideally with experience of event or mass-gathering environments. ⚽ Current professional registration as a paramedic or equivalent registered healthcare professional, plus a full UK driving licence. ⚽ Experience advising on, planning or reviewing medical provision, with a sound understanding of the Green Guide, event safety and multi-agency working.
⚽ Ability to assess risk, maintain accurate records and use information to support compliant planning and assurance.
⚽ Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across suppliers, venue teams and emergency services.
⚽ Experience chairing or contributing to governance groups, exercises, audits or incident reviews in a busy operational setting.
Why Choose Us
Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.
You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site before the 16th August 2026.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. job.title: Customer Enablement Manager
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time permanent role will shape how we use AI-enabled service capability to improve customer experience, strengthen automation and reduce avoidable contact. You will play a central part in making sure our customer journeys are well governed, continuously improved and designed to deliver clear, consistent support.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Customer Experience and Service Support teams, we focus on making every interaction clearer, quicker and more joined up. This role will help shape how AI-supported service journeys work day to day, partnering with colleagues across Technology and Knowledge Management to improve quality, consistency and the experience people have when they contact us.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the centre of how we use AI to improve customer service. You will own the day-to-day performance of AI-enabled customer journeys, making sure they deliver accurate, helpful and consistent support while creating a better experience for customers and reducing avoidable contact.

 

You will monitor service and automation performance, identify patterns in customer conversations and turn insight into practical improvements. That includes refining prompts, workflows and knowledge content, supporting quality assurance, and helping prioritise new use cases and integrations that increase automated resolution and reduce manual effort.

 

Working closely with colleagues across Service Support, Technology and Knowledge Management, you will help ensure AI capability is introduced responsibly and adopted well by operational teams. Your work will connect governance, service design and reporting so that we continue to evolve our customer experience in a way that is effective, measurable and aligned to wider business priorities.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in customer experience, service operations or digital service improvement, with an understanding of AI-enabled or automated service tools.

⚽ Ability to analyse service data, AI Agent and feature performance, customer conversations and feedback, then turn insight into practical, prioritised improvements to automated journeys and AI-powered tools.

⚽ Experience working with knowledge content, service journeys or process governance to maintain quality and consistency.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to work across Technology, Service Support and Knowledge Management teams.

⚽ Ability to manage priorities, quality and risk in a changing environment while keeping customer outcomes in view.

⚽ Comfortable supporting the adoption of new ways of working and helping colleagues adapt to process or technology change.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days' annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to the next stage of the process.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Finance Analyst
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent full-time role gives you the opportunity to play a key part in financial analysis that supports Group Functions and Manchester City Operations across the club's football and entertainment businesses. You will help turn data into clear insight, supporting decision making across Finance, Technology, People Services, Legal, Communications and Operations.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our Finance team, we support the business with timely insight, robust analysis and clear reporting that helps colleagues make informed decisions. You will work closely with stakeholders across Group Functions and Manchester City Operations to understand performance, identify opportunities and turn data into practical action.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of financial decision making across a varied and high-profile part of the business. You will work with colleagues across Finance, Technology, People Services, Legal, Communications and Operations to provide analysis that is accurate, thoughtful and useful, helping to shape decisions around facilities and business performance.

 

You will be responsible for turning detailed financial information into clear, concise outputs that colleagues can use quickly. That will include analysis of group function costs, facilities maintenance, utilities and business rates, as well as supporting presentations that summarise complex data in a meaningful way.

 

You will also play an important part in building trusted relationships across the organisation, presenting findings confidently to more senior colleagues and working proactively with stakeholders to improve understanding, support better planning and contribute to operational efficiency across the estate and wider business.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A relevant degree, an accounting qualification or relevant work experience
  • Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to work accurately with large amounts of information and draw out practical insight
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to analyse data and create clear, easy-to-follow presentations
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
  • An approachable and collaborative style, with the ability to work well with colleagues across different functions and priorities
  • A positive, open mindset and a proactive approach to delivering high-quality work within agreed deadlines

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 11 August 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

job.title: Communications Coordinator
job.html_description:
Communications Coordinator

This Communications Coordinator role is an opportunity to help tell the story of City in the Community through engaging digital content. Working closely with the Communications Officer and wider marketing team, you will source, create and schedule multimedia content that showcases our impact, strengthens our reach and helps bring our work to life for audiences across Manchester.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Our Communications and Engagement team plays a key role in sharing the charity’s story, connecting people to our purpose and helping ensure our work is visible, relevant and impactful. Through creative content, digital campaigns and collaboration across the charity, we help celebrate the difference City in the Community makes every day.

 

The Role

You will play an important part in the delivery of City in the Community’s communications and digital content, with a particular focus on videography and editorial. Day to day, you will source compelling stories and case studies, create engaging content for our digital channels and help ensure our social media and website reflect the breadth and impact of our work.

Working closely with the Communications Officer, you will maintain content planning systems, support monthly reporting and help shape a strategic, youth-led approach to digital communications. You will also be expected to respond positively to emerging priorities and use your own initiative where suitable to spot opportunities, apply creative thinking, keep content moving and support the wider communications strategy.

Alongside digital content creation, you will use Adobe templates to produce graphic design assets for social media and printed materials, support the internal charity newsletter and collaborate with the Marketing team to maximise the reach of content across Manchester City platforms. This is a varied role that requires creativity, organisation and a confident, proactive approach.

You will also help ensure that City in the Community and CFG policies and procedures are followed, with safeguarding embedded to the highest standard across the team. The role includes working across Greater Manchester, so a full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle are required.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ A degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field such as videography, media or journalism.

⚽ Experience working in communications, marketing or media, with a focus on creating digital content.

⚽ Confident video creation and editing skills, with experience of Adobe Premiere Pro, Illustrator and Photoshop.

⚽ Up-to-date knowledge of digital technologies, social media platforms and emerging trends.

⚽ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your tone and content for different audiences.

⚽ Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

⚽ A positive, proactive approach, with the ability to work well as part of a team, use your own initiative where suitable, and manage a deadline-driven workload.

⚽ A full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle for travel across Greater Manchester.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 31st August 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 2025 Marketing Matchday Activation Intern
job.html_description:
Columbus Crew Job Opportunity



Description

Do you have a passion for marketing, promotions, and fan development? The Columbus Crew is looking for outgoing and engaging college students to serve as Marketing Matchday Activation interns for the 2025 MLS season. This position provides a variety of sports-marketing related learning experiences, specifically in event production and fan experience.

 

Opportunities & Responsibilities
  • Execute matchday activations including coordinating with on-site vendors, placing banners, setting up tents, tables, and running supporter engagement stations
  • Demonstrate and maintain Crew brand standards while serving as an ambassador of the brand
  • Assist in executing in-match experiences, halftime contests and pre/post-match activations
