  • Assist guests with various Matchday elements
  • Assist with additional Crew grassroots and marketing events as needed

 

Required skills, experience & abilities
  • Available for the entire 2025 MLS Season
  • Max of 20 hours per match week paid hourly
  • Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and an active student or recent graduate of a college or university program
  • Ability to attend ALL regular and post-season Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments
  • Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull and move continuously during work hours
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions

job.title: Intern, Ticket Sales & Service - Fall
job.html_description:

The Columbus Crew is seeking college students who want the opportunity to develop valuable skills and gain firsthand experience in the professional sports industry as a Client Services/Ticket Sales Intern. Participants will be supervised by the Director Client Services and Manager of Season Ticket Sales for the Columbus Crew. The intern will learn all aspects of the coordination and administration of Ticket Sales, Fan Service, Ticket Operations, Grassroots Event Operations and Game Day Operations.   • Working closely with sales staff to fulfill orders
  • Assisting with ticket sales activities and events, including receptions and game day entertainment

  • Strong communication skills; both verbal and written
  • Detail oriented and enthusiastic about working within a sports-related environment

  • Must receive college credit for an internship with Columbus Crew

job.title: Director, Corporate Partnership Activation
job.html_description:
Overview

The Director, Corporate Partnership Activation, is responsible for overseeing the management of all the Club's corporate partnerships, as well as achieving the revenue goal tied to the retention/renewal and growth of all partnerships. The Director will oversee all strategy for setting each partnership's goals and KPIs, activation plan for the year, communication plan, measurement plan, and will work with each individual account leader to stay accountable to this strategy. The Crew have a highly engaged portfolio of partners, with a strong desire to activate outside of the venue and use the venue in creative ways. This position will lead those innovative efforts.

The Director will also work very closely with the partnership sales team throughout the new business process, helping to identify opportunities through best practices, growth/change status of categories, and identifying an account executive who will assist in the partnership development from the early stages. This individual must be very sales minded, as this position is a combination of both marketing and sales.

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Management of all Corporate Partnership account executives, including Managers and Coordinators 
  • Thorough knowledge of all corporate partnerships, including contract details, opportunities for growth and advancement, areas of improvement and category changes
  • Develop relationships within each corporate partnership, and establish his/herself as a leader and decision maker within the company/department
  • Assist with all renewal and upsell negotiations 
  • Oversee the general planning and execution of all partnership activation plans, taking a leadership role with cross-departmental collaboration 
  • Oversee and further develop partnership communications, including regular outreach calls/meetings, recap meetings and presentations, also identifying the right opportunities to engage executive leadership with accounts
  • Further the renewal and partner growth efforts by identifying opportunities, with the staff, to present to partners, and encouraging the staff to think months ahead 
  • Set aggressive timelines and revenue goals with the staff to stay progressive
  • Work closely on a high level with other departments, most importantly Marketing & Business Intelligence, to understand their goals and plans, to drive collaboration, and provide optimal opportunities to share with prospective and current partners
  • Represent the Team at various networking events and participate in other sales and community events, as defined by the Team
  • Oversee the department's expenditure portion of the budget, and collaborate with the Vice President of Corporate Partnerships in setting revenue goals each year
  • Develop and oversee all partner networking and entertainment opportunities
  • Provide guidance, motivation, and training (where applicable) to staff, with a focus on helping them grow into their next role within or outside of the organization
 

Required Experience & Skills
  • 4-year college degree
  • Minimum 5-7 years of sales and activation and/or agency experience (sports experience preferred)
  • Minimum 1-3 years of staff management experience 
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs with expertise in PowerPoint 
  • Proficiency in CRM and best practices in account management tools 
  • Ability to think creatively and "outside of the box" as it pertains to developing marketing and activation campaigns for small, mid and large business partners
  • Ability to work weekends, nights and holidays as dictated by events or requirements

job.title: Event Operations Assistant - Seasonal
job.html_description:
Description 

Crew Events is seeking Assistants for Event Operations, that will play an integral part in the planning, organization, and execution of soccer and non-soccer events, hosted at Historic Crew Stadium, ScottsMiracle-Gro Field, and the OhioHealth Performance Center.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Oversee the Credential Management process on event days:
    • Assist with printing, organizing and laminating the credentials for Match Operations.
    • Read and interpret event orders, task lists, and venue software to effectively approve, print and archive credentials
    • Distribute credentials through our Will Call Office using exemplary organization and communication.
  • Organize and manage a variety of events, both soccer and non-soccer, at our three venues:
    • Learn and utilize SharePoint, calendar management systems and other planning software to plan all events.
    • Create and distribute the documents used to drive all events including run of show, event briefs and budgeting sheets.
    • Manage smaller scale events that range from Soccer matches to corporate meetings.
  • Encouraged to prioritize and be available for 1st team Crew matches and MLS NextPro as needed
  • Work in tandem with all branches of the operations team, along with other departments in the organization
  • Effectively communicate with guests to create positive and memorable experiences
  • Oversee the execution of small scale events as the event lead.
  • Represent the Crew and MLS in all interactions
  • Other duties/tasks as assigned
 

Required Skills and Experience 

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Experience coordinating events in a stadium or arena
  • Detailed oriented and highly organized
  • Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve in high-stress, live event situations
  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership and communication skills
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays and non-traditional hours.

job.title: Assistant Groundskeeper
job.html_description:
Want to learn and have fun in a high-end sports environment? The Columbus Crew is looking for a
motivated candidate with a strong work ethic and attention to detail, to join the staff as an Assistant
Groundskeeper. Based at the Ohio Health Performance Center, this role will assist in maintaining the 3.5
natural grass and 3 synthetic fields on property as well as assist at Scotts Miracle-Gro Field as needed.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
• Assist in grounds operations at Ohio Health Performance Center, Historic Crew Stadium, and Scotts Miracle-Gro Field
• Assist in day-to-day operations for first team, Crew 2, and academy trainings
• Assist in hosting matches and events at Historic Crew Stadium and Lower.com Field
• Assist in training part-time staff in maintenance practices and equipment use

• To pursue other desired career development of interest

job.title: Manager, Performance & Player Development - Crew 2 & Academy
job.html_description:
Overview
Columbus Crew is searching for an energetic and passionate individual for a Manager of Performance, Player Development full time role. This exciting opportunity embeds the individual into the day-to-day programming of our player development pathway. The Crew is invested in the individual development of each athlete within our player pathway. This role will be vital in ensuring the maximization of their potential through the physical performance aspect of their profile. This individual should be motivated by the development of young players and be driven to contribute to their athletic journey.

Responsibilities:
  • Player Development & Leadership:
    • Lead the performance space within three main areas: emerging talents, second team and academy teams.
    • Implement and deliver plans for physical development of youth players within the club.
    • Manage the appropriate execution of the physical component of player development plans across all levels of the club.
    • Create and deliver reports on the physical component of player development across all levels of the club.
    • Establish age specific and science-based physical benchmarks to drive programs.
    • Create and maintain performance testing battery and schedule.
  • Coaches & Meetings:
    • Attend meetings with medical and performance staffs across all levels of the club.
    • Attend meetings with Crew2/Academy coaching staffs as needed.
    • Create and maintain regular meeting schedule to discuss progress of emerging talents throughout all levels of the club.
    • Act as the Performance Lead in the Emerging Talents Workgroup. 
  • On Field Coaching:
    • On field priority focus will be in attending the IDP and IDP+ sessions.
    • Establish cadence for attending first team, Crew 2, and Academy training sessions and/or matches.
    • Provide cross coverage of Crew 2 and Academy teams as needed (i.e. run warm up, RTP, or gym sessions).
  • Load Management & Injury Prevention:
    • Lead development of periodization and programming for emerging talents.
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff in load management and injury prevention.
    • Ensure all information is aligned within One Club philosophy.
  • Administrative:
    • Maintain appropriate reports that detail plans and progressions for player development.
    • Establish cadence for reporting on emerging talents progress physical development.
  • Return to Play Programming:
    • Ensure Crew 2/Academy performance staff have built appropriate RTP.
  • Leadership:
    • Provide leadership to Crew 2/Academy performance staff.
    • Provide support for Crew 2/Academy performance staff in day to day operations.
  • Pre-Season & Away Games:
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff to establish appropriate preseason physical periodization.
    • Attend preseason trips with Crew 2 as necessary and required.
    • Create a travel schedule for Crew 2/Academy away games and tournaments that fosters leadership, evaluation and support of Crew 2/performance staff.
  • Technology Platforms:
    • Use club's technology platforms to analyze physical development of emerging talents across all levels of the club.
    • Prepare individual physical development programs with second team and academy performance staff for players based off of data collected on these platforms.
  • Community:
    • Interact with local soccer community.
    • Making public appearances and participating in promotional and sponsorship activities on behalf of the Team (and its sponsors) as are reasonable in Employee's position as Manager, Performance (Player Development) without additional compensation.
    • Involve players with the community outreach activities.
  • Other Duties:
    • Performing such other duties reasonably consistent with Employee's employment as Fitness Coach that may from time to time be reasonably determined by the Director of Sports Science and/or club leadership.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited College/University in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education, or related field (required).
  • Master's degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education or related field (preferred).
  • Minimum of three (3) years' experience in working with and developing elite level youth athletes (required).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) by the NSCA, UKSCA, or ASCA or equivalent internationally recognized Strength and Conditioning certification (required).
  • Certified Performance and Sports Scientist (CPSS) by NSCA (preferred).
  • First Aid and CPR certified.
  • Previous experience working as a part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Experience in utilizing sports science technologies and athlete management systems such as: STATSports, Vald Performance, Kitman Labs, etc.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to quickly build trust and relationships with players and staff.
  • Fluency in multiple languages would be considered an asset.
  • Extensive computer knowledge, including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Zoom.
  • An ongoing awareness and responsiveness to client satisfaction.
  • A high level of accuracy, attention to detail and confidentiality, 
  • Proven ability to listen, understand and communicate effectively. 
  • Proven to perform well under pressure, manage multiple priorities simultaneously within a highly dynamic environment.
  • Accepting direction while also displaying a high level of initiative.
  • Ability to grasp new concepts quickly and comfortable and capable in meeting deadlines.
  • On call availability and flexibility and willingness to work evenings, weekends and holidays with ability to travel when necessary.
  • A positive, winning attitude, incorporating integrity and discretion.
  • A strong understanding of growth and maturation & pediatric exercise

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

job.title: Maintenance Operative
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• SIA Door Supervisor Badge (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

job.title: Media Relations Manager
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            31st July 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Media Relations Manager is primarily responsible for coordinating and managing the delivery of the club’s contracted media requirements for the men’s first-team, as well as securing additional media coverage for the club, its staff and players.

On a day-to-day basis, the successful candidate will work with our players to ensure the club meets its contractual media activity, and be required to work at all of the club’s home and away matches.

The role requires close liaison with media rights holders (such as Sky, TNT, BBC, and international broadcasters), the Premier League, UEFA, FA, EFL, national and local media, as well as internal stakeholders, to ensure all media appearances represent the club and its players in a positive light, and meets the needs of media partners.

The successful candidate will be supported by our Head of Media Relations, and external comms agency as required.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has passion for sports media, is highly organized, has exceptional communication skills and a candidate with experience in building strong relationships in an elite sporting environment. The chosen candidate will possess a tireless work ethic, a ‘can do’ attitude, and have exemplary attention to detail.

Responsibilities:

  • Managing and delivering the Premier League & UEFA media rights contract, fulfilling the obligations of the playing squad with UK and overseas broadcast rights holders, ensuring compliance with all contractual match week media obligations. For illustrative purposes, this includes match preview interviews in the days leading up to matches, matchday interviews pre- and post-match, as well as feature-length interviews.

  • Managing and delivering matchday media obligations at all home and away matches ensuring compliance with matchday protocols.

  • Managing and delivering, in conjunction with Premier League Studios, non-match related contractual obligations, such as pre-and mid-season media access days, extended interviews, ‘masterclasses’ and ‘behind-the-scenes’ sessions.

  • Developing strong relationships with key personnel at the Premier League, Premier League Studios , and broadcast partners.

  • Identifying and managing pro-active, non-contractual media activity to deliver positive PR for players and the club.

  • Researching and producing briefing materials ahead of all media activity for players/interviewees.

  • Discussing media opportunities and requirements with players.

  • Ensuring new and emerging players are aware of media requirements and expectations.

  • Develop and maintain a strong relationship with the club’s Player Liaison team to co-ordinate additional activity, including community and commercial initiatives – using media opportunities to showcase the wider work of the club.

  • Managing day to day media enquiries, and conduct daily media monitoring alongside the club’s appointed media agency, liaising internally and escalating to the Chairman and Executive team as necessary.

  • Working as part of a wider Marketing & Communications team - attending weekly meetings to discuss and share work streams/creative ideas/campaign planning, supporting marketing and club media initiatives.

  • Overseeing the Press Office Administrator (part-time role) in managing the media operations on matchdays, the PL and UEFA media accreditation system and be responsible for logistics for the manager’s pre-match press conferences.

  • Supporting the Marketing & Comms executive for the Women’s team at key points of the season. Please note the Media Relations Manager is not required to attend Women’s or Academy matchdays.

  • Distributing club announcements / releases to media database and monitor the media enquiries email account.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Essential

  • Minimum of three years experience in a press office

  • Previous experience in a football environment

  • Experience of working with elite athletes or high profile individuals in highly pressurised environments.

  • Outstanding attention to detail

  • Excellent knowledge of the media industry/landscape

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, record keeping and producing monthly department reports on delivery

  • A high level of commitment and flexibility, as often work is required outside of office hours

  • A positive, proactive, ‘can do’ attitude

  • Strong team ethic

Desirable

  • Previous experience of delivering a broadcast media rights contract

  • Line management experience

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Fixed-Term Contract (Part-time)

Deadline: 2nd August 2026

Roles: This vacancy is for multiple roles supporting both our Foundation Phase and Youth Development Phase (YDP).

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC Academy are looking for driven, reliable, and passionate people to strengthen the scouting department. Ideally located in London, the chosen individual will play a key role in building relationships with local grassroots clubs and identifying talented players at either YDP or Foundation phase ages. As the club continues to establish itself as a Category 1 Academy, we are keen to develop our scouting and talent identification. Successful candidates would need to be available to watch grassroots games in London at weekends and have an existing knowledge of local football in London.

You will need to have a proven track record of building relationships in the local community and experience of identifying talent in the local area.

Responsibilities:

  • Identifying and monitoring local grassroots talent to join our Academy by attending games and tournaments in London

  • Helping to build and maintain relationships with local grassroots clubs & coaches.

  • Writing reports to help improve knowledge of players via the club’s scouting system.

  • Attending CPFC Academy Talent ID events and showcase games as requested by your coordinator.

  • Liaising with your coordinator and communicating your weekly scouting activity.

  • Ensuring you are available to attend recruitment department meetings and CPD events.

  • Be available to attend up to 4 games per week

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • An FA Level 1 in Talent ID

  • A Valid Driving License

  • Excellent IT skills

  • Completed an FA Safeguarding Children Course

  • Full Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) Criminal Record Check (CRC)

  • Experience of working in football talent identification

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Flexible and available to work unsociable hours

  • Able to work using your own initiative and as part of a team

job.title: Academy Assistant Head of Coaching
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            7th August 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Working closely with the Head of Coaching and Academy Director, the Assistant Head of Coaching will support the leadership and operational delivery of the Schoolboy Programme (U8–U12). The role will lead the Academy Coach Development Programme, drive coaching standards, support curriculum implementation, and work collaboratively with multidisciplinary staff to enhance both coach and player development.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the operational leadership and day-to-day management of the Schoolboy Programme (U8–U16).

  • Coordinate weekly coaching schedules and staffing allocations.

  • Support the implementation and continual development of the Academy Coaching Curriculum, Playing Philosophy and Coaching Methodology.

  • Lead the Academy Coach Development Programme across the Foundation Phase and support the Youth Development Phase.

  • Design and manage Individual Coach Development Action Plans (DAPs).

  • Deliver coaching observations, mentoring, Coach Competency Framework reviews and developmental feedback.

  • Plan and deliver internal and external CPD opportunities.

  • Support coaches undertaking formal coaching qualifications.

  • Monitor coach development, coaching standards and the consistent delivery of Academy methodology across all Academy sites.

  • Support coaches in delivering individual player development through IDPs, player reviews and MDT collaboration.

  • Contribute to player transitions, interdisciplinary reviews and succession planning.

  • Support the recruitment, induction, deployment and development of Academy coaches.

  • Support annual appraisals, objective setting and performance management processes.

  • Develop age-specific coaching frameworks and integrate the curriculum into the games programme.

  • Work collaboratively with Recruitment, Sports Science, Medical, Psychology, Education and Player Care to enhance player development.

  • Maintain accurate coaching documentation, observations and KML records, ensuring compliance with Academy Audit and Premier League standards.

  • Coach Academy age groups where required.

  • Represent the Academy professionally and support Academy events and strategic projects.

  • Promote and safeguard the welfare of all children and young people.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Essential

  • UEFA A Licence.

  • FA Advanced Youth Award.

  • FA Safeguarding Certificate.

  • Emergency First Aid in Football.

  • Extensive Academy coaching experience across the Foundation and Youth Development Phases.

  • Experience leading coach development programmes, observations and mentoring.

  • Strong knowledge of Academy Audit requirements, Kit Man Labs and Academy systems.

  • Excellent leadership, organisational and communication skills.

  • Ability to influence, support and develop coaches.

Desirable

  • Premier League EHOC qualification.

  • Premier League FCD qualification

  • EMCC Coaching and Mentoring Accreditation.

  • Experience as a Coach Educator.

  • Teaching qualification.

  • Sport-related degree.

  • Experience contributing to Academy strategy and curriculum design.

  • Full UK Driving Licence.

Personal Attributes

  • Outstanding leadership and interpersonal skills.

  • A player-centred approach with high standards and attention to detail.

  • Emotional intelligence and the ability to build strong relationships.

  • The ability to develop coaches through support, challenge and accountability.

  • A collaborative approach to working across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Strong organisational and strategic planning skills.

  • Adaptability and resilience within a high-performance environment.

  • A commitment to continuous professional development and innovation.

  • Professionalism, integrity and alignment with the Club's values.

  • A commitment to creating an inclusive environment where every player and coach feels valued, challenged and supported.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Matchday Hub Leader (Casual)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £16.67 p/h

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Hub Leader is a senior front-line catering team member responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a designated concession or bar unit on matchdays and events. Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

Our commitment to Equality

Responsibilities:

job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            Sunday 9th August 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The position ensures all concourse kiosks, fan zones and public catering units are prepared, clean, compliant and ready for matchdays and events. The role focuses on operational readiness, compliance, porter coordination, Hub Leader support, and ensuring smooth matchday execution across the stadium.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, set up and complete pre-match readiness checks for all kiosks, bars and fan zone units, ensuring cleanliness, equipment functionality, signage, stock presentation and operational readiness.

  • Move between units during matchdays/events to ensure smooth, safe and efficient operations, assisting with issue resolution and supporting end-of-day close-down to leave all areas secure, clean and compliant.

  • Ensure Hub Leaders receive all operational information, briefings, schedules, allocations and updates required for each matchday, while reinforcing operational standards and key messages.

  • Ensure Hub Leaders have the equipment, disposables and operational support required to run their units effectively, resolving issues relating to staffing, equipment, customer flow and compliance.

  • Collect, log and communicate feedback, operational issues and risks raised by Hub Leaders before, during and after events.

  • Maintain high standards of hygiene, presentation and housekeeping across all concessions, carrying out routine food safety, health & safety and pest control checks, liaising with contractors where required, and ensuring all kiosks remain audit-ready for EHO, Fire Safety and internal inspections.

  • Document and maintain licensing records, including refusals and ID checks.

  • Coordinate porter activities to ensure kiosks and work areas are cleaned to the required standard before, during and after events, including waste removal, floor cleanliness and general housekeeping.

  • Provide clear communication between kiosks, Hub Leaders and the management team, reporting maintenance issues, equipment faults, health & safety concerns and recurring operational risks requiring management action.

  • Complete and maintain operational checklists, compliance documentation and post-event reports.

  • Support equipment and stock organisation by communicating operational requirements without undertaking stock control duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a catering, retail, stadium or events environment.

  • Understanding of food safety and health & safety procedures.

  • Ability to work across a large multi-unit site and manage multiple demands.

  • Strong organisational skills with good attention to detail.

  • Experience supervising or supporting operational staff. (desirable)

  • Familiarity with EHO expectations, HACCP, or compliance-based work. (desirable)

  • Experience coordinating cleaning/porter teams. (desirable)

  • Hands-on, reliable and calm under pressure.

  • Clear communicator with a practical, problem-solving approach.

  • Organised, methodical and consistent.

  • Takes pride in maintaining high standards across the stadium.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.

Crystal Palace Football Club Academy are looking for a Grounds person to assist in the Club’s pitch maintenance programme and to ensure the delivery of an excellent playing surface at Selhurst Park Stadium, the Training Ground in Beckenham and the Academy grounds.

Responsibilities:

  • Carrying out grounds maintenance works to the training pitches, stadium pitch and associated grounds and facilities as instructed, to a satisfactory standard.

  • Undertaking maintenance of grass areas hedgerows, trees and shrubs.

  • Operating machinery and equipment associated with sports pitch and grounds maintenance as instructed.

  • Ensuring the machinery and equipment is used correctly and kept clean, and when not in use put back to appropriate storage locations.

  • Preparing to work at the Club’s facilities and other leisure sites as hours and day shifts require, these can include evenings, weekends and Bank Holidays.

  • Representing the Club in a professional manner. This is a high-profile role; therefore, you must present with a clean and smart appearance at all times. Club uniform and PPE will be provided by the Club which must be worn on duty.

  • Attending industry training courses as instructed by the Head of Maintenance and Facilities and the Pitch and Grounds Manager to maintain and develop the technical skills required for the post.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in working on professional sports pitches or amenity horticulture

  • Competent level of numeracy and literacy

  • PA1, 2a and 6 spraying certificates

  • Excellent communication skills         

  • Qualified with an NVQ Level 2 in Sports Turf Management or equivalent qualification

  • Flexible with regards to your working hours

job.title: Part-time Security Operator
job.html_description:
Job Summary
D.C. Soccer, LLC is seeking Security Operators (SOs) to provide part-time security coverage at Audi Field during special events. Responsibilities include ensuring high-quality security services to protect individuals and property and communicating effectively with security and operational teams.

Compensation
$22/hr

Responsibilities
  • Provide excellent security services at the venue.
  • Communicate effectively and efficiently with security and surveillance teams using radio and phone communications.
  • Monitor and operate facility cameras and computer systems.
  • Report safety concerns and security breaches.
  • Handle security issues and emergency situations appropriately.
  • Participate in security/safety training programs.
  • Perform regular patrols in order to maintain a safe, orderly, and secure venue.
  • Authorize entrance of vehicles or people on the property, when prior notice has been given.
  • Remove trespassers from premises and secure all exits, doors, and windows
  • Provide quality customer service to guests and employees
  • Write reports of daily activities and incidents
  • Act as a dispatcher in relaying information and emergencies
  • Work weekends, nights, holidays, and/or extended shifts.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable DC SPO (Special Police Officer) and SO (Security Officer) laws and policies.
 
Qualifications & Requirements
  •  1+ year event security experience.
  •  Must be age 21 or older.
  •  Must have no felony convictions.
  •  Possess effective written and oral communication skills.
  •  Neat and professional appearance.
  •  Ability to be trained and certified in First Aid/CPR.
  •  Ability to handle crisis situations calmly.
  •  Intermediate knowledge of computer technology.
  •  Proficient in English communication, both written and oral.
  •  Must successfully complete background check and drug/alcohol test.
  •  Must maintain required SPO licensing and training standards.
     
    Physical/Environmental Requirements
    The job involves working in a high activity outdoor sports venue, sometimes at heights, and in varying weather conditions. Physical tasks include standing for long periods, walking long distances, climbing stairs, lifting/moving up to 45 pounds, and kneeling or stooping.
     
     D.C. United is committed to uplifting our community, staff, and club. We are seeking candidates to be a part of our journey in our quest for continued organizational growth and another MLS Cup.
     
     D.C. Please contact us to request accommodation.
     
     D.C. United is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). D.C. United reaffirms its commitment to the principles of equal opportunity and diversity. D.C. United is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. D.C. All employment decisions are made on the basis of individual skills, knowledge, abilities, job performance, and other appropriate qualifications.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

Position Summary
D.C. United is seeking hard-working, committed staff to assist with events in this part-time role for the 2026 season. The Event Operations staff are responsible for working soccer matches (MLS, NWSL, USL, International Friendlies, etc.), other sporting events (UFL, Congressional Sporting Events, etc.), as well as concerts, festivals, and corporate events hosted at Audi Field. This staff will work closely with the D.C. United Operations staff to fulfill these responsibilities and represent the club professionally on event days. This position is a part-time, event-based role and does not qualify for college credit.

Compensation
$19/hr

 Position Responsibilities
  • Set-up/breakdown for all full-stadium events at Audi Field.
  • Preparing stadium areas, including the field, gates, locker rooms, concourse, hospitality spaces, and other activation spaces on match days. 
  • Operational oversight of Fan Experience Programs and participants in D.C. United match day. 
  • Coordinate with full-time staff members to ensure successful event set-up and execution.
  • Adhere to a strict event timeline and tasks for preparing the stadium.
  • Assist with the coordination of various space changeovers between events as needed.
  • Provide operational and logistical support for D.C. United professional staff during events. 
 
Skills
  • Candidates should be very comfortable performing physical labor activities.
  • Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and be goal-oriented in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive work ethic, team mindset, and professional attitude are essential.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence interacting with fans and other staff members.
  • Previous experience in sports or events is ideal, and a leadership background is a plus.
 
Position Requirements
  • Must be available to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to lift 40+lbs without strain and comfortable walking for long durations.
  • Comfortable working outside in all weather conditions.
  • Commitment to work at least 80% of Full Stadium Audi Field Events (D.C. United, Washington Spirit, UFL, USL, etc.)
  • Must be available to attend mandatory training session(s).
  • Selected candidates must pass a background check.

job.title: Regional Development School (RDS) Coach
job.html_description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Regional Development School (RDS) Coach will be responsible for the coaching, development of talent, and delivery of multiple RDS locations per season. The RDS Coach will deliver the RDS curriculum and actively scout and assist in the recruitment of talent for the Academy within the guidelines of D.C. United, US Soccer and the MLS. The RDS Coach will be responsible for delivering summer camps and other clinics. This position will report directly to the Director of Youth Programs.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Assist in planning and organization of RDS tryouts.
  • Develop training program for weekly training sessions for RDS participants.
  • Consistently plan, execute, demonstrate and deliver high energy training sessions that are competitive and engaging
  • Provide player assessment and feedback of strengths/weaknesses each season
  • Guide players in development of an “action plan” setting specific goals to reach a desired outcome. 
  • Identify and recommend, talented, potential Academy players.
  • Attend mandatory education meetings and classroom sessions.
  • Organize and assist in the running of other camps/clinics/tryouts throughout the year.
  • Ongoing assessment and mentoring of summer coaching staff. 
  • Other coaching requirements as needed

QUALIFICATIONS
-       A current US Soccer C license coach or equivalent (minimum)
-       Possess the drive to develop youth players and work as part of a team
-       Knowledge of MLS/DMV soccer landscape preferred
-       Available to work flexible hours including nights, weekends & holidays
-       Have the ability to plan, create, execute and document training sessions and programs 
-       Have a basic knowledge of the MLS Next rules and regulations
-       The selected candidate must successfully pass a background check.

Compensation
Hourly (scale depending on coaching license)

D.C. United is committed to uplifting our community, staff, and club. We are seeking candidates to be a part of our journey in our quest for continued organizational growth and another MLS Cup.

job.title: Youth Futsal Coach
job.html_description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Youth Futsal Coach will be responsible for the coaching of futsal clinics around the DMV area throughout the year. The youth futsal coach will deliver from different curricula depending on the program. In addition, the coach will actively scout and recommend players for DC United’s Regional Development School program. The coach will report directly to the Director of Youth Programs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • A coach’s working week is comprised of on field coaching hours & administration duties
  • Required to attend mandatory paid pre-season orientation event(s)
  • Assist in Regional Development School (RDS) tryouts as needed
  • Scout/recommend talented, potential RDS players.
  • Organize and assist in the running of other camps/clinics/tryouts throughout the year.
  • Assist with Community Relations events as needed.
  • Assist with training for affiliate programs as needed.
QUALIFICATIONS
-       A current US Soccer D license coach or equivalent (minimum)
-       Possess the drive to develop youth players and work as part of a team
-       Knowledge of MLS/DMV futsal landscape preferred
-       Available to work flexible hours including nights, weekends & holidays
-       Have the ability to plan, create, execute and document training sessions and programs 
-       Valid US Driver’s License
-       The selected candidate must be able to successfully pass a background check

Compensation
-       Hourly (scale depending on coaching license)

job.title: 2026 Guest Experience Captain
job.html_description:
As a Guest Experience Captain at Audi Field, you are more than an event-day leader – you help shape every guest’s experience. Through leadership, professionalism, and service, you ensure every event is safe, welcoming, and memorable. This position helps oversee assigned areas of the stadium, supports staff deployment, resolves guest and staff concerns, communicates with the Command Center, and ensures every event runs with professionalism, safety, and care. At Audi Field, every event is different. Every crowd is unique. Every shift is an opportunity to go “Beyond the Game” by creating moments that fans, guests, staff, and partners remember long after the event ends.
 
Our mission is simple and powerful:
To deliver a safe, welcoming, and unforgettable guest experience while fostering a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
Who We Are
The Guest Experience Team serves as the face of Audi Field. Every interaction contributes to the overall guest experience, making professionalism, teamwork, and exceptional service essential to every event. Our team supports all home matches and major events hosted at Audi Field, including:
  • D.C. United
  • Washington Spirit
  • DC Defenders
  • DC Power FC
In addition to sporting events, our team supports a wide variety of special events throughout the year, including: 
  • Concerts, festivals, and live entertainment  
  • International sporting events 
  • Corporate functions 
  • Concerts and live entertainment
  • Corporate meetings and conferences
  • Galas, community events, and private rentals
  • Large-scale, full-stadium productions
The Guest Experience Captain plays an important role in making sure each event is staffed, supported, and executed at a high level.
Job Summary
• Position: Guest Experience Captain
• Department: Guest Experience
• Schedule: Part-time, event-based
• Season: Late February through November, with additional year-round event opportunities
• Average Shift Length: Varies by event
• Availability: Evenings, weekends, holidays, and major event dates required
• Pay Rate: $26.00
This is a part-time, event-based leadership position. Candidates must have strong availability for full-stadium events, sporting events, concerts, and special events.
 
Position Overview
The Guest Experience Captain serves as an event-day leader within the Guest Experience Department, overseeing assigned areas of the stadium to ensure safe, efficient, and exceptional event operations. This role is responsible for leading Guest Experience staff and supervisors, coordinating event-day activities, monitoring guest flow, addressing operational and service-related issues, and maintaining clear communication with the Command Center and other stadium departments. Captains play a critical role in upholding Audi Field's standards for guest service, safety, and operational excellence throughout every event. 
Success in this role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to remain composed in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who communicates effectively, makes confident decisions under pressure, and is committed to delivering outstanding experience for both guests and staff. 
Essential Functions
  • Ensure staff understand event details, policies, emergency procedures, and guest service experience expectations
  • Support crowd management, line control, gate operations, premium areas, seating areas, and special event needs
  • Help identify safety concerns, guest experience concerns, staffing gaps, and operational issues
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Audi Field policies, Fan Code of Conduct, emergency procedures, and stadium layout.
  • Represent Audi Field, D.C. United, and the Guest Experience Team with professionalism, integrity, and exceptional customer service at all times.
Key Responsibilities
 
Event Leadership
  • Assist with running assigned stadium areas during sporting events, concerts, and special events
  • Understand event flow from staff check-in through post-event exit
  • Support the Manager On Duty by communicating updates, concerns, and staffing need
  • Help adjust staff assignments based on crowd flow, weather, event needs, or operational changes
  • Make quick decisions while keeping guest safety and service standards at the center
Staff Leadership and Development: 
  • Assist with staff check-in, briefings, deployment, breaks, and end-of-night releases
  • Ensure staff are in proper uniform and ready for their assigned position
  • Provide coaching, performance feedback, and real-time directions to Guest Experience Ambassadors throughout the event. 
  • Help staff understand their role, location, responsibilities, and escalation process
  • Communicate with staff in a clear, respectful, and professional manner
  • Support new staff and help build confidence during event-day operations
Guest Experience and De-Escalation
  • Deliver exceptional customer service by resolving guest concerns with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment. 
  • Address ticketing, seating, ADA accommodations, lost and found, and general stadium inquiries. 
  • De-escalate guest situations and coordinate with Security or event leadership when necessary. 
  • Promote proactive guest engagement to create a safe, welcoming, and memorable event experience. 
  • Ensure Guest Experience standards are consistently maintained throughout assigned areas. 
  • Demonstrate proactive Guest Experience by anticipating guest needs before concerns arise.  
Command Center and Cross-Department Communication
  • Maintain continuous communication with the Command Center regarding operational updates, incidents, staffing needs, and guest concerns. 
  • Coordinate with Security, Medical, Operations, Ticketing, Premium Services, Concessions, Housekeeping, ADA Services, and other event partners. 
  • Escalate operational, safety, and security concerns promptly through established communication channels. 
  • Foster collaboration across departments to ensure efficient event operations. 
Event Readiness and Reporting
  • Complete accurate and timely incident reports, event summaries, and operational documentation where applicable 
  • Conduct pre-event inspections to identify operational, safety, or guest service concerns. 
  • Verify staff assignments, operational readiness, and area preparation before gates open. 
  • Monitor crowd flow, guest behavior, access points, and high-traffic areas throughout the event. 
  •  Document staffing observations, guest interactions, and operational recommendations to support continuous improvement.  
Required Qualifications
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Previous experience working in a stadium, arena, sports venue, entertainment venue, or large-scale event environment required
  • Experience working sporting events, concerts, or high-volume guest-facing events strongly preferred
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure
  • Experience de-escalating guest or customer concerns
  • Ability to support, coach, and direct part-time event staff
  • Strong understanding of guest experience, crowd management, and event operations
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple departments and vendors
  • Comfortable communicating with Command Center and event leadership
  • Ability to stand and walk continuously for shifts lasting 6-12 hours, including climbing stairs and navigating all stadium levels.  
  • Comfortable working in heat, cold, rain, and changing weather conditions
  • Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and blackout dates
  • Reliable transportation to Audi Field
  • Must embody our Company Values: Determined, Committed, United
  • Must demonstrate our Departmental Values: Respect, Integrity, Safety, Empathy
  • The selected candidate must be able to successfully pass a background check
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous leadership experience in guest services, stadium operations, event operations, hospitality, customer service, or venue security. 
  • Experience supervising or deploying event-day staff in a high-volume environment. 
  • Working knowledge of ticketing systems, access control, credential verification, ADA accommodations, premium hospitality, and guest services. 
  • Experience supporting professional sporting events, concerts, festivals, conventions, or other large public events. 
  • Familiarity with Major League Soccer (MLS), professional football, or the live entertainment industry is preferred. 
At Audi Field, Guest Experience Captains set the standard for professionalism, leadership, and exceptional service. If you enjoy leading teams, solving problems, and creating memorable experiences in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply and help us go “Beyond the Game”.
