job.title: Fan Services Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027 across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Fan Services Manager (Lead), the Fan Services Manager is responsible for delivering a world‑class fan experience at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This role supports the planning, coordination, and delivery of fan services across all venues, ensuring that spectators enjoy a safe, welcoming, and seamless experience from arrival to departure.

The Fan Services Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.

This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.


The Fan Services Manager is responsible for overseeing the planning, preparation, and delivery of fan services across all tournament venues, including:

·     Support the planning, coordination, and delivery of Fan Services operations across all venues.
·     Ensure high‑quality fan experiences aligned with FIFA service standards and spectator expectations.
·     Work closely with stadium Spectator Services, Guest Experience, Operations, Security, and other teams to integrate tournament operations with existing services, including the development and execution of efficient Spectator Services and Crowd Management plans.
·     Coordinate with FIFA Functional Areas, stadiums, and external stakeholders on Last Mile operations to ensure safe, efficient access to and from venues.
·     Support and manage the Fan Services project plan, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC2027 programme.
·     Oversee fan service spaces, assets, Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E), and related logistics across venues.
·     Manage staff and volunteer requirements for Fan Services central and in each stadium.
·     Support procurement processes by defining operational and technical requirements for fan services at each stadium.
·     Contribute to budget planning, track delivery, and support post‑event reporting and debriefing.
·     Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks related to fan services across all venues.
·     Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Education
·        University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
·        Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
·        Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience
·        Minimum of 5 years delivering Fan Services at international sporting events.
·        Proven experience managing fan services for complex, multi‑venue events involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.
·        Strong knowledge crowd management particularly within sporting events.
·        Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies. 
·        Demonstrated excellence in customer service delivery. 
·        Strong presentation and negotiation skills. 
·        Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
·        Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams without formal reporting lines. 
·        Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large‑scale events. 
·        Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure. 
·        Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset. 
·        Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic and evolving environments. 
·        Strong IT proficiency, including MS Office and Visio.

Skills & Competencies

·        Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
·        Solution-oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
·        Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during peak periods.
·        Sound judgment and critical problem-solving skills.
·        Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
·        High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
·        Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
·        Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Requirement

·       The right to work in Brazil. 
·       Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
· Assist the team in building complete and accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for selected FIFA tournament venues in the host country
· Assist in the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories and seat allocations and carries out required updates
· Maintain on day-to-day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and applies changes as required
· Ensures data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
· Carry out seat assignment processes in the ticketing system
· Support team to liaise with other functional areas in the planning of seating configuration and spectator flow for selected venues
· Assess and analyze maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
· Carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
· Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and proposes corrective measures
· Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measure for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
· Support administrating allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
· Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events systems
· Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events
Education
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience
• Strong professional experience
· Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
· Experience in working with CAD technical drawings considered as a plus
· Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player

Skills & Competencies
· Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
· Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
· Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
· Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas
· Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements
· Willingness to travel to host cities
· Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
· Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
· Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese. Proficiency in additional languages is valued
· Right to work in Brazil
· Fluent in English (spoken and written)
· Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
· Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Vehicle Access and Parking Permit (VAPP) Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Vehicle Access and Parking Permit (VAPP) Programme Manager shall be responsible for the planning, development, implementation and overall management of the VAPP Programme for the FWWC2027 Tournament, ensuring that all vehicle accreditation and parking operations are delivered in accordance with FIFA27 operational requirements. The role shall coordinate the design, production, allocation, distribution and control of VAPPs, ensuring effective integration with all FIFA27 Functional Areas, Host Cities, stadiums, airports, training sites and other relevant stakeholders. The VAPP Programme Manager shall also oversee the planning, allocation and distribution of workforce public transport cards, ensuring compliance with established eligibility criteria, operational timelines and service levels, while maintaining accurate records, reporting and effective stakeholder coordination throughout the Tournament lifecycle.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all VAPP related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Actively lead and contribute on the development and implementation of the Host Cities Vehicles Access and/or Parking Permits (VAPPs) and venue/stadium transport access operational plans.
  • Deliver FWWC2027 VAPP scheme taking into consideration all factors surrounding the guests and Workforce’ journey.
  • Lead the procurement, contract implementation and performance management of the service provider(s) responsible for the production, printing, packaging and distribution of all VAPPs, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, production schedules, quality standards, security protocols, inventory control, distribution plans and agreed service levels throughout the Tournament lifecycle.
  • Manage VAPP system and the supporting tools and systems (in coordination with FIFA27 Client Services) and ensure integration with other systems/ platforms within Operations department and other FIFA27 departments.
  • Engage with all stakeholders effectively; collect requirements, update and maintain VAPPs database, and assist with the distribution of VAPPs to all guest groups in coordination with guest group owners (departments/ functional areas).
  • Create and maintain comprehensive processes to obtain necessary documents from all functional areas/ departments to facilitate the permit application.
  • Work closely with key partners and service providers to monitor and ensure VAPPs activities are being executed in alignment with the contractual requirements.
  • Develop FWWC2027 VAPP Guide(s), policies and related procedures.
  • Work closely with the relevant local authorities and FWWC2027 Security Department in the implementation of the Vehicle Permit Checkpoints (e.g. at vehicle screening areas).
  • Prepare and submit forms/ applications and letters to various departments/ functional areas having jurisdiction over required permits and/or approvals.
  • Manage the onsite VAPP helpdesk for all incoming enquiries during operational period
  • The specific duties of this role may evolve and change through the operational planning and delivery phases.

Qualifications:
Education – bachelor’s degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.

Experience:
  • Experience managing service providers, including procurement support, contract administration, supplier performance management and service level monitoring.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and engaging with public authorities, venue operators, suppliers and internal stakeholders. 
  • Experience managing operational databases, permit or accreditation systems, or other information management platforms is highly desirable. 
  • Experience developing operational procedures, policies, user guides and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
  • Experience working in an international, multicultural and fast-paced environment is desirable.
  • Previous experience in large events would be an advantage, but is not mandatory.
Skills:
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management.
  • Strong ability to work with operational systems, online platforms, databases and reporting tools. 
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, gaps, duplications and risks in data and operational records. 
  • Ability to produce clear reports, trackers, dashboards and status updates for management and stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially when dealing with permits, vehicle data, stakeholder requests and controlled documents.

job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Vehicle Access and Parking Permit (VAPP) Programme Manager shall be responsible for the planning, development, implementation and overall management of the VAPP Programme for the FWWC2027 Tournament, ensuring that all vehicle accreditation and parking operations are delivered in accordance with FIFA27 operational requirements. The role shall coordinate the design, production, allocation, distribution and control of VAPPs, ensuring effective integration with all FIFA27 Functional Areas, Host Cities, stadiums, airports, training sites and other relevant stakeholders. The VAPP Programme Manager shall also oversee the planning, allocation and distribution of workforce public transport cards, ensuring compliance with established eligibility criteria, operational timelines and service levels, while maintaining accurate records, reporting and effective stakeholder coordination throughout the Tournament lifecycle.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all VAPP related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event. - Actively lead and contribute on the development and implementation of the Host Cities Vehicles Access and/or Parking Permits (VAPPs) and venue/stadium transport access operational plans. - Deliver FWWC2027 VAPP scheme taking into consideration all factors surrounding the guests and Workforce’ journey. - Lead the procurement, contract implementation and performance management of the service provider(s) responsible for the production, printing, packaging and distribution of all VAPPs, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, production schedules, quality standards, security protocols, inventory control, distribution plans and agreed service levels throughout the Tournament lifecycle. - Manage VAPP system and the supporting tools and systems (in coordination with FIFA27 Client Services) and ensure integration with other systems/ platforms within Operations department and other FIFA27 departments. - Engage with all stakeholders effectively; collect requirements, update and maintain VAPPs database, and assist with the distribution of VAPPs to all guest groups in coordination with guest group owners (departments/ functional areas). - Create and maintain comprehensive processes to obtain necessary documents from all functional areas/ departments to facilitate the permit application. - Work closely with key partners and service providers to monitor and ensure VAPPs activities are being executed in alignment with the contractual requirements. - Develop FWWC2027 VAPP Guide(s), policies and related procedures. - Work closely with the relevant local authorities and FWWC2027 Security Department in the implementation of the Vehicle Permit Checkpoints (e.g. at vehicle screening areas). - Prepare and submit forms/ applications and letters to various departments/ functional areas having jurisdiction over required permits and/or approvals. - Manage the onsite VAPP helpdesk for all incoming enquiries during operational period - The specific duties of this role may evolve and change through the operational planning and delivery phases.
Qualifications:Education – bachelor’s degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
Experience:
- Experience managing service providers, including procurement support, contract administration, supplier performance management and service level monitoring. - Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and engaging with public authorities, venue operators, suppliers and internal stakeholders. - Experience managing operational databases, permit or accreditation systems, or other information management platforms is highly desirable. - Experience developing operational procedures, policies, user guides and standard operating procedures (SOPs). - Experience working in an international, multicultural and fast-paced environment is desirable. - Previous experience in large events would be an advantage, but is not mandatory.
Skills:
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management. - Strong ability to work with operational systems, online platforms, databases and reporting tools. - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, gaps, duplications and risks in data and operational records. - Ability to produce clear reports, trackers, dashboards and status updates for management and stakeholders. - Strong attention to detail, especially when dealing with permits, vehicle data, stakeholder requests and controlled documents. - Ability to translate operational requirements into system requirements, user guides and practical procedures. - Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines. - Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Social Media Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Senior Social Media Manager (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Social Media Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Digital Marketing team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for managing, planning and delivering social media campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Social Media Manager for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ include:

• Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with tournament goals and target audiences based on country and consumer audience. 
• Set specific objectives for social media campaigns, such as increasing brand awareness, driving traffic, and boosting engagement through a fan-first approach. 
• Ensure all social media content aligns with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging guidelines. 
• Create, curate, and publish engaging and relevant content across social platforms, including text, images, videos, and other multimedia. 
• Develop content calendars and schedule posts across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and more. 
• Monitor social media platforms for trends, mentions, and relevant conversations. 
• Use social listening tools to gather insights and trends for stakeholders across marketing, creative, and digital content teams. 
• Track and analyse social media performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Sprinklr, native platform analytics, and third-party tools. 
• Prepare and present reports on engagement, reach, follower growth, and ROI, using insights to optimise strategies. 
• Plan, create, and manage paid social media campaigns to achieve marketing objectives such as lead generation or sales. 
• Monitor and optimise advertising performance, adjusting targeting, creative, and budgets based on analytics. 
• Identify, manage, and collaborate with influencers, brand ambassadors, broadcasters, and partners to amplify reach and engagement. 
• Stay up to date on social media trends, tools, and best practices. 
• Execute social campaigns including contests, giveaways, and product launches. 
• Coordinate cross-platform campaigns to ensure consistent messaging and maximum impact. 
• Work closely with marketing, PR, creative services, and other departments to support overall business goals. 
• Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to produce high-quality content. 
• Act as the primary social media liaison between the Zurich-based global team and the US-based event teams. 
• Adjust strategies based on data to improve reach, engagement, and conversion rates. 
• Ensure collaboration and content optimisation with other stakeholders in the Digital Marketing group, including colleagues working on owned-and-operated platforms

  • Education & Qualifications

    • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education.


  • Work Experience

    • Experience developing social media campaigns for sports teams, paid social campaigns, creating social content, and leadership responsibilities (preferably in the South American market). 
    • Ability to understand and execute brand guidelines. 
    • Proficiency across Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. 
    • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. 
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Languages

    • Fluent in English and Portuguese 

  • Technology

    • Experience/Proficiency with; Google Analytics, Keyhole, Canva, PowerPoint, Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Adobe Creative Cloud.

job.title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour
job.html_description:
FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). 


The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy Tour exists to build anticipation and engagement ahead of the tournament, serving as a promotional platform to drive ticket sales, tourism, and global visibility. By bringing the Trophy to communities across Brazil and the world, it demonstrates FIFA’s truly global mission while positioning Brazilian host cities as vibrant, capable, and welcoming destinations at the heart of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Trophy Tour Manager will lead the planning, marketing and delivery of the Host Country phase of the FIFA Women’s World Cup2027™ Trophy Tour across Brazil, ensuring a cohesive, high-impact and locally relevant execution across all Host Cities. They will also support in moments on the Global Tor that require local stakeholders in particular Brazilian Embassies in the 32 participating Member Associations.

Acting as the central point of coordination in-market, this role will drive alignment across FIFA’s global project team in Zurich, local stakeholders and all relevant internal functions. Working in close collaboration with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich, the Manager will ensure that all FIFA Trophy Tour activities are strategically aligned, culturally relevant, and delivered to FIFA standards.

The role will also support the global leg of the FIFA Trophy Tour where required, ensuring continuity and consistency between international and Host Country phases. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy, planning & alignment
  • Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities in Brazil 
  • Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact 
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the eight Host Cities, coordinating planning, timelines, and delivery expectations 
  • Ensure integration with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives 

Stakeholder management & governance
  • Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in-market 
  • Serve as the source of truth on local context, sensitivities and opportunities, proactively informing the global team 
  • Lead cross-functional coordination across FIFA internal teams (including Operations, Legends, Digital, Communications, Brand, Partnerships and Media), ensuring all workstreams are aligned, integrated and delivered against a unified plan 
  • Ensure consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich-based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision-making across global and local stakeholders 
  • Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run of show, schedules and promotional activities 
  • Ensure total compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments 
Marketing, communications & content
  • Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on-the-ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan
  • Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative 
  • Inspire Host Cities and hosting stakeholders at a local level to invest as many resources as possible to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events possible. 
  • Lead coordination of media activities in-market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications
  • Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs and social platforms.
On-site delivery & operations
  • Represent FIFA on-site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed
  • Oversee delivery of FIFA communications, promotional and content activities, ensuring high-quality execution and stakeholder experience 
  • Ensure proper representation, handling and protection of FIFA assets, including the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy and FIFA Legend 
  • Coordinate on-site stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, including media, partners and local teams 
Reporting & performance tracking
  • Monitor progress of the FIFA Trophy Tour across Host Cities and ensure timely escalation of risks or issues 
  • Provide regular and comprehensive reporting on activities, performance and key learnings 
  • Contribute to post-event evaluation and recommendations for future FIFA Trophy Tours 
Global coordination
  • Support the Zurich-based project team on the global leg where required.
  • Coordinate with FIFA27 Government relations to pitch the FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion both phases of the FIFA Trophy Tour to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities 
  • Ensure continuity and consistency between the global and Host Country phases, capturing and sharing key learnings to inform delivery across the tour
  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing. 
  • Experience in Marketing and Events or Experiential projects, ideally within sport or major international events 
  • Preferred previous experience in football and/or professional sports. 
  • Strong understanding of sports marketing, including sponsorship, brand communication and fan engagement
  • Proven ability to deliver integrated marketing communications and promotional campaigns across online and offline channels
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced and evolving environment 
  • Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally, building strong relationships and aligning diverse teams towards a shared objective
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner
  • High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment
  • Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools e.g. Monday.com

Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Disputes & Litigation
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Responsible for the conduct of all external disputes and contentious matters involving FIFA, including civil and criminal matters and arbitration cases (note: this does not include the conduct of any sports-related matters in the CAS); 
  • Providing legal advice and guidance across all functional areas at FIFA related to contentious matters, including advising on litigation risks and outcomes; 
  • Conduct of settlement negotiations in the context of disputes;
  • Managing multiple cases in Switzerland and internationally; 
  • Engagement and instruction of external counsel, and responsibility for budgets for external legal spend; and
  • Attending court hearings, reviewing, drafting and commenting on documents.  
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Fully qualified to practise law (admitted to the Florida bar or eligible to register as Florida Authorized House Counsel) having completed academic and practical training
  • 8+ years of legal practice PQE
  • Substantial professional experience of working with and drafting legal documents in English
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Enhanced expertise: 8 years expertise "on the job" in a recognised firm or in a similar role in an in-house legal department
  • Demonstrable interest in or experience of sports, media, sponsorship and regulatory matters, including and interest in the interplay between sports and competition law
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Comfortable providing advice and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice 
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, highly organised with a strong eye for detail 
  • Ability to work as part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals.
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient, with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during court hearings, mediations and negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice. 
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/German) is an asset but not necessary
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Willingness to travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing Stadium Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the Ticketing Stadium Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Ticketing team, and work in close collaboration with the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager in Zurich as well as other key individuals responsible for delivering the Ticketing operation at the stadium for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Assist in the definition of overarching and stadium specific ticketing operations concepts
  • Liaise with other Ticketing and non-Ticketing functions to plan and deliver required stadium ticketing infrastructure, technology, equipment and security
  • Liaise with other Ticketing and non-Ticketing functions to ensure all plans are refined and integrated into stadium ticket operations planning, including; stadium seating configuration, spectator flows, Electronic Access Control procedures, customer journeys and wider venue operational plans
  • Define and develop stadium ticketing operational policies and procedures
  • Define and develop stadium ticketing issue resolution processes
  • Liaise with providers and subject matter experts to configure all ticketing systems for use during tournament operations
  • Assist in the development and execution of stadium ticketing workforce planning, including; role definition, recruitment, rostering, uniform and catering
  • Design and deliver a world class training programme for stadium ticketing staff, contractors and volunteers, including; training needs analysis, session plans, learning aids, e-learning and training logistics
  • Ensure two-way communication and engagement with FIFA departments and Host City venue teams to ensure all ticketing requirements and operational plans are clearly communicated and understood
  • Plan and deliver Ticketing HQ operations support for venue teams during tournament time
  • Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience
  • Customer oriented, strong communication skills, flexible, efficient and accountable team player
  • Solid Ticketing Operations experience – ideally in a stadium or large venue and international sporting events
Skills & Competencies
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Experience in designing and delivering face to face and online training
  • Experience in managing large projects with multiple workstreams and stakeholders 
  • Experience in delivering world class customer service
  • Knowledge of Ticketing and Electronic Access Control systems
  • Knowledge of e-learning design systems is preferred
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across internal functional areas as well as external stakeholders
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel to host cities
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese. Proficiency in additional languages is valued
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Spanish Translator
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.  

Based in our Zurich office, this is an individual contributor role focused on delivering high-quality language services and driving excellence in translation technologies. 
These are your key tasks:
  • Deliver high-quality proofreading, translation, transcription and subtitling within agreed deadlines,
  • Clarify linguistic and content-related queries with stakeholders and ensure transparent communication with the Project Management & Technology Unit and Team Lead,
  • Manage and develop terminology resources to ensure consistency across all materials,
  • Provide linguistic guidance and advisory support to assigned departments,
  • Lead internal linguistic projects and contribute to continuous process improvement,
  • Escalate risks or deadline challenges proactively and propose solutions.
AI & Technology Integration
  • Evaluate, implement and optimise AI-assisted translation, terminology and quality-control tools,
  • Perform high-level post-editing of AI-generated content to ensure alignment with FIFA quality standards,
  • Identify workflow automation opportunities and recommend efficiency enhancements,
  • Monitor AI tool performance, provide structured feedback and support system optimisation,
  • Contribute to internal guidelines and best practices for responsible and effective AI use.
Tools & Systems
  • Advanced user of translation and subtitling tools (e.g. Trados, Ooona/Aegisub) and Microsoft applications,
  • Strong understanding of translation technologies and digital workflow solutions.

We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish (Spain). Please note that this role requires translation into European Spanish Applications from professionals whose primary translation variant is Latin American Spanish will not be considered.
  • 3–5 years of experience in a similar translation or localisation role, ideally within multilingual, fast-paced environments where AI-assisted tools and automation form part of the daily workflow. 
  • Up to date with the newest translation technologies, including neural machine translation (NMT), AI-assisted CAT tools, adaptive MT engines, terminology extraction tools, quality-estimation models, and collaborative translation platforms. Ability to evaluate MT output critically and apply efficient post-editing strategies.
  • Experience in the sports industry, preferably football, is a strong advantage; ability to translate with contextual accuracy and sensitivity to the culture, terminology and emotional tone of the game.
  • Academic degree in Translation or equivalent, with formal training in EN>ES and ideally a second combination (FR>ES, DE>ES or AR>ES). Demonstrated understanding of linguistic quality frameworks, terminology management and controlled-language principles.
  • Demonstrated football knowledge and genuine interest in the sport to ensure nuanced, credible translations aligned with fan expectations and industry standards.
  • Experience in the sports industry is an advantage.

The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Regional Intern, Central Africa
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
·        Assist the Lead Regional Office with the day-to-day coordination of activities at the regional office (UNIFFAC)
·        Support the follow-up of football development projects implemented with member associations in the region
·        Prepare minutes, reports and presentations for internal and external meetings
·        Coordinate logistics for missions, workshops and events organised by the regional office
·        Handle administrative follow-up of files (correspondence, agenda, filing, databases)
·        Contribute to communication and liaison with member associations and local stakeholders
·        Take part in monitoring and gathering information on ongoing projects

We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
·        Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
·        Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with a variety of stakeholders (member associations, partners, FIFA staff)
·        Autonomy, proactivity and a strong sense of priorities
·        Discretion and respect for confidentiality
·        Team spirit and flexibility
·        Strong interest in football and its development in Africa
·        Student or recent graduate in sports management, international relations, administration or a related field
·        A background in, or interest for, football and its ecosystem is an asset
·        Prior experience (internship, volunteering, student association) in sport, events or project coordination is a plus
·        No significant professional experience required, as the role is aimed at a junior profile
·        Fluent in French
·        Good level of English required; proficiency in another FIFA language (Spanish / Arabic) is an asset
·        Proficient in the Office suite (Word / PowerPoint / Excel) and comfortable with collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)
·        Available for a 6-month internship
·        Mandatory internship agreement (school or university)
·        Flexibility for occasional travel within the UNIFFAC zone

job.title: Radio & Spectrum Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the senior Telecom manager, the radio and spectrum manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Technology team and other key individuals responsible ensuring all the aspects of Private Mobile Radio (PMR) and Spectrum Management Services are implemented according to FIFA requirements for the associated Tournaments/Events. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Spectrum:
  • Identify the Spectrum service needs and manage collection of the Spectrum requests from all Stakeholders
  • Work closely with ANATEL to identify and plan all frequencies to be reserved or use by all the client groups during the Tournaments/Events.
  • Manage spectrum governance with the key partners, the main stakeholders and with ANATEL
  • Coordinate the implementation of the frequency plan for all these services requiring temporary frequency allocation, define the frequency provision procedure and the management of requests with ANATEL and structure the organization and management control of radio equipment and monitoring on all tournament sites.
  • Develop with ANATEL a spectrum control process to ensure spectrum is managed during operations
  • Ensure that all necessary infrastructure, services and spaces required for the delivery and support of spectrum services as per FIFA requirements, are understood and effectively communicated into the venue planning process.
  • Plan and coordinate the implementation of the Test & Tag and Incident Management processes.
Private Mobile Radio:
  • Ensure services are delivered at agreed service levels in line with Tournaments/Events operational support model. 
  • Identify needs for PMRs, work closely with Tournaments/Events Venue Management staff to plan the Fleet Map and validate it with all the Functional Areas.
  • Ensure that all necessary infrastructure, services and spaces required for the delivery and support of radio services as per FIFA requirements, are understood and effectively integrated into the venue planning process.
  • Define with all partners the Roles & Responsibilities, and any other operational process.
  • Put in place the means of controlling commitments in terms of service levels, so as to organize problem-solving operations but also to facilitate any discussion with stakeholders.
  • Lead the Request for Purchase process to procure any necessary devices and operational services
Education:
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Telecommunications, Radio Communications, Spectrum management or related field
Experience:
  • Experience with Radio and Spectrum Services.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
Skills & Competencies:
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of TETRA systems, PoC (Push to Talk over Cellular), Fleet Map planning and Spectrum management.
  • Strong Project Management skills, with experience in leading large scale complex projects.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Protocol Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Protocol Manager is responsible for the definition, development, and implementation of the Protocol strategy for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role focuses on the planning, coordination, and delivery of high-level Protocol services for VVIP/VIP guests and dignitaries, including liaison with government authorities, embassies, and official delegations.

The Protocol Manager ensures the establishment of Protocol guidelines, processes, and service standards, and oversees their consistent application across all official FIFA event sites, in alignment with FIFA expectations.

Reporting to the Senior Guest Operations Manager, the role acts as the key point of reference for all Protocol-related matters and represents the function to both internal and external stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Define the overall Protocol strategy, including guest group segmentation and corresponding levels of Protocol services.
  • Develop and implement Protocol guidelines, policies, and decision-making frameworks (e.g. VVIP seating principles, order of precedence).
  • Lead the planning and delivery of Protocol services for VVIP/VIP guests and dignitaries across all official FIFA event sites.
  • Act as the key liaison with government authorities, embassies, and official delegations before and during the tournament.
  • Oversee interactions with high-ranking guests, ensuring compliance with Protocol standards and expectations.
  • Define and coordinate Protocol requirements across venues, including VVIP/VIP seating, lounges, drop-off zones, and guest flows.
  • Provide guidance and supervision to the Protocol team and coordinate with external partners and guest Protocol representatives.
  • Oversee Protocol-related services, including seating planning, forms of address, ceremonial arrangements, and official welcoming procedures.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Zurich and relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of Protocol services with overall Guest Operations delivery.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Attend site visits and inspections.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Business Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Specialization in protocol, diplomacy, or international organizations is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Extensive experience in protocol management, government relations, or diplomatic environments, including interaction with high-level stakeholders.
  • Relevant professional experience in protocol, guest management, or international relations, preferably within large-scale events or complex organizational environments.
  • Proven experience working with government authorities, embassies, and official delegations.
  • Experience in defining and implementing protocol frameworks, guidelines, and service delivery standards.
  • Experience in planning and delivering protocol services in event environments, including on-site operations is an advantage.
  • Ideally experience within a sport/event organisation or large-scale international project, preferably in a world-class event environment.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with high-level dignitaries and officials.
  • High level of diplomacy and cultural awareness in handling sensitive Protocol interactions.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage complex requirements across multiple venues.
  • Proven problem-solving skills and ability to operate in dynamic, high-pressure environments.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to oversee multiple workstreams.
  • Ability to develop and implement structured guidelines and processes.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications in protocol, diplomacy, or event management are a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Host City Volunteer Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Host City Volunteer Manager will be responsible for the delivery of the FIFA Volunteer Programme in-line with the FIFA Volunteer Framework and FIFA’s service excellence standards supported by the local operational concept. This will include full alignment with the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich on the programme strategy, mission, and vision, safeguarding the FIFA Volunteer brand and its reputation across all the host cities and assigned venues.

Reporting to the Volunteer Management Central Team – FIFA27 and working in close collaboration with the Lead of the project on the city level, the Host City Volunteer Manager will be the face of the FIFA Volunteer Programme for their respective Host City. The role will be responsible for supporting the delivery of the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform and overseeing volunteer operations within their assigned Host City.

The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following points will apply to all host cities and venues where the competition takes place.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Programme Delivery and Coordination at the Host City level
  • Collaborate with the Volunteer Management Central Team (FIFA27) and FIFA Zurich to support the delivery of the Volunteer Programme and reporting on the project status.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between FIFA27 Volunteer Management Central Team and Host City counterparts on all volunteer related matters, ensuring clear two-way coordination and information flow.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Host City queries and requests related to volunteer communications and engagement activities and projects, including volunteer-focused events.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Functional Area managers who engage volunteers or support volunteer management operations.
  • Act as a Point of contact for volunteer related topics with Venue Management when necessary.
  • Work closely with Host City counterparts for pre implementation of promotion and recruitment initiatives within local communities to tournament delivery including but not exclusive to training and uniform distribution
  • Support the promotion initiatives and events of the Volunteer team by:
    - Identifying volunteer profiles for media and/or social media features.
    - Maintaining an archive of photos and videos of Host City volunteers for use at the discretion of the central volunteer management team. Oversee the organization of volunteer-focused events led by the Host City.
    - Ensuring the Host City adheres to brand and communications guidelines at all times.
  • Actively represent the FIFA Volunteer Programme in public settings, including speaking at community events, hosting volunteer information sessions, and supporting recruitment activations.
  • Implement a coordinated approach with all stakeholders across all phases of the volunteer journey, including promotion, recruitment, role offers, training, and the tournament period.
  • Attend daily HQ meetings, Venue meetings and reporting on the status of the Volunteer Programme.
  • Participate in site visits to inspect potential pre-tournament and tournament-time required spaces.
  • Oversee the set-up and daily operations - act as a venue manager - dismantling and handover of the Volunteer Centres and spaces.
  • Align and coordinate with Host City and venue teams on logistics, storage, inventory, and distribution of volunteer recognition items as part of the Recognition Programme. Ensure venues adhere to the gift distribution calendar outlined in the Recognition Plan
  • Communicate with candidates and volunteers via Volunteer Support Channel and the FIFA Volunteer Platform.
Volunteer Management
  •  Recruit, train, manage, and lead Volunteer Coordinators within the assigned Host City, ensuring alignment, clear communication, and effective team collaboration.
  • Manage volunteers’ day-to-day to ensure efficient deployment and the well-being of volunteers on-site during each volunteer journey phase.
  • Ensure the volunteer services and recognition are provided as planned and liaise with local authorities when necessary.
  • Lead the recruitment, training and oversee the operation of the journey volunteers
  • Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other FWWC27 official events, as required.
Volunteer Platform
  • Work extensively on the Volunteer Platform to manage all stages of the volunteer journey in the host city, including but not limited to interview scheduling, role assignment, uploading shifts, shift allocation, trainings, communication, Tournament-time operations and overall communications.
  • Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
Reporting and Feedback
  • Raise risks and concern to the Volunteer Management Central team in a timely manner
  • Prepare and submit daily reports during tournament time
  • Support the knowledge transfer programme to ensure planning and operational learnings are carried to the future events
  • Prepare and deliver the post-tournament report for the assigned Host City.
Education
  • Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
Experience
  • Experience with events, and strong understanding of volunteer management
  • Proven experience in leading and managing volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including fit for purpose attraction, promotion, recruitment, training, engagement, and tournament operations.
  • Knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience in Volunteer Management System is an advantage. (Rosterfy knowledge is preferrable)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, as well as with local networks within the Host City, especially among the football community.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills
  • Enthusiasm, and the ability to inspire and motivate volunteers
  • Ability to facilitate workshops, information sessions, and volunteer briefings
  • Community outreach and recruitment engagement skills.
  • Knowledge of the local landscape, community networks, and key stakeholders within the respective Host City is an advantage.
 Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

    Expected start date: June 2, 2026

job.title: Training & Readiness Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Manager, Training & Readiness (Safety & Security) is responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing the tournament-wide capability-building, training and readiness programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment.

The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non-competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce.

• Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services
• Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines
• Design and implement a bespoke capability-building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers
• Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires)
• Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan
• Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor-led programmes, workshops and e-learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role-specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel
• Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment
• Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites
• Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table-top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario-based drills to test operational response and inter-agency coordination
• Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes
• Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability-building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work
• Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols
• Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness
• Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes
• Conduct on-site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence
• Support senior management and site management in verifying training-related supplier invoices and compliance documentation

Education
• University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field
• Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable

Experience
• Experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles
• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large-scale operational environments
• Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi-agency readiness activities
• Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector
• Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers

Skills & Competencies
• Strong instructional design and training delivery capability
• Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Ability to coordinate complex multi-stakeholder exercises and rehearsals
• Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements:
• Right to work in Brazil. 
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)
• Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Event Marketing Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Team Lead, Event Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Event Marketing Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Event Marketing in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for all marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the creation and implementation of strategic, high impact, end-to-end marketing campaigns to meet and exceed the objectives of the Tournament 
  • In line with the wider FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich teams, contribute to the GTM multi-channel marketing plans (in close liaison with the digital marketing, ticketing, comms, BI, and brand teams) to support strategic goals to drive awareness, attendance, engagement and retainment 
  • Coordinate between internal and external tournament stakeholders as directed including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees  
  • Support the development of cross cultural and sector tactical and long-term  
    strategical promotional partnerships with partners and third parties for mutual benefit 
  • Assist with the creation of relevant briefing, publishing plans, planning, valuation, tracking and final reporting documents related to marketing stakeholder’s needs as required 
  • Support the team to deliver launches of major brand assets, such as tournament logos, mascots, posters, and songs, as well as oversee multi-stage global and localised awareness and tournament related sales campaigns  
  • Ad-hoc support of additional workstreams in relation to event marketing needs which may include contact/planning/liaising and coordination with stakeholders with football clubs or participating member associations (PMA’s) 
  • Become an expert in FIFA event marketing milestone planning and FIFA processes and organise and maintain an updated library of marketing-related assets ensuring all files are easy to locate, properly labelled, and accessible to the team 
  • Assist in providing stakeholders with timely and accurate information on promotional and marketing events, activations and opportunities and ensure stakeholders to drive optimisation of the opportunities. 
  • Provide administrative and project support across the Event Marketing team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders as needed 
Education 
  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education. 
Skills & Competencies 
  • Adaptable, effective and efficient under pressure, immovable deadlines, and in stressful situations  
  • Effective at working proactively and independently whilst providing regular updates, being able to communicate clearly and effectively via different channels with key stakeholders 
  • Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders 
  • Willingness to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed 
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables 
Work Experience 
  • Experience in a marketing function favourable to hold experience with sport’s governing bodies, LOCs and, or sports and entertainment rightsholders 
  • Understanding of the dynamics of football 
  • Experience in Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations, Communications, Events 
  • A passion for football 
Technology 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools (Monday.com)  
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Senior Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working in a “team first” approach to support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel will support as follows:
  • Reporting to the Commercial Legal team leads
  • Assist in supporting on legal matters relating to FIFA’s Innovation and Technology operations
  • Provide legal support in the following areas:
    • FIFA’s direct to consumer media offerings, (including distribution and syndication and advertising sales)
    • hardware and software procurement
    • the collection of match data
    • ensuring appropriate ownership, protection and exploitation of FIFA-proprietary technology developments and collaborations
    • website and other consumer-facing T&Cs in the digital environment
    • FIFA’s data and artificial intelligence initiatives
    • FIFA’s innovation portfolios (including VR/XR and AI related matters)
  • General commercial legal support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Support as point of contact for legal matters for FIFA’s Football, Technology and Innovation Department
  • Providing strategic liaison with FIFA’s Data Protection department to ensure seamless integration into FIFA digital products
  • Providing detailed knowledge of FIFA’s rights and obligations in connection with its digital and technology programmes, including the implementation and protection thereof; including the provision of legal and contractual input on FIFA’s existing commercial commitments and future commercial possibilities
  • Providing commercial transactional support and guidance regarding the interpretation of relevant commercial agreements, including the assessment of relevant business and strategic risks, and commercial regulatory matters
  • Developing and maintaining suitable template agreements
  • Support in the delivery of ad hoc advice on issues relating to technology related activities
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great organisational and communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the digital and technology industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, well-organised with a strong eye for detail
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top-tier accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • Minimum of 7 years expertise "on the job" in the industry in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on relevant matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not necessary
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Comfortable with international travel
  • Readiness for stand-by duties and special projects
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
