- Reporting to the Commercial Legal team leads - Assist in supporting on legal matters relating to FIFA’s Innovation and Technology operations - Provide legal support in the following areas:FIFA’s direct to consumer media offerings, (including distribution and syndication and advertising sales)hardware and software procurementthe collection of match dataensuring appropriate ownership, protection and exploitation of FIFA-proprietary technology developments and collaborationswebsite and other consumer-facing T&Cs in the digital environmentFIFA’s data and artificial intelligence initiativesFIFA’s innovation portfolios (including VR/XR and AI related matters) - General commercial legal support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities - Support as point of contact for legal matters for FIFA’s Football, Technology and Innovation Department - Providing strategic liaison with FIFA’s Data Protection department to ensure seamless integration into FIFA digital products - Providing detailed knowledge of FIFA’s rights and obligations in connection with its digital and technology programmes, including the implementation and protection thereof; including the provision of legal and contractual input on FIFA’s existing commercial commitments and future commercial possibilities - Providing commercial transactional support and guidance regarding the interpretation of relevant commercial agreements, including the assessment of relevant business and strategic risks, and commercial regulatory matters - Developing and maintaining suitable template agreements - Support in the delivery of ad hoc advice on issues relating to technology related activities
We work hard at FIFA. We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.
And we respect our values. Always.
For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.
This role would suit someone with great organisational and communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.
The specific competencies we require for this position are:
- Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals - First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements - Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice - Excellent understanding of the digital and technology industry landscapes - Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills - Structured, reliable, well-organised with a strong eye for detail - Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects - Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities - Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills - High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour - Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments - Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts - Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone - Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients - Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top-tier accredited law school - Active bar membership is required - Minimum of 7 years expertise "on the job" in the industry in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on relevant matters - Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice - Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not necessary - Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel - Comfortable with international travel - Readiness for stand-by duties and special projects
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing Training Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator plays a key role in the preparation of all required training programmes for the Ticketing department prior to, and during, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring tournament time Ticketing Workforce are effectively prepared to deliver in their role. 

The Ticketing Training Coordinator will be required to lead activities related to learning needs analysis, training design, training delivery, logistical planning and reporting.

Training is expected to be delivered across a variety of mediums including – e-learning, face to face, self study and additional knowledge base resources.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The key responsibilities and oversights of the Ticketing Training Coordinator include:   
  • Develop, design, and or adapt existing e-learning content using Rapid Authoring Tool(s) such as Adobe Captivate or similar. 
  • Collaborate with Ticketing Operations experts to gather information and ensure the accuracy of training modules. 
  • Support other Ticketing teams in their training planning in relation to the e-learning tool. 
  • Support Ticketing Operations teams in designing and delivering face to face training content and supporting resources. 
  • Integrate and manage e-learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS). 
  • Ensure all e-learning modules are accessible and user-friendly for a diverse audience. 
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. 
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for e-learning modules and LMS issues.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of all training materials and development processes. 
  • Coordinate with the IT department to ensure seamless operation of e-learning platforms. 
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations in all training content. 
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of e-learning content to maintain relevance and effectiveness. 
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in e-learning and instructional design. 
  • Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required.
Education/ Experience 
  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education  
  • 1-3 years of professional experience 
  • Experience in training design and delivery
  • Experience in delivering e-learning as a training solution and managing LMS systems 
  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player 
  • Native-level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued 
 Skills & Competencies 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams) and online collaboration tools 
  • Proficient in e-learning Rapid Authoring Tools
  • Knowledge and understanding of Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Able to think creatively and ‘outside of the box’ to deliver solutions in a fast-faced- environment 
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities 
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas 
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred

job.title: Licensing & Retail Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Coordinate and manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders to oversee production workflows and the end-to-end process for premium gifts and giveaways, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and FIFA brand guidelines. 
  • Assist in coordinating and managing licensing agreements with partners, ensuring compliance with contractual terms and timelines.
  • Support the production and distribution of licensed merchandise, including coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners.
  • Analyse sales data and generate reports on merchandise performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to optimize sales strategies.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to gather insights on consumer preferences, trends, and potential opportunities for licensing and retail activities.
  • Support the development and execution of marketing and promotional campaigns for licensed merchandise, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, monitoring stock levels, and coordinating inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Provide operational support for retail partnerships, including coordinating product displays, ensuring brand compliance, and addressing partner inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective communication and alignment.
  • Manage the product approval of different Licensees across the three phases: graphic, pre-production and production.
  • Support the maintenance of licensing and retail databases and systems, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information.
  • Assist in managing licensing and retail budgets, tracking expenses, and providing financial analysis and reporting.
  • Support the coordination of licensing and retail-related events, such as trade shows, product launches, and promotional activities.  
Competencies and personality 
  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Knowledge about Brazilian market trends.
  • Good understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistent, eager and quick lerner.
  • Good organizational and back-office skills.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management, etc.
  • Relevant work experience in licensing & event retail across Brazilian market.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: Venue Operations Assistant Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Operations Assistant Manager supports the Venue Operations Manager in the planning, coordination and operational delivery of the stadium activities for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™.  

Working closely with FIFA functional areas, venue teams, stadiums and host city authorities and service providers, the role is responsible for coordinating operational activities, monitoring project progress, supporting venue readiness, and ensuring that venue plans are implemented efficiently and in compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements.

The Venue Operations Assistant Manager plays a key role in facilitating communication across stakeholders, tracking operational deliverables, supporting reporting processes, meetings and inspections, and contributing to the successful delivery of match days and non-match day activities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Assistant Manager for each host city: 
  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera
Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Venue Operations Assistant Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ include:  
  •  Support the Venue Operations Manager in the planning and operational delivery of the venue activities.  
  • Coordinate day-to-day operational planning across FIFA functional areas and local stakeholders.  
  • Monitor the implementation of venue operational plans and follow up on action items and deadlines.  
  • Assist in integrating functional area requirements into the overall venue operational plan.  
  • Coordinate meetings, workshops and venue operational briefings with internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Support venue inspections, site visits, and stadium readiness activities.  
  • Track venue issues, risks and mitigation actions, escalating matters to the Venue Operations Manager when appropriate.  
  • Maintain operational documentation, reports, meeting minutes, and planning tools.  
  • Support to coordinate  Operational Maps review (BIM360) follow-up activities resulting from inspections and site visits.  
  • Support the planning and delivery of official test events and operational exercises.  
  • Assist in coordinating venue service providers and local authorities during planning and event-time operations.  
  • Support budget tracking, procurement follow-up and operational reporting as requested by the Venue Operations Manager.  
  • Contribute to knowledge management activities, operational debriefs and lessons learned documentation.  
  • Support match day and non-match day operations, ensuring timely communication and coordination across all stakeholders.  
  • Coordinate the preparation, maintenance and distribution of daily operational documentation, including the Daily Run Sheet, operational schedules, daily reports and other venue operational documents.  
  • Coordinate venue daily operational meetings, ensuring agendas, documentation, action tracking and follow-up with all relevant stakeholders.  
  • Coordinate the planning and delivery of venue team onboarding, inductions and operational training sessions to ensure all personnel are prepared for venue operations.  
  • Liaise with the Stadium Authority core team to ensure the timely delivery of all core stadium services and operational requirements, maintaining close coordination throughout the planning and operational phases.  
  • Act as a key operational focal point during match days, proactively resolving operational issues on the ground while liaising with and responding to the Venue Operations Centre (VOC), ensuring timely communication, issue escalation and coordinated implementation of solutions.  
  • Perform other operational duties as assigned by the Venue Operations Manager.
Education
  • University degree in an appropriate field (or equivalent professional experience).
Experience
  • Strong experience in venue operations, event management, sports venues or large-scale international events. 
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders in complex operational environments. 
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills. 
  • Experience supporting operational planning and event delivery. 
  • Ability to work under pressure while managing multiple priorities. 
  • Experience with reporting, planning tools and operational documentation. 
  • Experience working with public authorities, venue operators or service providers is considered an advantage. 
  • Skills & Competencies.
  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. 
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset. 
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow through on deliverables. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. 
  • Good problem-solving and decision-support skills. 
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Adaptability, resilience and flexibility. 
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability. 
  • Commitment to delivering operational excellence.  
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Strong administrative and IT skills, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and Monday.com.

job.title: MA Africa, Intern/Apprentice
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

·        Providing operational support to the Deputy Chief Member Associations Officer
·        Provide administrative support to the Paris team and conduct research
·        Prepare reports, presentations, meeting minutes, and project documentation
·        Follow up on project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
·        Coordinate logistics for Member Association delegations visiting the Paris office
·        Assist in organizing meetings, workshops, and official missions
·        Supporting the team in the organisation of workshops and seminars, including education and capacity building
·        Improve the service to the MAs with the help of external stakeholders and other departments/divisions
·        Assist in the development and implementation of specific football development projects within Africa in collaboration with other FIFA departments
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:

·        Strong organizational and communication skills
·        Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented
·        Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
·        Team player with a collaborative mindset
·        Interest in football development and international organizations
·        Bachelor's or Master's student (Currently pursuing or recent graduate) in Sports Management, Law, Business, International Relations, or a related field
·        Strong analytical and writing skills
·        Good knowledge of project management principles
·        Interest in international development and sport
·        Previous internship or project experience is an asset
·        Experience in administration or project coordination is an asset
·        Experience in an international or multicultural environment is an asset
·        Sport organization experience is an advantage
·        Volunteer experience in sport is welcomed
·        Fluent in English
·        Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / AR / ES) is an asset
·        Willingness to travel when/if required  
·        Availability to work from the Paris office four days per week
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Home office: Up to one day of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Guest Experience Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for the development and implementation of the guest experience concept exclusively within the FIFA VIP Hotel environment, including the FIFA Club.

This role focuses on brand implementation, experiential elements, FIFA Club concept (including F&B), and curated guest touchpoints such as gifts and in-hotel experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the development and execution of the VIP Guest Experience concept within the FIFA VIP Hotel, including FIFA Club, brand implementation, and experiential elements (e.g. gifts, amenities, and curated guest touchpoints).
  • Define the FIFA Club concept (including F&B, design, and guest journey) and oversee its implementation.
  • Supervise the tender process, evaluation, and appointment of guest experience suppliers related to VIP Hotel and FIFA Club delivery (e.g. experiential agencies, branding, F&B concept providers).
  • Coordinate and maintain a strategic overview of all guest experience activities within the VIP Hotel environment.
  • During tournament time, act as FIFA Club Manager (or oversee FIFA Club Manager role), responsible for operational setup and delivery of the FIFA Club.
  • Collaborate with relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of VIP Hotel guest experience delivery (e.g. Accommodation, Protocol, Transport, Branding).
  • Establish clear lines of communication and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and involved parties.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for all relevant suppliers, their service staff, and volunteers, focusing on excellence and ‘wow’ customer service.
  • Attend site visits and inspections.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Marketing & Communications, or a related field. Specialization in hospitality, event management, or experience design is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Experience in developing and delivering premium VIP guest experience concepts and operations, ideally within hotel environments, hospitality settings, or large-scale events.
  • Extensive experience in concept development and implementation of guest experience elements, including branding, scenography, F&B concepts, and curated guest touchpoints.
  • Experience in designing and delivering premium hospitality environments (e.g. lounges, clubs, VIP spaces, or hotel-based experiences).
  • Proven experience in managing and coordinating external agencies and suppliers for experience delivery (e.g. production, branding, F&B, experiential agencies).
  • Hands-on experience in implementing on-site guest experience concepts, including setup, testing, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments, coordinating with hospitality, accommodation, and operational stakeholders.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to ensure high-quality delivery of premium guest experience standards.
  • Ability to translate conceptual ideas into operational execution, ensuring consistency between design and on-site delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate, manage, and resolve complex situations in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to manage and steer multiple external suppliers and agencies to deliver against defined concepts and timelines.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously.
  • High level of adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high-pressure event environments.
  • Solid understanding of premium hospitality environments and guest expectations.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Project or similar tools is an advantage)
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Additional certifications in hospitality, event management, or experience design are considered a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries. 

The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy. 
  •  Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. 
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. 
  •  Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. 
  •  Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. 
  •  Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. 
  •  Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. 
  •  Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. 
  •  Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. 
  •  Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. 
  •  Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. 
  •  Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. 
  •  Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. 
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. 
  •  Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  •  Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. 
  • Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. 
  • Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests. 
  • Ticketing. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. 
  • Customer Service. 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management. 
  • Good numeracy. 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation. 
  • Accountability and Transparency. 
  • Analysis and Innovation. 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability. 
  • Perseverance and Dedication. 
  • Proactivity and Organisation. 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.   
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.   
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Non-Competition Venue Dressing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all non-competition FIFA Official Sites. 

This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  
Non-competition venues are crucial to the successful delivery of a successful FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, the below list is a non-exhaustive list of venues that the successful candidate may be responsible for: 
  • Team Base Camp Training Sites 
  • Team Base Camp Hotels 
  • VIP Hotels 
  • Accreditation Centres 
  • Ticketing Centres 
  • Volunteer Centres 
  • Airports 
  • International Broadcast Centre (IBC) 
  • Outside Presentation Facility (OPF) 
  • Main Operations Centre (MOC) 
The successful candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the dressing and signage planning and implementation at all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ non-competition venues Brazil. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their cluster and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their cluster, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with the wider Dressing and Signage team to maximise creativity and ensure consistency across all non-competition venues. 
There will also be a potential need to relocate to another Host City for up to three months to take the role as Venue Dressing and Signage Managers during event periods at an assigned stadium. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups who require the services of non-competition venues at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Overseeing the turnkey planning and delivery of non-competition venue dressing and signage across the tournament.  
  • Collaborating with the other Venue Dressing and Signage Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament official sites.  
  • Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project.  
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. 
  • Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.  
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.  
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project.  
  • Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.  
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.  
  • Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.  
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management.  
  • Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project.  
  • Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues.  
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.  
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against.  
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.  
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.  
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities

    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Ticketing Infrastructure Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
This role will be responsible for delivering all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities, including all related sub-infrastructure projects, serving millions of ticket holders.

The main responsibilities of the Ticketing Infrastructure Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ include:  


·        Ensure the delivery of all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and other FIFA tournaments, in full compliance with established requirements.


·        Coordinate with other departments to review and interpret facility designs and floor plans, as well as hardware and equipment scope, specifications, and requirements, to ensure accurate and timely implementation.


·        Attend regular coordination meetings with the Ticketing Infrastructure team and other relevant departments.


·        Establish and maintain up-to-date requirements documents, as well as policies and procedures for ticketing facilities, including physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), signage, and IT equipment.


·        Plan and oversee the delivery and installation of physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E, signage, and IT equipment in ticketing facilities.


·       Manage, plan, and oversee staff involved in supporting ticketing infrastructure delivery in the host cities.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience supporting infrastructure projects.
• Proven experience working in similar roles at international sporting events
• Experience in ticketing projects is an advantage
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments.

Skills & Competencies

• Proven knowledge of infrastructure projects (e.g., overseeing the installation of overlay, furniture, signage, equipment, etc.).
• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented, with focus on delivering high-quality projects.
• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.


Certifications & Requirements

• Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese.
• Technology: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), as well as planning software and online collaboration tools. Knowledge of Power BI will be considered a significant advantage.
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
• Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: Site Security and Audit Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Site Security and Audit Coordinator is responsible for the structured protection, oversight and assurance of FIFA assets and safety and security delivery at stadium level for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role develops and implements patrimonial security and asset protection plans, establishes 24/7 security protocols during the Exclusive Use Period (EUP), and ensures that deployed security resources and stewarding operations are transparent, verifiable and compliant with FIFA regulations and contractual agreements.

The position safeguards both operational integrity and financial accountability by managing deployment information, maintaining the stadium “Blue Book,” hosting and validating event stewarding information, and conducting audits and compliance checks throughout tournament operations.

• Develop patrimonial security and asset protection plans for FIFA assets at each stadium, including overlay, branding, broadcast and restricted operational areas
• Define and implement 24/7 security protocols during the Exclusive Use Period (EUP), ensuring continuous protection of FIFA property and sensitive areas
• Establish and monitor robust perimeter control, access control and asset safeguarding measures aligned with risk assessments and FIFA standards
• Manage deployment information for each stadium, including security staffing levels, steward allocations and shift structures
• Hold, manage and continuously update the official stadium “Blue Book,” ensuring accuracy and structured sharing with relevant functional areas (e.g. Finance, Operations)
• Host and maintain event stewarding information, ensuring that stewarding numbers, roles, qualifications and deployment models are clearly documented and validated
• Develop, maintain and regularly update detailed dot plans reflecting security and steward deployment positions, resource allocations and operational coverage at stadium level
• Prepare daily verification protocols for each day of the Exclusive Use Period to ensure that supplier invoices correspond to actual deployed security and stewarding resources
• Verify installation, attendance and deployment reports against contractual requirements and approved resource plans
• Identify discrepancies in deployment or billing and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders
• Arrange for and/or conduct structured audits, inspections and compliance checks during tournament time
• Assess compliance with FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations, operational policies and contractual obligations
• Provide structured audit reports and assurance updates to the Senior Manager, Stadiums
• Support the Senior Manager, Stadiums with related administrative tasks, documentation control and reporting requirements
• Contribute to the drafting, review and maintenance of relevant policies and procedures relating to asset protection, deployment governance and stadium-level security operations
• Monitor implementation of corrective actions and support continuous improvement of asset protection and deployment governance processes
• Support operational readiness validation prior to each EUP phase and matchday
Education
• University degree or higher qualification in security management, risk management, business administration, audit, finance, data management or a related field

Experience
• Experience in physical security, asset protection, compliance, deployment governance or venue security operations
• Demonstrated experience managing large-scale operational deployment data or similar
• Proven experience conducting audits, inspections or compliance reviews in multi-site or major event settings
• Experience verifying operational resource allocation against contractual and financial documentation
• Experience working with private security suppliers, stewarding providers and venue operators

Skills & Competencies
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, complex formulas and structured data management
• Experience using macros and/or VBA to automate and manage large datasets desirable
• Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail
• Ability to design and maintain deployment tracking and verification systems
• Structured reporting capability for senior management
• High integrity when handling sensitive operational and financial information
• Strong organisational and coordination skills
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, including PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements
• Right to live and work in Brazil
• Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
• Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written); working knowledge of English is essential

job.title: Host City Volunteer Coordinator - 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
 
Support the delivery of the FIFA Volunteer Programme under the leadership ofthe Host City Volunteer Manager and the guidance of the FIFA27 Central Volunteer Management and FIFA Volunteer Management Zurich.

The role is supporting the coordination of volunteer recruitment, training, communications, and day-to-day operations within the assigned Host City.  This includes coordinating activities within the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting Stadium Volunteer Centre readiness and operations, assisting with volunteer recruitment and engagement initiatives, and helping ensure the consistent delivery of the Volunteer Programme in line with FIFA standards.

The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The following points will apply to all host cities and venues where the competition takes place. 
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
· Support the Host City Volunteer Manager in delivering the FIFA Volunteer Programme across the assigned Host City
· Support the administration and day-to-day use of the FIFA Volunteer Platform: selecting volunteers, role offers, shift management, change maanagement, communication and any other related queries
· Support the recruitment process (through application screening) and ensuring that successful candidates are appropriately matched to roles which best suit their skills and experience (assignment).
· Participate in site visits, as necessary to inspect and validate potential pre-tournament and tournament-time required spaces
· Coordinating the delivery of the Volunteer Training Programme (general and role/venue-specific training) and support Functional Areas (FAs) with Role-Specific Training plan.
· Deliver Trainings for engagement volunteers 
· Ensuring volunteers have a good experience and are deployed depending on the daily activities taking place.
· Coordinating the set-up, daily operations and readiness of the stadium volunteer centre and providing inspiration, support, and motivation to the volunteers, as well as leading the reward and recognition programme and the engagement programme during tournament time.
· Communicate with applicants and volunteers via FIFA Communications tools 
· Leading the volunteers’ day-to-day activities and supporting them while on shift.
· Supporting the HC Volunteer Manager in coordination with FAs at the venue for shift planning, change management process and volunteer deployment.
· Monitoring volunteer attendance and escalating if any issue arises.
· Undertaking the day-to-day management of volunteers to ensure the well-being of volunteers on-site.
· Ensuring that shifts are fully covered, and FAs daily requirements are fulfilled.
· Collaborate closely with the Central volunteer management team and relevant on-site Functional Area (FA) teams, to ensure the timely delivery of engagement items and gifts. 
· Coordinate the execution of engagement initiatives and gift distribution, ensuring accurate inventory control, asset tracking, and efficient management of all items and equipment.
· Support with the planning and delivery of Volunteer Thank-You event
· Contribute to the development of volunteer communications, operational guidelines, and information materials across all phases of the volunteer journey.
· Provide support to applicants and volunteers through ServiceNow, responding to enquiries promptly and escalating complex issues where required
· Depending on your assign city: support the planning and delivery of FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ events, including the Final Draw, Team Workshop, Play-Off Tournament, Volunteer Thank-You events, and other official tournament activities, as required.


  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese (local language), basic level of English is an added advantage
  • Education:  Undergraduate Degree in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience of working for events, and strong understanding of volunteer management 
  • Desirable experience in delivering volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including fit for purpose attraction, promotion, recruitment, training, engagement, and tournament operations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Knowledge of volunteer or workforce system an advantage
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, as well as with local networks within the Host City, especially among the football community.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented.
  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills
  • Experience in delivering workshops, volunteer briefings or training sessions
  • Enthusiasm, and the ability to inspire and motivate volunteers from diverse backgrounds
  • Ability to facilitate workshops, information sessions, and volunteer briefings
  • Knowledge of the local landscape, community networks, and key stakeholders within the respective Host City is an advantage.

job.title: Workforce Systems, Tools & Data Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Workforce Data & Systems Coordinator supports the effective day‑to‑day operation of workforce systems, data administration and reporting for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role helps ensure workforce data is accurate, consistent and timely, contributing to reliable planning, reporting and operational readiness. Working closely with the Workforce Data & Systems Manager and Workforce Planning team, the coordinator provides system, data and reporting support across workforce planning and operations, including preparation for test events and tournament delivery, helping to ensure systems and processes function smoothly throughout the event lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Workforce Systems & Workforce Systems Support


·       Support the day‑to‑day operation of workforce planning and workforce operations systems used across the tournament.


·       Assist with system configuration, user access management, testing and troubleshooting under the guidance of the Workforce Data & Systems Manager.


·       Act as a first point of contact for workforce system users, logging issues, resolving basic queries and escalating more complex system issues as required.


·       Support the setup and maintenance of workforce operations systems


 


Workforce Data Administration


·       Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date workforce data across multiple systems, ensuring consistency and completeness.


·       Conduct regular data checks, validation and cleansing in line with agreed data standards.


·       Support the coordination of workforce data inputs from planning, recruitment, HR, training and operations teams.


·       Assist with data reconciliation between systems to ensure alignment across workforce functions


 


Reporting & Dashboards


·       Produce routine workforce reports and extracts to support workforce planning and operational decision‑making.


·       Support the maintenance and updating of Power BI dashboards and other standard workforce reports.


·       Assist with ad‑hoc data requests, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of information.


·       Help prepare data inputs and visuals for leadership updates, meetings and operational briefings


 


Process & Documentation Support


·       Assist in documenting workforce processes, system workflows and user guidance.


·       Support the development and maintenance of workforce process maps across planning and operations activities.


·       Help identify basic process inefficiencies or data gaps and raise improvement opportunities with the manager


 


Workforce Operations Support


·       Provide system and data support for tournament‑time operations.


·       Assist with operational readiness checks to ensure systems and data are accurate ahead of key milestones.


·       Be available during operational periods to support issue resolution and rapid data updates.


·       Support the use and optimization of Excel-based planning tools (advanced formulas, dynamic dashboards, data validation)


 


Collaboration & Stakeholder Support


·       Work closely with the Workforce Planning team to ensure data and systems align with planning assumptions and deployment needs.


·       Liaise with other workforce functional teams to support consistent system usage and data inputs.


·       Support user training sessions, contribute to help materials and provide ongoing guidance to system users.


·       Operate in line with FIFA policies, data protection standards and tournament governance requirements


 


Continuous Improvement


·       Support testing activities, system enhancements and new functionality rollouts.


·       Capture issues, lessons learned and feedback from users to inform system and process improvements.

·       Contribute to knowledge sharing and handover documentation for future tournament delivery
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  •  Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Business
  • Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, HR or a related discipline.
  • Experience in a coordination, administration, systems support or data support role, ideally within workforce, HR, operations or event delivery environments.
  • Experience working with data, systems or reporting tools in a professional setting.
    Skills & Expertise
  • Practical experience using workforce systems, databases or operational platforms.
  • Working knowledge of reporting tools such as Power BI, Excel or similar data analysis tools.
  • Strong data accuracy, validation and attention‑to‑detail skills.

  • Ability to follow defined processes while supporting documentation and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence supporting system users.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with planning, operations and technical teams.
  • Willingness to learn new systems and adapt in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.
  • Comfortable supporting operational delivery during test events and tournament periods.

· Help identify basic process inefficiencies or data gaps and raise improvement opportunities with the manager
Workforce Operations Support
· Providesystem and data support for tournament‑time operations.
· Assist with operational readiness checks to ensure systems and data are accurate ahead of key milestones.
· Be available during operational periods to support issue resolution and rapid data updates.
· Support the use and optimization of Excel-based planning tools (advanced formulas, dynamic dashboards, data validation)
Collaboration & Stakeholder Support
· Workclosely with the Workforce Planning team to ensure data and systems align with planning assumptions and deployment needs.
· Liaise with other workforce functional teams to support consistent system usage and data inputs.
· Support user training sessions, contribute to help materials and provide ongoing guidance to system users.
· Operate in line with FIFA policies, data protection standards and tournament governance requirements

· Supporttesting activities, system enhancements and new functionality rollouts.
· Capture issues, lessons learned and feedback from users to inform system and process improvements.
· Contribute to knowledge sharing and handover documentation for future tournament delivery
- Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. - Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Business - Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, HR or a related discipline. - Experience in a coordination, administration, systems support or data support role, ideally within workforce, HR, operations or event delivery environments. - Experience working with data, systems or reporting tools in a professional setting. Skills & Expertise - Practical experience using workforce systems, databases or operational platforms. - Working knowledge of reporting tools such as Power BI, Excel or similar data analysis tools. - Strong data accuracy, validation and attention‑to‑detail skills. - Ability to follow defined processes while supporting documentation and continuous improvement. - Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence supporting system users. - Ability to work collaboratively with planning, operations and technical teams. - Willingness to learn new systems and adapt in a fast‑paced, evolving environment. - Comfortable supporting operational delivery during test events and tournament periods.

job.title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership 
  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.
Team Leadership
  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.
Major Ceremonies Oversight
  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.
Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management
  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.
Supplier & Budget Management
  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. 
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. 
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. 
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. 
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. 
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. 
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
Venue Readiness & Execution
  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.
Other Duties
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  •  Experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
