job.title: Fleet and Bus Service Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Fleet and Bus Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation Tournament fleet and for any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of bus services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams, providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, Media and Broadcast, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet and Bus Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing bus performance, developing, and ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all bus and minibuses related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the event bus and minibus suppliers, ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, KPIs, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of vehicles (e.g. buses), ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of fleet and buses post-tournament.
  • Act as the primary operational interface with cars, buses and minibuses and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met.
  • Manage all ancillary contracts, if any, and operational processes related to the bus and minibus services, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines.
  • Develop the fleet and bus services Operational plan and well as the Depot Concept of Operations (including the design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all vehicle Operations.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of service-related Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.
  • Manages day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers.
  • Setup of the bus timetables and any required information into Tournament Management System (TMM). Daily management and updates.
  • Ensure all FIFA and Supplier staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities.
  • It’s also responsible, in coordination with the bus and minibus service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. 
  • During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to PMA services, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams.
  • Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, Media, Broadcast, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters.
Qualifications:
Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.

Experience:
  • Strong transport and fleet or bus services experience in international major events in at least two (2) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. 
  • Strong management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.
Skills:
  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management. 
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.  
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Proven solution orientated decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Safety & Security Planning Coordinator supports the Senior Manager, Safety & Security Planning and Operations in the delivery of integrated planning, coordination and operational readiness activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
The role provides structured project coordination, administrative and communication support across the Safety & Security department, acting as a central point for task tracking, documentation management and inter-functional communication. The position ensures that planning processes are organised, documented and delivered to a high professional standard in both Portuguese and English.
The Coordinator contributes to departmental efficiency, consistency and quality by preparing high-standard materials, tracking central deliverables and supporting cross-functional collaboration throughout all phases of the tournament.

• Support the Senior Manager in coordinating the integrated operational planning process across stadiums, non-competition sites and ancillary events
• Act as a central coordination point for planning-related tasks within the Safety & Security department
• Track central task completion, deadlines and deliverables across workstreams, ensuring visibility and timely follow-up
• Support communication between the Safety & Security function and other FIFA functional areas
• Prepare, coordinate and document planning meetings, including agenda preparation, minute-taking and follow-up action tracking
• Draft and format planning documents, reports, presentations and briefing materials in both Portuguese and English
• Provide small translation tasks as required to ensure clarity and consistency across bilingual documentation and/or in meetings
• Prepare high-quality materials in Word, Excel and PowerPoint to support senior management and departmental reporting
• Maintain structured documentation control, version management and file organisation across planning workstreams
• Provide general administrative support to the Senior Manager and the wider Safety & Security department
• Support preparation of operational frameworks, planning matrices and readiness tracking tools
• Assist in the preparation of procurement documentation, scopes of work and planning summaries where required
• Contribute to the consolidation of information for reporting to senior leadership and external stakeholders
• Provide flexible support to other Safety & Security workstreams as required during peak planning and operational phases

Education
• Higher education in project management, business administration, security management or a related field
• Certification or training in project coordination, administration or a security-relevant field is desirable

Experience
• Experience in project coordination, planning support or administrative roles within complex operational environments; alternatively comparable experience in a security-relevant field
• Experience supporting multi-stakeholder planning processes
• Experience preparing professional documentation and presentations for senior management
• Experience working in bilingual (Portuguese–English) environments is highly desirable

Certifications & Requirements:

• Right to work in Brazil. 
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)
• Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Guest Relations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Relations Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of Guest Relations activities for VVIP/VIP and other FIFA guest groups at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role focuses on guest account management (including invitation, registration, and communication), as well as the coordination of end-to-end guest journeys and liaison with key stakeholders.

Under the guidance of the FIFA Guest Relations Lead, the role ensures the implementation of the Guest Relations strategy, maintaining high service standards, efficient processes, and seamless communication across all guest touchpoints.

The Guest Relations Manager acts as a key point of reference for guest management operations and supports the training and coordination of service providers and workforce in the respective areas.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and coordinate Guest Relations activities across all guest groups, ensuring alignment with service levels and event objectives.
  • Define and manage VVIP/VIP account management processes, including invitation, registration, communication, and quota management.
  • Liaise with stakeholders on guest invitation concepts, guest lists, and quota definitions, including coordination with offices and embassies of international and local authorities.
  • Map and oversee end-to-end guest journeys, ensuring high service standards across all touchpoints and efficient resolution of guest issues.
  • Oversee guest requests and bookings (e.g. program attendance, ticketing, travel, accommodation, transport), including structured change management processes.
  • Oversee ticketing-related guest processes and ensure consistency and efficiency in guest request handling.
  • Define and implement guest communication and liaison strategies, ensuring streamlined communication flows across all channels.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Zurich and relevant departments to ensure an integrated Guest Relations approach and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish and maintain clear communication lines with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop policies, guidelines, and protocol requirements for VVIP/VIP guests and other dignitaries.
  • Coordinate the management of guest-related IT systems and applications in alignment with FIFA Guest Relations.
  • Manage resources and support workforce planning for Guest Relations activities.
  • Ensure project delivery within defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards, including reporting and issue resolution.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for service providers, workforce, and volunteers.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Communications & Marketing, International Relations, Business Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Specialization in protocol, event management, or international relations is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Extensive experience in guest relations and guest management, including exposure to protocol environments and structured guest handling processes.
  • Experience in planning, coordinating, and delivering guest services in a professional or event-based environment.
  • On-site event experience in guest relations, protocol, or VVIP/VIP service delivery.
  • Experience in managing guest accounts, invitations, registrations, and communication processes is an advantage.
  • Experience in coordinating with high-level stakeholders (e.g. government representatives, embassies, international organizations) is an asset.
  • Ideally experience within a sport/event organisation or large-scale international project, preferably in a world-class event environment.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • High level of diplomacy and ability to handle sensitive VVIP/VIP interactions.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven problem-solving skills and ability to operate in dynamic environments.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to deliver under pressure.
  • Solid understanding of guest management processes and operational coordination.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with planning tools is an asset.
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification (e.g. PMI) or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications in hospitality, event management, or protocol are a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Partnership Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day-to-day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and on-budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA-related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third-party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution-oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.
  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • Experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in or with international organizations and global brands
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market and local executional landscape is a strong asset
  • Client-oriented with strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Efficient and effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to define priorities, lead projects independently, and provide direction to junior team members when required
  • Team-oriented, service-minded, and collaborative across functions
  • Strategic and creative problem-solver with a hands-on mindset
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Fan Festival
job.html_description:
FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). 


The Event Experiences Marketing Manager (FFF) supports and implements all strategic deliverables prescribed by the Experiential Marketing Manager (FFF) based in Zurich. This includes developing, supporting, and delivering innovative and best-in-class FFF deliverables and other experiential marketing activations that might be developed. The core deliverable is to lead the strategic and commercial development and positioning of the FIFA Fan Festival™ across Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, focusing on the commercial, promotional, brand, entertainment, and partner and stakeholder integrations. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the manager will help shape the narrative, drive partner and government integration, and develop innovative fan engagement in line with FIFA’s strategic objectives from a local perspective.

This role and team will work in tandem with the Special Events team at FIFA27, who hold accountabilities for all operational elements of the FFF. However, on a day‑to‑day basis, the Strategy and Operations teams will operate and be perceived as one unified team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Commercial & Strategy
  • Support the development and implementation of the FIFA Fan Festival™ commercial and strategic framework. 
  • Support communications and promotional planning across Host Cities. 
  • Liaise with commercial and media partners (alongside the local Commercial and Media partnership teams) to support project alignment and approvals. 
  • Prepare workshop planning, presentations, and strategic alignment sessions.
  • Maintain all SharePoint documentation and ensure excellent level of project document management 
  • Lead on local conversations and meetings while delivering detailed meetings and project updates including meeting minutes and communications for reporting back to the team in Zurich.
  • Support budget tracking, procurement processes, and relevant strategic documentation. 
  • Support local issue resolution and escalation processes, ensuring key decisions, risks and dependencies are clearly communicated to the Zurich team.
  • Support the review of plans and materials to ensure alignment with FIFA commercial rights, partner obligations, and clean site principles.
  • Provide local market insights and stakeholder contexts to support strategic decision making, planning, and delivery when needed.
FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Host City Coordination
  • Support Host Cities throughout all strategy and commercial processes. 
  • Act as a key point of contact for Host Cities at local level and any other local stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate requests, tracking, review and adaptation of Host City deliverables, including promotional copy, brand assets, content inputs and local information. 
  • Review and adapt Host City content, copy and materials to ensure consistency with FIFA tone, messaging, objectives and standards. 
  • Develop a strong understanding of the FWWC27 brand manual and ensure Host City and stakeholder materials are reviewed in line with FIFA brand requirements. 
  • Coordinate feedback, brand approvals, and final sign-off with relevant internal FIFA teams. Or communicate with FIFA Zurich where necessary.
  • Support the local Special Events team to ensure FIFA Fan Festival™ strategic, commercial, promotional and brand requirements are understood and integrated into Host City planning and delivery.
  • Support the coordination of content capture 
  • Delivery of local reporting inputs and post event documentation for FIFA27 and Host Cities and relevant stakeholders.  Experiential Projects
  • Act as project manager for selected experiential marketing projects as required. 
  • Coordinate project planning, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, and execution. 
  • Support RFP processes, agency evaluation, supplier onboarding, and procurement processes when required. 
  • Manage day-to-day coordination with agencies and suppliers, ensuring clear briefs, timelines, feedback rounds, and delivery expectations. 
  • Maintain all project documentation, trackers, meeting notes, action lists, and approval records. 
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and in line with FIFA standards and identify, track and communicate key project risks, dependencies, decisions and escalation points.
  • Support post-project reporting, learnings and evaluation, including documentation of outcomes, performance and recommendations.
  • Experience in marketing, event management, or relevant client account management
  • Proven relevant experience in similar position or another relevant role 
  • Experience working in a multi-national, multi-cultural, and multi-stakeholder environment 
  • Appreciation and understanding or sport and the role it plays in marketing, fan engagement and popular culture
  • University degree in a marketing discipline, or business administration with major in a relevant field (desired)
  • Proficient in Office 365 
  • Excellent knowledge of MS Teams, SharePoint/One Drive, Monday.com 
  • Flexible, adaptable, proactive, attention to detail, and constantly striving for excellence 
  • Multi-tasker with excellent organizational skills and time/priority management 
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills 
  • Stress resilient and able to work to immovable deadlines 
  • Excellent stakeholder and network management skills, including understanding and awareness of cultural nuances and communication needs for different stakeholders 
  • Comprehensive understanding of entertainment, major events and fan entertainment understanding 
  • Diplomatic and comfortable handling conflicts in a positive and objective manner 
  • Team Player and Adaptability with strong teamwork abilities and willing to go the extra mile
Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Entertainment Technical Integration Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role ensures the seamless technical implementation of all entertainment elements, including in-stadium entertainment activations, audio-visual systems, show control, and content playback, IBCCC integration, venue technology interfaces, Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre-Match Ceremonies (PMC), Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), and other ceremonial moments.

The role leads the coordination and integration of technical requirements across all entertainment environments, ensuring alignment between FIFA, host venues, the IBCC, production partners, technical suppliers, broadcast stakeholders, and operational teams.

The Entertainment Technical Integration Manager is responsible for translating creative and operational concepts into executable technical solutions, ensuring that all entertainment and ceremonial elements are delivered safely, consistently, and to the highest standard across the tournament.

The role supports the development, implementation, testing, and execution of integrated entertainment systems and operational processes.
The position oversees technical planning timelines, manages supplier coordination, facilitates cross-functional technical reviews, and ensures readiness across all competition and ceremony venues.
 
The Entertainment Technical Integration Manager serves as the primary focal point for entertainment-related technical integration, providing centralized coordination and governance from the planning phase through tournament delivery.

The role requires an experienced live events professional with strong technical production and project management expertise, capable of managing complex stakeholder environments and delivering world-class entertainment experiences across stadiums, ceremonies, and IBCC operations on the global stage of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
 
Key Responsibilities

Technical Integration & Delivery
  • Lead the technical planning, integration, and readiness of all Stadium Entertainment, Ceremonies, and Entertainment IBCCC operations across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s operational, technical, and creative objectives. 
  • Ensure the successful implementation of the FIFA-approved Stadium Entertainment and Ceremonies Concepts from a technical and operational perspective. 
  • Coordinate the integration of audio, video, lighting, LED systems, show control, communications infrastructure, content distribution platforms, graphics systems, and venue technology interfaces required to support entertainment and ceremonial delivery.
  • Act as the primary technical integration point of contact between the Entertainment Department, Broadcast, Technology, venue teams, ceremony production partners, and technical suppliers.
  • Ensure consistency, technical quality, and operational readiness across all tournament venues, ceremony locations, and centralized Entertainment operations.
Team Support 
  • Support the Entertainment Team through technical coordination, planning, and readiness activities across Stadium Entertainment, Ceremonies, and Special Events.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to internal teams, freelancers, suppliers, and project stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery standards and best practices. Foster strong collaboration between Entertainment, Technology, Broadcast, IBCC, Venue Operations, and other Functional Areas throughout the project lifecycle. Support alignment between venue-based technical teams and central project teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards across all competition and ceremony venues.
Technical Planning & Production Coordination
  • Create and manage the overall Technical Production Schedule for Stadium Entertainment, Ceremonies, IBCC Operations, ensuring alignment with tournament milestones and delivery requirements.  
  • Develop and maintain technical integration plans, readiness trackers, installation schedules, testing plans, and operational documentation.
  • Coordinate technical surveys, venue assessments, production walkthroughs, rehearsals, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness activities across all venues and project sites.
  • Coordinate rehearsals, technical run-throughs, systems testing, and operational readiness exercises to validate delivery requirements before live operations.
  • Ensure all technical requirements are accurately captured within production schedules, venue operational plans, and technical documentation.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and operational challenges, ensuring appropriate mitigation and contingency planning measures are in place.
IBCC Integration & Operations
  • Lead the planning, setup, technical integration, and readiness of all Entertainment-related facilities, systems, and services within the IBCC.
  • Create and manage the IBCC Technical Production Schedule and ensure alignment with Stadium Entertainment and Ceremonies delivery requirements.
  • Develop and manage the stadium-to-IBCC integration plan, ensuring seamless connectivity between venue systems, centralized operations, communications infrastructure, content distribution platforms, and operational workflows.
  • Manage the technical relationship with Host Broadcast Services (HBS), IBCC overlay providers, venue stakeholders, and key technical suppliers.
  • Ensure seamless distribution of entertainment content, graphics, show-control cues, and operational data from the IBCC to stadium systems, while maintaining reliable two-way communication and monitoring between the IBCC and all tournament venues.
  • Oversee the integration of content distribution networks, communications systems, graphics platforms, show-control solutions, AE Live services, and other third-party systems supporting Entertainment delivery. Coordinate IBCC FF&E requirements, TEAP requirements, BIM360 updates, technical documentation, and readiness reporting to ensure tournament-wide technical preparedness. 
Venue, Ceremonies & Special Events Readiness
  • Lead stadium technical installation and readiness activities, ensuring all Entertainment infrastructure is delivered, tested, and commissioned in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Lead IBCC technical installation and readiness activities, coordinating delivery partners, suppliers, and technical stakeholders.
  • Support the technical planning and readiness of all Ceremonies, including Opening Ceremonies, Closing Ceremonies, Medal Ceremonies, Pre-Match Ceremonies (PMC), and other official FIFA ceremonial events. Support the technical planning and delivery requirements of FIFA Special Events, including tournament draws and other major FIFA events, ensuring alignment with Entertainment technical standards and operational requirement.
 Content & Systems Management
  • Coordinate the collection and validation of venue technical specifications, including giant screen, LED ribbon, control room, playback, and presentation system capabilities, ensuring all requirements are available for content production and delivery planning.
  • Define and communicate technical content specifications, formats, resolutions, workflows, and delivery requirements to content producers, ensuring compatibility across all stadium and ceremony presentation systems.
  • Review and validate stadium technical overlay designs, control room infrastructure, and presentation system configurations to ensure all Stadium Entertainment and Ceremonies content can be successfully delivered and operated.
  • Coordinate the integration, testing, and readiness of content playback, graphics, show-control, and presentation systems across stadiums, ceremonies, and IBCC operations.
  • Work closely with Technology, venue operators, and technical suppliers to ensure all content delivery workflows, system interfaces, monitoring tools, and operational processes are fully implemented, tested, and operational prior to tournament delivery.
  • Ensure documentation, technical specifications, system inventories, and content delivery requirements remain accurate and up to date throughout the project lifecycle.  
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
  • Prepare match-day reports, schedules, show notes and post-event summaries for the Head of Entertainment.
  • Maintain up-to-date operational documentation.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions.
  • Flag operational risks and escalate issues to the Head of Entertainment in a timely manner.
Supplier & Budget Management
  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Head of Entertainment, including supplier briefing and evaluation. ·        Manage day-to-day relationships with technical suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalate risks to the Head of Entertainment as needed.  
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
  • Coordinate closely with Technology, Broadcast, Venue Operations and other Functional Areas to ensure seamless project integration. 
  • Act as the central coordination point for technical requirements impacting Stadium Entertainment, Ceremonies, IBCC Operations, and Special Events.
  • Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.  
Other Duties
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management in support of tournament and event delivery objectives.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Managers in technical planning, operational readiness, project delivery, and tournament-wide integration activities.
  • Contribute to the successful delivery of world-class entertainment, ceremony, and special event experiences across FIFA competitions and events.
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  • 5+ years’ experience in technical production, systems integration, and live event delivery, ideally within major international sporting events, ceremonies, entertainment productions, or large-scale public events.
  • Proven experience planning and delivering stadium technical infrastructure, venue technical overlay, content presentation systems, and IBCC operations across complex event environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing technical production schedules, installation programmes, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness activities across multiple venues and stakeholders.
  • Strong track record of managing technical suppliers, system integrators, Host Broadcasters, venue operators, and production partners in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting the technical planning and delivery of stadium entertainment, ceremonies, special events, and multi-venue tournament operations, including content delivery systems, control room environments, and venue technology integration.
Skills & Competencies
  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including presentations, RFPs, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

This role is 20hrs per week.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable
  • Organised and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends.
  • Full Driving License
  • Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
 
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit.
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use.
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management.
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required.
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas.
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.

job.title: u21 Head Coach
job.html_description:
The U21 Head Coach plays a pivotal role in delivering the Academy's player development strategy, creating a high performance environment that prepares young players for the demands of professional football. Responsible for leading the U21 programme, the role focuses on maximising the development and progression of players, supporting their transition into the senior game, and ensuring alignment between the Academy and First Team. Working collaboratively across departments, the postholder will contribute to the continuous evolution of the Academy's technical and performance programmes, helping to create a seamless pathway for emerging talent.

Responsibilities

The u21 Head Coach must: 

Experience
•  Experience working with Professional Development Phase (u18-u21) aged players. 
•  Experience of successfully holding a leadership role or position within a Club or organisation. 
•  Experience of successfully supporting the development of people

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications
•  To hold appropriate and up to date qualifications to conform to PL Academy Licence requirements. 
•  UEFA A License (FA Level 4 qualification). 
•  FA Advanced Youth Award (FA Level 4 qualification). 
•  Broad awareness of the football industry and governing policies. 
•  An understanding of player development principles or applied knowledge from across other sports, countries and/or clubs

Personal Qualities
•  To ensure the highest levels of professionalism in organisation, delivery and conduct. 
•  To demonstrate an engaging personality that naturally supports the learning and education of players and staff. 
•  To demonstrate growth mindset. 
•  To be Player or Person-Centred in the approach to development. 
•  To show diligence towards all aspects of the role. 
•  To have an outstanding work ethic. 
•  To actively demonstrate humility and vulnerability within the working environment.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
 
Coaching
  • Establish and continually refine the Season Plan for the u21 age group, shaping the player development programme in line with individual player and group needs. 
  • Lead coaching sessions across the u21 age group which align and integrate Season Plan commitments & players Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) to wider Academy and Club approaches and Values.
  • Create and sustain an elite learning environment that appropriately balances challenge and support, empowering players to take ownership of their development and become independent decision-makers.
  • Manage the u21 Games Programme in line with the Season Plan to ensure teams and players compete and develop appropriately through these experiences. 
  • Ensure all training and match experiences are purposefully designed to accelerate individual player development whilst maintaining alignment with the Academy Performance Plan and Club playing philosophy.
  • Lead weekly u21 Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) meetings to shape and guide player development while ensuring the highest quality operations and organisation of resource. 
  • Integrate and connect the u21 group to both the u18 and First Team programmes. 
  • Maintain close alignment with First Team staff to ensure shared coaching language, tactical principles, behavioural expectations and physical demands that facilitate seamless player transition.
  • Support the u21 MDT (including u21 Assistant Coach) to integrate player development across disciplines. 
  • Plan, upload/record and reflect systematically on all coaching activity within the u21 age group. 
  • Support the delivery of u16 & u18 training and games programme to share ideas and approaches across the department, contribute to effective succession planning, and cover coaching colleagues as required.
  • Continually evaluate and innovate coaching practice by integrating current research, emerging methodologies and reflective practice to enhance player and programme development.
 
Player & Programme Management 
  • Develop and sustain frequent, consistent and supportive communication with all players, and where appropriate their families and other stakeholders, to support transitions into Professional Football. 
  • Oversee the implementation of the Academy Code of Expectations for all u21s players and staff.
  • Oversee the implementation of all Club policies that relate to the U21s programme. 
  • Lead all u21 player reviews, iteratively contributing to an on-going, continuous process of support for the u21 age group. 
  • Drive individual player acceleration through bespoke development planning, ensuring each player is appropriately challenged and supported in pursuit of First Team and professional football opportunities.
  • Manage the completion of ILPs for all u21 players in collaboration with other disciplines and stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary contributions to ensure each player's development programme is integrated, evidence-informed and aligned to individual needs.
  • Manage on-going reflection processes (of players and staff) in a way that contributes to on-going learning and development. 
  • Work with the Talent Identification and Recruitment team to provide suitable feedback to any players that trial with the u21s. 
  • Be an available point of contact for First Team colleagues, ensuring there is appropriate and regular connections on u21 players and the u21 programme. 
  • Provide informed recommendations regarding player progression, First Team integration, external loan opportunities and succession planning through regular collaboration with Academy and First Team staff.
  • Player a key role in the Succession Planning processes within the Academy to support the Club to retain individuals who have First Team potential.
  • Foster an elite performance culture that promotes accountability, professionalism, resilience and behaviours consistent with the Club's Values and Code of Expectations.
  • Attendance at First Team games as required.
 
Insights (in collaboration with the Insights department)
  • Align video to team and individual commitments, supporting team and individual player development over time. 
  • Manage all reporting systems to ensure accurate information is captured in relation to player performance. 
  • Ensure all players are provided with regular access to their personal performance data highlighting key metrics in line with the Academy Technical Plan. 
  • Utilise objective performance data, video analysis and observational insights to evaluate programme effectiveness, inform coaching interventions and support evidence-based decision making.
  • Support the development and integration of Insights staff within the u21 MDT. 
 
Leadership & Collaboration
  • Lead, support and positively influence the wider Academy coaching team through collaboration, mentoring and the sharing of best practice across the Professional Development Phase.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with all Academy departments to ensure a connected, player-centred and high-performing multidisciplinary environment.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Academy Technical Plan by identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation across the programme.
  • Act as an ambassador for Fulham Football Club, consistently demonstrating the Club's Values of being Pioneers, Confident Custodians, Action Orientated, Open & Inclusive and committed to Service Excellence.

Benefits

The closing date for applications is Friday 14th August.

Leadership & Collaboration
- Lead, support and positively influence the wider Academy coaching team through collaboration, mentoring and the sharing of best practice across the Professional Development Phase. - Build and maintain effective relationships with all Academy departments to ensure a connected, player-centred and high-performing multidisciplinary environment. - Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Academy Technical Plan by identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation across the programme. - Act as an ambassador for Fulham Football Club, consistently demonstrating the Club's Values of being Pioneers, Confident Custodians, Action Orientated, Open & Inclusive and committed to Service Excellence.
Benefits
The closing date for applications is Friday 14th August.

job.title: Pre-Academy & Development Centre Head Coach (Slough)
job.html_description:
1. To lead on the development of all talent and support Recruitment Managers by providing insight on player progress
  2. To lead on the organisation, management and setup of practices at your relevant centre 

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
  • To ensure the high quality co-ordination and smooth operational running of the session you lead at your respective Pre-Academy or development centre session.
 
  • To ensure the deployment of appropriate football & sports coaches onto sessions. 
 
  • To collaborate effectively with the relevant Recruitment Manager manager to ensure a safe and fun programme for our young players.

  • Experience working with Microsoft Office
  • Hold a UEFA C License/FA Level 2 Coaching in Football

  • Have worked in a Pre-Academy or Academy Development Centre

job.title: Security Officer - Day
job.html_description:
To be responsible and protect the Clubs assets, security of the grounds, its contents & the safety of staff and visitors across all Fulham Football Club & Fulham Pier premises.

Requirements

• To open and secure the premises at the correct times and in the correct manner.

• To be fully conversant with the intruder and fire alarm systems and to report any problems that may arise with these systems.

• To carry out regular & varied patrols of the grounds to deter theft, anti-social behaviour and to detect fire.

• To record all incidents and tasks undertaken during every shift. These entries will be made in the security Daily Occurrence Book.

• To report any matter having a bearing on the safety of the club and its staff and visitors.

• To inform the Security Manager of any incident this may involve dishonesty or when Company rules and regulations have been broken. 

• To carry out investigation as directed by the Security Manager involving cash, stock and property of the club and the personal effects of the staff.

• To conduct bag and vehicle searches on staff and contractors as directed by the Security Manager.

• To keep, the confidentiality of any matter concerning the club and Security department.

• To maintain a good working relationship with the staff and managers and encourage a high standard of Security.

• To maintain a smart appearance and to act in a courteous and professional manner when dealing with members of the public and staff.

• To issue keys from the security office and to record the issue and receiving of those keys in the appropriate register, reporting any missing keys or damaged locks.

• To record lost property in the lost property, register and to update the register when required.

• To ensure that all visitors are recorded in the Visitors Register, for the purpose of maintaining accurate records.

• To be fully conversant with the operation of CCTV, Access Control and Two way radio systems used by the Club.

• To be fully conversant with the Company rules and regulations, health and Safety at work and the Fire and Emergency procedures and ensure accurate logs of these are kept.

• To ensure accurate goods inwards records are kept.

• Other ad hoc duties as required by the business.

job.title: Female Football Coach (Casual)
job.plain_text_description:
Fulham FC Foundation are currently seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and committed person to take up the casual position of a Female Football Coach.
Reporting directly to our Operations Officers the Female Football Coach will be responsible for managing a number of female teams at one of the foundations partner schools. This role would involve both the management of these teams, as well as providing high-quality, team-based training sessions throughout the week. You will also be responsible for overseeing any fixtures these team have across the season. This is a casual role where flexibility is essential, as the delivery of training sessions and fixtures changes across the school term.
The successful candidate will be somebody who has prior experience managing a female team, and holds at least a UEFA C License qualification. Due to the requirements stipulated by the school, the successful candidate will be a female coach with relatable experience to their players allowing them to be a positive role model to them.
Although this role is casual, with the hours varying across the season, meaning that there is no set timetable. There are some key times when training sessions and fixtures are likely to happen. Therefore, the ideal candidate will have good availability during the afternoons of the working week. The ideal availability will be:
Monday – Friday from 2pm to 6pm
There will also be opportunity to work across other foundation programmes such as our ‘Player Development Centres’ and ‘Girls Development Centres’ should the successful candidate want to.
Whilst there is no obligation for Fulham FC Foundation to provide, or for the Female Football Coaches to accept, work. Female Football Coaches who do not work for an extended period of time (3 months), may no longer be offered work.
Salary: £16.50 p/h
Next steps:
The closing date for this role is the 30th of June, however applications will be reviewed consistently so any appropriate candidate may be interviewed before this date.
If successful, you will join a vibrant team who are passionate about achieving the organisation's vision of “an active healthy, inclusive and thriving community”, and you’ll have the opportunity to build on your existing skills through a variety of training and development opportunities and experiences. This role will also play a role in supporting the Foundation’s Women’s and Girls Strategy to develop and support opportunities for underrepresented groups.
*This job description should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive. It is intended as an outline indication of areas of activity and responsibility and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation.
Responsibilities
- To act as an Ambassador for Fulham FC Foundation (FFCF), representing the organisation professionally in line with its values.
- To design and deliver high quality, team training sessions to the teams you’ll be working with.
- To manage the teams during both home and away fixtures, including all the team admin that does along with managing the team.
- To provide high-quality, individualised feedback to each of the players in your teams to support their footballing development.
- To be a positive role model to the student athletes, helping both motivate and support them with their football, and education.
- To identify and support progression pathways for talented young people.
- To provide a safe, positive and inclusive learning environment at all times,
- To adhere to FFCF’s safeguarding policies and procedures, ensuring the timely reporting of any safeguarding concerns or incidents within sessions.
Requirements
Essential:
Experience:
- Experience of delivering high quality training sessions to female footballers. - Experience of running a 9 or 11 aside female football team. - Experience of working with others as part of a coaching team. - Has a driving license and/or is willing to travel independently.
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Excellent verbal communication skills. - Excellent knowledge of Women’s Football. - Excellent knowledge of the pathway opportunities for female players. - First Aid, Safeguarding and DBS qualification. - A UEFA C Coaching Qualification, or currently undertaking and due to complete this year. - Base knowledge of and willingness to learn & contribute towards FFCF strategic aims.
Personal Qualities:
- A positive role-model for children & young people. - Ability to travel independently across Surrey and South-West London, including transport of equipment. - Well presented, with a professional manner. - Positive, energetic persona. Able to build rapport with participants. - Excellent time-keeping & punctuality. - Willingness to learn & develop personally & professionally.
Preferred:
Experience:
- Experience of delivering football sessions in a secondary school - Experience of working with high performing footballers. - Experience of leading a local female grassroots team
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Additional football qualifications such as Goalkeeping, S&C, or Fitness. - Knowledge and links to local grassroots football teams. - UEFA B License (or willing to work towards)

job.title: Academy Lead Analyst
job.html_description:
Support the implementation of the Academy Vision, Mission and Objectives through the delivery of analysis work with the Professional Development Phase. This role will provide analysis leadership within the Insights department as well as lead the analysis provision for the U18 age group. This role will support the overarching age group objectives and commitments to player development in collaboration with the wider multi-disciplinary team. Furthermore, the role will lead the creation of bespoke, streamlined data systems and effective workflows to ensure the delivery of the Insights department strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
• Lead the creation and dissemination of analysis workflows throughout the Insights department ensuring these are appropriately aligned and scaffolded across phases and age groups.
• Manage analysis students through effective and robust recruitment, induction and appraisal processes.
• Manage hardware and software equipment to ensure the Insights staff effectively function and deliver on department objectives.
• Support the tracking of key results to ensure Insights strategic objectives are met.
• Lead weekly department meetings and contribute to monthly knowledge share events.
• Be an active member of the U18s multi-disciplinary team developing, monitoring, and reviewing both team and individual KPI's across the season.
• Support the broad player development processes with the U18 MDT to ensure a tailored individual approach.
• Ensure 'best practice' is used throughout the Academy with specific regards to the capturing, coding, and visualisation of video and data.
• Support the U18 MDT with timely and appropriate presentations / reports to support ongoing and iterative reflections of player performance.
• Contribute to our student learning programme by providing support to staff around coding and presenting of video content.
• Undertake continued professional development and be able to present learnings back to the Insights teams and/or U18 MDT.
• Support the highest levels of safeguarding.

Requirements

The Lead Analyst must:
• Have 2+ years’ experience working as an analyst (or similar title) in elite sport.
• Have experience in the effective management and use of data to measure player development.
• Understand the demands and processes within an elite football environment.
• Be competent in using Apple Mac Products and Microsoft Office.
• Have experience in designing analytical workflows to support pre-match, live and post-match analysis in elite sport.
• Be highly skilled in the use of SportsCode, Hudl Insight, and Power Bi.
• Be highly skilled at communicating and presenting to coaches and players using a combination of video and data.
• Have high levels of empathy and care for young people and their development.
• Be diligent with and excellent eye for detail.
• Possess good emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
• Hold a UEFA C Coaching Qualification.

Ideally, Lead Analyst will: 
• Have experience in conducting case study research to support individual development plans. 
• Have experience of managing iterative processes within a multi-disciplinary team. 
• Hold a UEFA B Coaching Qualification. 
• Hold an operator ID with the Drone and Model Aircraft Registration Team, CAA. 
• Be creative when implementing strategies for process improvement. 
• Have a curious nature when it comes to the evolution of football insights, 
• Hold a FA Safeguarding qualification. 
• Be FA First Aid Qualified.

Benefits

Applications close 18th August

job.title: Host Family
job.html_description:
Are you passionate about football and looking for a unique opportunity to make a difference in the lives of young athletes, aged 15-21?


Fulham FC is seeking warm and welcoming host families to provide a safe and supportive home environment to support our Academy players who will be required to live away from home to fulfil their education and football training at our club.


As a host parent, you will play an essential role in helping our players thrive both on and off the pitch. You'll provide a comfortable living space, home-cooked meals, emotional support and help them to adjust to life away from home as they focus on their training and academic pursuits.


What we are looking for:
  • A friendly, caring family or individual with a spare room
  • A willingness to provide support, guidance, and encouragement to our young players
  • A safe and welcoming home environment
  • Support our young people by teaching them basic independent living and self-care skills such as washing, cooking and cleaning up after themselves.
  • Providing meals in line with nutritional guidance from the Academy.
  • Accommodation has access to public and local amenities with good transport links to the Academy training ground.
  • Report any welfare concerns to the Academy Safeguarding and Player Care team should they occur.
  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with.
  • The club will regularly inspect and visit the placement during the season.
  • The club will provide further guidance to host families, young people and their parents explaining what would be expected of them.

In order to be considered for this position you must live within 30 minutes travel for the player from the training ground.

Fulham Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and young people and expects host families to share this commitment. As such, the host family provider will be subject to an Enhanced Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) check and risk assessments prior to a placement commencing.


Any other person over the age of 18, who resides in the household or has regular contact with the player will be required to complete an enhanced DBS. Host Families will be required to attend safeguarding training and workshops arranged by the Academy.


We are committed to supporting an environment where all staff have a personal responsibility to uphold the Club’s Equal Opportunities Policy by treating fellow employees, prospective employees, casual workers, prospective casual workers, players, prospective players and customers fairly and impartially.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer - Electrician
job.html_description:
We are looking for an experienced Electrician to provide a comprehensive high standard of Maintenance support to the Club and proactively identify areas for improvement and develop and implement solutions.

Responsibilities

The Maintenance Engineer – Electrician must: 
  • Experience of electrical installation within a large commercial environment 
  • NVQ level 1, 2, 3 in Electrical Installation
  • 18th Edition

Ideally, Maintenance Engineer – Electrician will: 
  • Experience in previous Maintenance roles
  • Experience using Planned Maintenance software 
  • Full Driving Licence
  • PAT testing experience
  • Proven ability to work unsupervised and as part of a team
  • Proactive
  • Organised
  • Flexible Attitude
  • Team Player 

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
  • To carry out electrical work, both reactive and planned maintenance
  • To carry out general day to day maintenance duties, which will sometimes be on very tight deadlines and to a high-level finish
  • General planned maintenance is divided between the team dependant on site coverage
  • Site electrical installations and upgrade works
  • Assist in ad-hoc projects where required
  • Matchday preparation carried out 24-72hrs prior to each game
  • Matchday & Event cover along with other team members
  • To ensure that all work is carried out in a safe manner and within relevant Health and Safety Guidelines
  • Covering Events where required 

Benefits

Applications close on 21st August.

job.title: Football & Sports Coach - Development Centres
job.html_description:
To deliver high quality football coaching sessions to accomplished & aspiring grassroots players aged 6 to 16.

To deliver football & sports sessions across the wider Foundation to a range of children, young people and adults.


Responsibilities

  • To act as an Ambassador for FFCF and maintain and develop relationships to ensure high quality experiences for young people, partner organisations, other staff and customers

  • To effectively plan and deliver high quality football sessions in-line with coaching syllabus, philosophy and values

  • To effectively support the development of individual players through the creation of individual development plans throughout the season

  • To identify and support the development of progression pathways for talented young people

  • To effectively plan and deliver extra-curricular and community activities across the wider Foundation

  • To support the transition between school-based activities, wider Foundation activities and where appropriate, other community activities

  • Assist in data collection and completion of monitoring for reports on an ongoing basis, within the timescales required

  • To work closely with Football Development Officer's to understand programme standards and attendance targets and support the promotion of FFCF activities

  • To support the smooth function of the Operations Department in line with the Foundation values and targets and work across programmes, when required

Requirements

Essential:

Experience:
  • Leading football sessions to age groups U7 to U16
  • Delivery of extracurricular and community activities to all age groups
  • Supporting and developing coaches in a sports environment
  • Working with external partners to achieve successful outcome
  • Monitoring and Evaluation 
  • Marketing and promotion

Skills, knowledge & qualifications:
  • Minimum of UEFA C qualification in Coaching Football
  • FA First Aid - in date
  • FA Safeguarding - in date
  • Ability to drive, has access to a car or ability to travel independently

Personal qualities:
  • Committed and motivated by the purpose of the Foundation 
  • Demonstrates respect for colleagues, partners and customers and when possible operates above and beyond expectations
  • Well presented with a good manner
  • Excellent punctuality
  • Ability to prioritise work and consistently meet deadlines
  • Effective communicator
  • Cheerful positive attitude

Preferred:

Experience:
  • Delivery in a Club Community Organisation (CCO)
  • Delivery of activiry to young people with a Disability. 
  • Delivery of CPD events to coaches.
  • Delivery of Physical Education lessons to primary age children

Skills, knowledge ​& qualifications:
  • UEFA B qualification
  • Non-football NGB sports qualifications
  • Mentoring qualification
  • Talent Identification qualification
  • Understanding of Physical Education standards in schools (Ofsted guidance)

job.title: Lewisham Advanced Centre Coach
job.html_description:
Join our team at the Lewisham Advanced Centre and play a key role in shaping the next generation of talent. Working closely alongside the Head Coach and a dedicated team of coaches, you will contribute to the development, support, and progression of players in a dynamic and professional environment.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact, delivering high-quality coaching, fostering player growth, and creating a positive, high-performance culture.

As a representative of Fulham FC, you will be expected to consistently uphold and embody the club’s core values in everything you do, both on and off the pitch.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Deliver high-quality coaching and player development across both the Lewisham Advanced Centre and Motspur Park, ensuring every session meets the highest professional standards.
  • Work collaboratively with the Head Coach, Pre-Academy Manager, and Recruitment Manager to create a safe, engaging, and enjoyable environment for all young players.
  • Provide effective support in the delivery and ongoing development of the club’s Pre-Academy programme at Motspur Park, contributing to its continued growth and success.
  • Build strong working relationships with the wider academy team, promoting high standards, sharing best practice, and creating clear, supportive pathways for players transitioning between programmes.
  • Attend and contribute to internal and external meetings as required, representing the programme with professionalism and purpose.

  • Good knowledge of coaching standards and best practice.
  • Clear and effective communication skills.
  • Committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity, and inclusion in the workplace.

As a representative of Fulham FC, you will be expected to consistently uphold and embody the club’s core values in everything you do, both on and off the pitch.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Deliver high-quality coaching and player development across both the Lewisham Advanced Centre and Motspur Park, ensuring every session meets the highest professional standards. - Work collaboratively with the Head Coach, Pre-Academy Manager, and Recruitment Manager to create a safe, engaging, and enjoyable environment for all young players. - Provide effective support in the delivery and ongoing development of the club’s Pre-Academy programme at Motspur Park, contributing to its continued growth and success. - Build strong working relationships with the wider academy team, promoting high standards, sharing best practice, and creating clear, supportive pathways for players transitioning between programmes. - Attend and contribute to internal and external meetings as required, representing the programme with professionalism and purpose. - Maintain a strong focus on safeguarding at all times—ensuring all participants are safely welcomed and dismissed, and that a secure, supportive environment is consistently upheld.
Requirements
- FA Level 1 Coaching qualification, with up-to-date FA First Aid and Safeguarding certifications. - IT literate, with proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). - Highly organised, with strong time management and planning skills. - Good knowledge of coaching standards and best practice. - Clear and effective communication skills. - Committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity, and inclusion in the workplace.

job.title: Stadium Tour Guide - Weekend
job.html_description:
We intend on building the Craven Cottage stadium tour to be one of the truly popular London experiences for football fans and visitors to London. Our guides are key to this objective. 
Craven Cottage tour guides are expected to be hard working, well presented, passionate and dedicated to ensuring that our guest’s expectations are met every time. Guides are also expected to be proactive and receptive to performance feedback and to be enthusiastic, proud club ambassadors in every possible aspect of the position.

Responsibilities

PERSON SPECIFICATION AND ATTRIBUTES
 
  • Smart and well presented
  • Guest oriented
  • Positive attitude
  • Friendly, flexible and proactive
  • Strong team player with the ability and willingness to work alone
  • Knowledgeable and passionate regarding Craven Cottage and Fulham Football Club
  • Willing to improve and develop
  • Reliable and punctual
  • High personal standards
  • Values and respects others
  • Takes responsibility
  • Ideally a Fulham fan but this is not essential
  • The ability and willingness to work home match days if required
  • The willingness to wear official club branded clothes as directed by the stadium   tour manager when leading tours or on duty.
  • The ability to regularly work weekends


Skills and Experience
 
  • Excellent communication skills with  the confidence to speak to large groups
  • Customer service skills with the desire to improve
  • The ability to study and learn the history of the club and ground
  • The ability to present the information to the timings required in an interesting, passionate manner and with   historical accuracy
  • The ability and interest in remaining up to date with the latest club news
  • Where necessary, the willingness and ability to work in an office environment, responding to emails, answering enquiries, selling tickets for the tour and tour events.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • To support the delivery of the Craven Cottage stadium tour, across all   operations and in every respect
  • To deliver an engaging stadium tour to a wide variety of guests
  • To handle payments
  • Provide a customer service experience to our guests that meets their expectations
  • To deliver a personable tour, including welcoming and saying goodbye to the   group
  • To deal with a wide variety of customer enquiries
  • To be a proud and enthusiastic club ambassador
  • Taking photo’s where requested for guests where and when permitted
  • To liase with stadium management, stadium tour manager and security on a tour   day and while the tour is in progress where necessary
  • Ensure that the tour route is litter free, clear, safe and adheres to health and   safety policies and procedures
  • To promote the club at every opportunity including ticketing, retail,   hospitality and events
  • Deliver other tours relevant to Fulham Football Club
  • To carry out other related duties that may reasonably be required including   covering for absent staff during holidays and sickness
  • To be responsible for the safety and security of staff, visitors and the ground   throughout the tour and while guests are present in the stadium. This   includes following instructions from the stadium tour manager, security,   stadium management and other departments

Benefits

Full training will be provided to the successful applicant.

This is a casual position and hours will be arranged accordingly.

Shifts will involve weekend, weekdays, bank holidays and potentially match days. Hours might involve evening shifts or early starts when required. The length of the shift may vary according to the needs of the organisation and events.

job.title: Warehouse Operative/Driver (Part-time)
job.plain_text_description:
Oversee the efficient receipt, storage, dispatch and movements of all stock. Be able to ensure productivity targets are achieved and that all warehouse processes are running smoothly and promptly. Delivering of Stock to the store.
