job.title: Host Families
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Casual Job ref: 008802 Published: 4 months ago Expiry date: 30 Sep 2026 20:00
job.html_description:
Could you provide a welcoming home for the next generation of Newcastle United stars?

 

We’re looking for Host Families to support our young players as they move to Newcastle United from outside the North East.

 

Why Become a Host Family?

 

*        Provide a stable, safe, and welcoming home

*        Play a vital role in a player’s growth on and off the pitch

*        Support their academic and personal development

*        Receive competitive remuneration

 

Family is at the heart of Newcastle United. We know our players perform at their best when they feel happy and secure at home.

 

We offer both short-term (1–2 nights) and full-time (7 nights per week) placements for players aged 14–21.

 

If you can offer a nurturing environment and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What we’re looking for:

 

We’re seeking Host Families in Newcastle upon Tyne (postcodes NE7, NE6, NE2, NE3, NE12), located close to our education partner or the Academy. You should be able to provide high-quality accommodation, ideally in a family environment.

 

Requirements:

 

*        Provide an evening meal, breakfast (for school-age players)

*        Access to laundry facilities and Wi-Fi

*        A safe and suitable environment for the player

*        Private bedroom with a double bed

*        Full or part-time placements available year-round to align with the football season

*        Willingness to accommodate trialists and provide holiday cover when needed

 

You’ll be able to:

 

*        Create a welcoming, homely environment for young players

*        Teach essential independent living skills like cooking, cleaning, and self-care

*        Provide meals following nutritional guidance from the Academy

*        Ensure accommodation is close to local amenities with good transport links to the Academy

*        Report any welfare concerns to the Academy’s Safeguarding and Wellbeing team

*        Integrate players into family life as much as they feel comfortable

*        Accommodate regular inspections and visits during the season

*        Build trusted relationships through open communication

*        Adapt to the flexible schedule of young players throughout the football season

*        Promote and demonstrate a strong anti-discriminatory practice

 

It would be great if you have:

 

*        Experience working with young people

*        Understanding of the emotional impact and well-being challenges young athletes face

*        A child-focused approach

*        The capacity to accommodate more than one player

 

We welcome applications from all sections of the community. In particular, we encourage candidates from Black, Asian and other minority ethnic backgrounds to apply, as these groups are currently under-represented in this role. If you're ready to offer a supportive home and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you! 

 

To express an interest and find out more information please email Callum.Thompson@nufc.co.uk detailing the following:

 

1)      Your full name and current address

2)      Current occupation

3)      Whether you are interested in offering a full-time placement or intermittent support for trialists

4)      Your current property situation including availability of a private bedroom / number of rooms available

5)      Why you would like to become a host family in no more than 250 words

job.title: Lead UK Academy Scout
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Permanent Job ref: 010703 Published: 6 days ago Expiry date: 07 Aug 2026 17:00
job.html_description:
Lead UK Academy Scout

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne / Remote

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: Friday 7th August

Be part of something bigger. Identifying tomorrow’s talent through insight, intelligence and expertise.

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As Lead UK Academy Scout, you will operate within the Club’s scouting framework, profile and methodology to lead and drive the Talent Identification process for potential targets within the youth recruitment department.

Working closely with the Head of Academy Recruitment, First Team and Emerging Talent recruiters, and Scout Analysts, you will focus on UK and European academy players, lead and manage the UK Lead Scouts, and support detailed decision-making within a highly competitive area of recruitment.

What you’ll do

*         Lead and organise scouting structures and processes to ensure effective weekly and monthly coverage of potential targets.

*         Manage the North and South UK Lead Scouts to support regular cross-checking and assessment of potential players.

*         Ensure detailed Talent ID information is recorded, stored and shared quickly with key staff.

*         Work with the Recruitment Operations Manager and Academy Technical Scout to produce records of coverage, data and scouting performance.

*         Create high-level reports for key stakeholders on talented young players across the UK and Europe.

*         Use scouting and video platforms to provide insight into UK and European markets.

*         Review player options proposed by scouts, agents and other sources to determine suitable opportunities.

*         Collaborate with Emerging Talent, First Team, Data and Insights teams to align scouting strategies and ensure highlighted players are covered.

*         Maintain up-to-date target lists to support positional analysts and scouts.

*         Build strong working relationships across Academy Recruitment and Emerging Talent to align processes, protocols and information sharing.

*         Support the development of the future Academy Recruitment strategy plan.

*         Undertake any other reasonable duties.

 

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

Stadium Tour Guide

Newcastle upon Tyne

Casual

£13.45 per hour

Closing Date: 10th August 2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and engaging Stadium Tour Guide to deliver exceptional and informative tours of St. James’ Park. You’ll provide visitors with a unique experience, sharing fascinating stories and facts about the Club’s rich history while ensuring the highest standards of customer service and safety.

Your impact

You will deliver engaging tours to diverse audiences, use storytelling to bring the Club’s history to life, provide outstanding customer service, manage and adapt tours for different group sizes and needs, ensure compliance with health and safety procedures. You will also have confidence in public speaking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build rapport with guests. Previous experience in a customer-facing role and flexibility to work weekends are required.

About the team

You will work as part of our Stadium Tours team, acting as a brand ambassador for Newcastle United and ensuring every visitor leaves with an unforgettable experience.

Location

This role is based at St. James’ Park, Newcastle upon Tyne. Flexibility to work weekends is essential.

United As One

job.title: Buying and Merchandising Administrator
job.html_description:
Buying and Merchandising Administrator

Permanent

Newcastle upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 17 August 2026

Be part of something bigger. Be part of the team behind every product and every purchase.

We are the heartbeat of the city.  A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to join our Retail and Licensing team as a Buying and Merchandising Administrator, supporting our Buying and Merchandising function with the accurate, timely and organised administration that helps our retail channels perform at their best.

About the role

As Buying and Merchandising Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting the team with stock intake, sample handling, product information and supplier communication. You will help maintain accurate documentation, support product data processes and work closely with colleagues across Buying, Merchandising and Finance to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

This role will suit someone who brings a strong eye for detail, excellent organisation and a positive, team-focused approach. You will be confident managing multiple priorities, working with data and using systems to support accurate product and stock information.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will:

  • Create and upload SKUs to internal systems, ensuring data is accurate, consistent and well maintained.
  • Maintain and update the product master document to support accurate product information across the team.
  • Liaise with suppliers to support stock updates and ensure booking-in processes are followed.
  • Monitor delivery discrepancies, including over and under deliveries, working with the Buyer and wider team to resolve issues.
  • Track stock due dates, delivery statuses and received quantities to support accurate intake reporting.
  • Support invoice processing and work with Finance and Buying colleagues to investigate and resolve invoice queries.
  • Provide high-quality administrative support to the Buying and Merchandising teams, helping to deliver smooth and efficient daily operations.
  • Manage product samples for eCommerce photography and internal use, including tracking sample movement, deliveries and returns.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who can bring:

  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables and basic formulas.
  • It would also be beneficial if you have previous experience in a retail buying or merchandising administration role, although this is not essential.

The team

You will be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we are looking for someone who is ready to contribute, learn and play their part in helping the club continue to move forward.

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply 

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Strength & Conditioning
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

New York Red Bulls Academy are looking for an intern to join our excellent Medical and Performance department. This internship provides a professional learning environment for aspiring strength and conditioning coaches, performance scientists or other performance related careers.

Note: applicants must have consistent afternoon and/or evening availability on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. Weekend availability is a plus.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Contribute towards the development of best practices in the Academy
  • Design and administer strength training sessions and pre-training activation protocols that will align with the Red Bulls youth development model
  • Development and implementation of strength and conditioning programs to excel individual player performance and reduce risk of injuries
  • Evaluation of player performance through testing and workload monitoring in conjunction with selected key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Live global positioning system (GPS) monitoring of players during training and games
  • Plan and develop late-stage return to play sessions – working in collaboration with medical staff
  • Provide daily and weekly reports to the coaching staff regarding individual player and team physical performance
  • Testing and analyzing player physical performance and creating reports for coaches and players

Qualifications

Basic knowledge and understanding of soccer


Current undergraduate or graduate student studying sports exercise and science, strength and conditioning, CSCS accreditation, or a related field


Demonstrates effective communication, time management, and organizational skills


Lives within 60-miles of Whippany, New Jersey


Possess a driver’s license and/or reliable transportation


Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

  • Ordering, organization, distribution, and tracking of training kit and equipment
  • Scheduling of IDP, training, and games for all Academy teams
  • Travel planning and coordination for all Academy teams

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Scout
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

The Academy Scouting & Video Analysis Intern will gain hands-on experience within a professional youth academy by supporting the player identification and recruitment process through video analysis. Working alongside the Academy Scouting department, the intern will learn how video evaluation, player profiling, and scouting operations contribute to identifying elite youth talent while developing practical skills used throughout professional soccer. 

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Learn the fundamentals of professional academy scouting, talent identification, and player evaluation.  


Develop technical skills in video analysis, including clipping, organizing, and presenting player footage using industry-standard software.  


Understand how scouting reports, video analysis, and recruitment workflows support player identification and decision-making.  


Gain experience organizing scouting databases, maintaining video libraries, and preparing materials for internal scouting discussions.


Improve analytical thinking, written communication, and attention to detail in a professional sporting environment.  


Work collaboratively with Academy staff while gaining insight into the day-to-day operations of a Major League Soccer academy. 

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship.  


Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Sports Analytics, Performance Analysis, Coaching, Data Analytics, Kinesiology, or a related field.  


Passionate about soccer, player development, scouting, and performance analysis.  


Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.  


Comfortable reviewing large amounts of match footage and identifying key player actions.  


Strong written and verbal communication skills.  


 Proficient with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.  


Experience with video analysis software (Hudl Sportscode, Hudl, Spiideo, Wyscout, or similar platforms) is preferred but not required.  


Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a professional environment. 

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - RBII Analysis
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.


RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

Red Bull New York II are looking for an intern to join our high-performance team for the season. A key responsibility of this internship includes providing analysis support to 2nd team staff in order to aid player development and maximize workflow efficiency. This internship will provide a valuable introduction into the world of analytics and the dynamics of a professional football club.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).  

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • A basic understanding of how analysis is performed at a professional level
  • Introductory tools and skills to be able to analyze matches and trainings
  • The ability to fly a drone
  • Firsthand use of industry specific software programs
  • A beginning understanding of providing analysis within a professional football context

Qualifications

Passion for the game of soccer


A willing learner and can take initiative


The ability to learn on the fly and be adaptable in different situations


The ability to work under pressure

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends). 


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

Red Bull New York are looking for a motivated and organized college student to join the Operations department. This 12-week program is an opportunity to join the club and gain comprehensive understanding of operations at RBNY and Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS). The internship is a great opportunity for those interested in pursuing a career in sports. Experience will include working match days and non-match days at SIS, as well as Montclair State University. In addition to soccer events (MLS, MLSNP, NWSL), chosen applicants will likely be exposed to dark day assignments, special events, stadium projects, and potential requested support at the First team training ground.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship only (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Red Bull New York (MLS) Matches @ SIS, NJ/NY Gotham FC (NWSL) Matches @ SIS, RBNY II (MLSNP) Matches @ Montclair State University.


Support in daily operation of SIS, as well as stadium setup, breakdown, staging and conversion for matches.


Coordinate with other Red Bull New York departments to ensure successful event planning and execution.


Liaise with outside parties (visiting teams, referees, league officials, vendors, partners, etc.) to ensure all needs are met.


Other designated assigned duties.

Qualifications

Student pursuing career in Sports Management and/or Event Operations, with 1-2 years of related experience.


An individual with the ability to lift 50+ pounds and perform moderate labor over the course of a full event (8-12 hrs). Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions (heat, cold, rain, etc.).


Experience showing professionalism around pro athletes/teams, while maintaining composure and effectiveness under pressure and changing conditions in a team environment. 


Ability to meet deadlines; accomplish work in order of priority; effectively multitask and deliver consistently at a high level.

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).

job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Control Room Internship is designed to provide experience to college students pursuing a career in live production within a sports organization. Interns focus on creating an exciting fan experience for all Red Bull New York home matches and other events held at Sports Illustrated Stadium. Interns learn about live production, equipment operation, content creation, and other aspects of match presentation. Interns report directly to the Event Production Coordinator and work collaboratively with stakeholders across the organization. During the internship, students are involved in all stages of production of all events at Sports Illustrated Stadium.             

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Assist full-time control room staff with completing checklist items in preparation for each event.  


Work with Daktronics, Sony, DiGiCo, Chyron, Click Effects, and Evertz equipment in a live control room 


Assist in organizing and creating content for stadium video boards and LED ribbon boards 


Actively participate in the planning stage, preparation, and execution of events 


Learn to troubleshoot video, audio, and other signal flow issues 


Understanding of the process of setup, breakdown, and storage of broadcast equipment after various events 

Qualifications

Experience working with Adobe Suite or other similar editing software 


Pursuing a degree in Production, Digital Media, Sports Management, or other associated fields 


Knowledge of pre-production, production, and post-production processes 


Possess a strong work ethic, take a leadership approach, and strong improvisational skills 


Must be eligible to receive college credit 


This internship is ideally suited for someone with a strong interest in behind-the-camera live event production. While a strong interest in soccer and sports is not required, it is most definitely a plus!

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

Purpose of this Internship

The purpose of this position is to learn the behind-the-scenes operations of a sports team by working closely within the Equipment department. This position will experience the crucial function the equipment team plays in daily operations around team training and match preparations. 

This is an unpaid, for credit internship only (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Travel preparations and logistics management for a pro sports team


Day to day operations, supporting the players and coaches with training and match preparation


Compliance protocols surrounding club branding, league minimum standards, and kit requirements


Inventory management utilizing current technology partners


How our equipment team supports special events, community relations initiatives, and partnership ventures

Qualifications

Must be working towards an undergraduate or graduate degree and eligible to receive college credit for this position


Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal


A passion or eagerness to work in the Sports industry


Strong organizational skills and a keen attention to detail


Comfortable and proficient with various technology including Microsoft Office


Must be able to maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality within a team environment


Personable and enthusiastic about participating in a team environment.

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - RDS Operations
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The internship is designed to provide experience working specifically within the Regional Development School (RDS). The RDS Operations Intern is responsible for assisting in the day-to-day summer season operations of the RDS. The role comprises a balance of logistics and operational support for residential and day camps, with some focus on summer showcase league and regional select tournament preparations. The overview of responsibilities provided here is intended as a guideline only and should not be exhaustive.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Red Bull New York elite player identification and development process


Showcase team preparation, and summer league scheduling


Regional Select team tournament preparation and scheduling


Residential and day camp operations and planning


Kit and equipment inventory, delivery, and tracking


Hudl camera equipment operation to record summer showcase and/or Regional Select and/or Academy games/training where possible

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a degree in Sport Management, or a related field of study


A candidate with an interest in gaining experience in sports management operations, and/or elite level youth soccer


A passionate soccer fan with knowledge and interest in Major League Soccer


An organized self-starter with the ability to efficiently multi-task


Proficient in Microsoft Office – Word, PowerPoint, Excel


Preferable driver’s license and means of transportation

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Box Office
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Red Bull New York, Inc. Ticket Operations department is seeking qualified candidates to fill the position of Box Office Intern. Ability to work effectively with others and self-motivation are a few of the key characteristics required.

Note: Consistent availability on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday - as well as game days preferred.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Learn the main functions of SI Tickets ticketing system to complete daily operations at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS). Consists of face-to-face interaction with patrons and Red Members for individual sales, customer service, and all other related ticket issues.


Communication with account representatives for distribution of tickets for the season, which includes printing tickets, and group/individual ticket package mailing.


Learn how to manage the seat inventory for all events. Includes reclassing of seats, delegating holds, and setting tickets for Account Manager, Will Call or regular mail on individuals’ accounts.


Creation and maintenance of promo codes for account representatives using SI Tickets, upon request.


Assisting our sales staff & finance team with support, research, projects, and operation aid during game days.  

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in college; must be able to receive college credit


Knowledge of and/or enthusiasm for soccer, Red Bull New York/MLS, and professional sports a plus.


Attendance at all Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) events is strongly encouraged (events are generally held on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday Evenings. There are some weekday events).

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Communications
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

In this internship, you will learn how the day to day of communications and community relations fields on match days and non-matchdays operates. In this role, you will assist the communications and community relations teams in day to day operations including but not limited to assisting with stats research for our first and second teams, writing press releases, researching outlets to collaborate with, researching organizations in our community that we can work with, and transcribing quotes from all press conferences.

This is an unpaid, 20 hours a week for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Write a professional press release for player transactions, schedule changes, international call ups and award recognitions.


Create Game Notes and Post Game Notes/Recaps.


Conduct stats research.


Moderate a press conference/media availability.


Pitching interview opportunities and community collaborations.


Draft match previews.


Organize and execute player appearances and community events.

Qualifications

Pursuing a degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations or any other related field.


Interested in a career in Communications, Public Relations or Marketing.


Outgoing and open to learning opportunities.


Strong communications skills.


Experience using the Microsoft Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel etc).


Experience using the Adobe Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Lightroom).

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Digital Growth & Content
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

The Digital Growth & Content Intern will support Red Bull New York’s digital marketing efforts across paid media, creative strategy, and campaign performance analysis. This internship is designed to provide hands-on experience in performance marketing, digital content execution, and campaign optimization while contributing to real business objectives across ticketing, brand, and fan growth initiatives.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Performance Marketing Fundamentals:


Gain foundational experience in paid media, including campaign setup, optimization, and reporting across platforms such as Meta and Google Ads. 


Creative Strategy & Execution:


Learn how performance data informs ad creative, messaging, and campaign recommendations, while also gaining hands-on exposure to building creative assets and briefs. 


Marketing Analytics & Reporting:


Develop the ability to analyze campaign performance, identify trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations that improve marketing outcomes. 


Cross-Functional Marketing Operations:


Understand how digital growth work connects with broader business needs, including collaboration with internal creative and marketing teams to support campaign execution and organizational priorities. 

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a college or university program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship  


Strong interest in digital marketing, advertising, social media, and content creation  


Familiarity with major digital platforms such as Meta, Google, Instagram, and/or TikTok  


Comfortable working with spreadsheets, campaign data, and basic reporting  


Strong written communication skills and attention to detail  


Interest in creative development, including copywriting, visual concepts, and digital asset creation  


Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or similar creative tools is a plus  


Self-starter with a willingness to learn, take feedback, and contribute in a fast-paced environment  


Passion for sports, entertainment, or fan engagement marketing is a plus 

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

The IT Internship at RBNY aims to provide a practical complement to a formal education in IT.


The program aims to help interns develop specific technical skills as well as soft skills like communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.


In addition, give interns a taste of different career paths within IT and help them determine what they're most interested in, as well as offer an understanding of how IT functions in a real-world business environment and to expose interns to industry standards and practices. In this case, specifically in the world of professional sports.               

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

Contribute to ongoing IT projects by performing tasks assigned by project managers or team leads


Conduct research on new technologies, vendors, or IT strategies that could benefit the organization.


Create and update documentation for IT systems, procedures, and training materials.


Participate in training sessions and workshops, and shadow experienced IT professionals to learn from their expertise.

Qualifications

Familiarity with computer hardware, software, and networks. Even at a basic level, understanding how systems interconnect and operate is crucial


Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems logically and systematically.


Document solutions, write reports, and maintain clear documentation for technical procedures.


Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members and explain technical issues to non-technical colleagues.


Be able to work well in a team, as IT projects often require collaboration with various stakeholders.


Precision and attention to detail when working with complex systems to avoid errors and identify issue

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: Host Family Provider
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Contract: Temporary engagement

Location: Within three miles (15 minutes), easy access to The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Working Arrangements: Remote

Closing Date For Applications: INSERT

About the Role:

We are recruiting for host families who can provide accommodation for our Academy players to support them living away from home. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to their experience and provide vital support to the players as they develop as young people alongside their football.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people

  • Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills

  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with

  • Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house

  • Provide a nutritious evening meal 

  • Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur.

  • Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season.

  • Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this. 

What are we looking for:

  • Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person

  • Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities 

  • Excellent communication and listening skills

  • Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season

  • Previous experience of working with young people

  • Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice 

As part of the recruitment process the Club would need to conduct a number of home visits to determine suitability and ensure the home meets the requirements for hosting young people within the Academy.

Forest For Everyone

At Nottingham Forest Football Club we are committed to creating an environment where differences are respected, individuality is celebrated, everyone feels valued, supported, and included. Our goal is to ensure every member of our team can be themselves, contribute fully, and reach their potential without barriers.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion and Mental Wellbeing

As an equal opportunities employer, we welcome applications from talented people of all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We continue to develop policies and practices that promote equality, diversity, inclusion and mental wellbeing across our workforce. To help us measure progress and hold ourselves accountable, we ask all applicants to provide accurate diversity information during the recruitment process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer, taking positive steps to attract, recruit, and support disabled people. As part of this commitment, we work hard to ensure our recruitment processes are fair, inclusive, and accessible to everyone. We are committed to offering interviews for disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for a role and provide reasonable adjustments at every stage from the application process through to ongoing support in the workplace.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme. Please indicate this in your application form. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

Health and Safety

At Nottingham Forest Football Club, we are committed to ensuring a safe and healthy working environment for all employees. In accordance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, you are required to take reasonable care for your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your actions or omissions at work. You must also cooperate with the Club's health and safety policies and procedures. Should you identify any health and safety concerns, please report them promptly to your manager or a member of the Health and Safety/Facilities team.

job.title: Safety Supervisor (Casual)
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Casual position offering variable hours on a flexible basis

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Safety & Security

Reporting to: Safety Officer

About the Role:

In addition to all roles outlined in the Steward Job Description, Supervisors should ensure, as far as is reasonably practicable, they have prepared a safe environment to facilitate the safety of all attendees at events held at the Stadium.

To ensure that those stewards under your supervision feel able to perform their roles, it is essential that you remain visible and accessible, routinely offering support, encouragement, and advice. Ensuring the delivery of excellent customer care is essential to your role.

You will be expected to be involved in managing incidents within your area of responsibility, including dealing with breaches of ground regulations, searching of spectators and performing ejections. You will also be required to assist with queue management within the stadium and in the areas outside.

Supervisors will work within the law and the event regulations as set down by the Club in accordance with the Stadium Safety Certificate.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Attend the Stadium at given dates and times as directed by the Stewarding Services Lead

  • Attend pre-event briefings, noting anything specific to your area as well as ensuring all information is understood and what your areas of responsibility are

  • Brief stewards under your supervision, relaying information relevant to the event as well as reminding them of the threat of terrorism and emergency procedures

  • Assign stewards to their positions, ensuring that they are aware of their roles and areas of responsibility

  • Perform pre-match checks to ensure all areas are checked for damage, cleanliness and suspicious items

  • Ensuring that emergency phones in your area of responsibility are in working order

  • Providing support to stewards under your supervision ensuring that they are constantly monitoring the crowd for overcrowding, signs of distress and enforcing Ground Regulations

  • Supervise ejections in accordance with Club policy, providing updates to Match Control and ensuring all relevant paperwork is completed

  • Ensure that all relevant debriefing documentation is completed, recording complaints and incidents

  • Ensure that your area of responsibility is clear of supporters and all stand checks are completed

  • Be fully conversant with any methods/messages or signals used to alert staff that an emergency has arisen

  • To maximise any opportunity to enhance the customer’s match day experience

  • Attend all training sessions as required by the Safety Management Team

What are we looking for:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • To remain calm, efficient and assertive, in particular when dealing with challenging situations

  • Thorough and ready knowledge of safety procedures

  • Effective questioning when in pressure situations

  • Have a polite, courteous and approachable manner

  • Able to manage conflict and demonstrate confidence to challenge inappropriate behaviour

  • Have good numeracy and literacy skills

  • Level 2 in Spectator Safety

  • Be willing to undertake and complete level 3 Certificate in Spectator Safety

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Casual position offering variable hours on a flexible basis

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Education

Closing Date For Applications: 7th August 2026

About the Role:

We are requiring a Mathematics Tutor to join us on an engagement basis to support with the delivery of Mathematics sessions across the Academy.

This role will be responsible for the organisation and delivery of the Mathematics provision within the Hybrid Training Model.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage, facilitate and co-ordinate the delivery of Mathematics for schoolboys on the Hybrid Training Model.

  • Ensure that tracking and assessment of schoolboys’ progress is up to date.

  • Contribute to the writing of schemes of learning for Mathematics.

  • Contribute to the development of effective tracking systems to monitor student progress.

  • Deal with any safeguarding issues that may arise by reporting them to the Head of Education and Welfare.

  • Participate in any training courses for Academy staff and other Club staff as and when required, e.g. FA Safeguarding workshops and Equality seminars.

  • Be the key point of contact and liaise with partner schools of schoolboys over any matters relating to the subject.

  • Postgraduate Certificate in Education (PGCE) or Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) essential

  • Degree level education or equivalent essential in the subject area

job.title: Academy Kit Manager
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Operations

Reporting to: Academy Operations Manager

Closing Date For Applications: 17th July 2026

About the Role:

Manages all aspects of the Academy Players’ kit ensuring that all training, travel and matchday kit is correctly ordered, prepared, printed, distributed and laundered to meet industry standards and Club and Players’ needs. Ensures availability and set up of other equipment such as footballs, bibs and cones.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Take lead responsibility for ensuring that the correct kit is available for all Academy players and staff on a daily basis and that all match kit is prepared and packed in line with Professional Development League and PL2 standards.

  • Ensure that all numbers are correctly ordered and printed on the playing kit for Players and training kits for Players and Staff, liaising with Retail as appropriate.

  • Order, sort and distribute all training, travel and playing kit for Players and Staff so that each individual has the correct kit for the event / fixture / training session.

  • Ensure all kit is returned to the Laundry following every session and that the Laundry is aware of the full Academy weekly training schedule and all fixtures and keep them up to date with changes promptly.

  • Order all training, travel and match kits for Players and Staff for the next season within budget.

  • Ensure all training and playing equipment is ready and available for every session, such as footballs set at the correct pressure, bibs, cones, poles and mannequins.

  • Supply correct equipment at the training field / pitch for warm ups, matches and training sessions for Coaching staff to set up.

  • Liaise with medical staff if any injured players are training on scheduled days off and with coaching staff if any First Team players are involved in B Team fixtures.

  • Order all footballs for the new season and liaise with coaching staff to order any training accessories and equipment needed for the new season.

  • Produce when required monthly, quarterly and yearly reports in line with our Academy strategy to update on progress met and achieved in relation to our kit strategy tactics and KPI’s.

  • You may be asked to undertake additional duties to those above, either on a temporary or permanent basis, which the Club reasonably believes you are capable of carrying out, or for which you will be trained.

  • Relevant professional, ethical and health and safety standards apply.

  • You will be required to work on all home and away match days (squad TBC) which will involve travel and overnight stays which will necessitate a flexible approach and attitude to working hours as this will involve early mornings and late nights.

  • Complete regular real time stock level checks and reports to be made available to Academy Management.

  • A full UK driving licence is essential as you will be required to drive the dedicated Club vehicle.

  • Present a professional image when dealing with both internal and external contacts and partners, acting in a professional manner always.

  • To create successful and professional relationships with players and staff whilst maintaining professional distance from playing staff at all times.

  • To act, at all times, in a manner appropriate to a representative of Nottingham Forest FC

  • All staff are responsible for the wellbeing and safeguarding of children and vulnerable adults on all Club sites. If you have a concern or witness a Safeguarding matter, you must report it to the department’s

  • Designated Safeguarding Officer (DSO) or the Club’s Lead DSO or Senior Safeguarding Manager. If It’s an emergency, you are to call the relevant emergency service such as Police or CAMHS.

What are we looking for:

  • Excellent attention to detail and is very well organised and punctual

  • Able to communicate effectively at all levels and is fully computer literate.

  • Works effectively in a fast-paced environment; remains calm under pressure and is comfortable working to tight deadlines.

  • Prior experience managing kit and equipment for a large sporting institution preferably within football.

  • Full knowledge and experience of all duties involved in a role of this nature.

  • Drive to achieve deadlines, organise and prioritise workload effectively, and continually review ways to improve efficiency and effectiveness

  • Demonstrate skills and attributes in a PA/administration capacity

  • Good verbal and written communication skills and be able to understand and explain matters arising in own area of work.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with people of all ages and backgrounds, able to maintain confidentiality, and act with tact and diplomacy

  • Willingness and flexibility to deal with urgent changes/ demands, whilst maintaining existing workload.

  • Excellent IT skills, including MS Office, intranets, web and Outlook

  • Experience in health and safety duties and responsibilities appropriate to the post.

  • Skill at handling difficult situations and confidential matters according to policy and procedures, referring to others where necessary/appropriate.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

job.title: Academy Education Officer
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Education

Reporting to: Head of Education and Audit Coordinator

Closing Date For Applications: 5th August 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest Academy has a clear aim of building on its excellent history and strong back story with the following vision ‘develop a world-class Academy which develops players of Premier League and International Standard. Recognised as a genuine EPPP Category One Academy differentiated by ‘emotion’ and ‘innovation’, this post will be held by an exceptional leader to continue our journey and further develop the excellent young players, people, strategy and methodology we have in place.

The post holder will support the delivery of the Academy Education programme (Scholarship, Full Time Training Model and Hybrid Training Model). The post holder is required to support the academic progression of Academy players aged between under 9 and under 18 to ensure that learners are achieving the highest possible education outcomes in line with the Academy Strategy and exceed the full requirements of the Category 1 Academy determined by the EPPP.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • To work under the direct instruction of the Head of Education and Audit Co-Ordintaor to support the teaching and learning activities of all Academy players.

  • Support with the delivery of the Academy Education Programme (Scholarship, Full Time Training Model and Hybrid Training Model) from an academic and administrative perspective.

  • Planning and delivery of the BTEC Level 3 provision for the Academy.

  • Assess and mark work in line with the BTEC Assessment plan set out by the Premier League.

  • Support the Intervention programme to support learners who are not making expected progress on the BTEC Level 3 programme

  • Be the key point of contact for all education matters on the Full Time Training Model including delivery and coordination of education intervention sessions.

  • Assist with the Co-ordination and delivery of the schoolboy hybrid education programme including liaison with schools of schoolboys in the 12-16 age groups.

  • Liaise with schools to collect academic data every 12 weeks for players on both Part Time Training and Hybrid Training Models to track and monitor academic progress.

  • Build new relationships / partnerships with schools, educational institutions and organisations that will enhance The Academy.

  • Ensure all administration work is completed accurately and within the time scale set by the Head of Academy and /or Head of Education/Assistant Head of Education.

  • Assist in creating a positive and purposeful learning environment for all learners.

  • Assist in creating an inclusive and safe environment for all learners ensuring all have equal access to opportunities to learn and develop.

  • Deal with any safeguarding issues that may arise by reporting them to via Myconcern and to the Academy Safeguarding Manager.

  • Participate in any CPD courses that are deemed relevant to your role

  • Lead on your CPD to ensure you are enhancing your development within the role.

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with governing bodies and external stakeholders to help shape the external environment, maximise student development opportunities, through appropriate challenge and varied experiences.

  • Ensure full adherence to safer recruitment practices and procedures across all Academy staff recruitment activities.

  • Be accountable for maintaining and embedding Nottingham Forest’s values, standards, and behaviours across all Academy staff and players at all times.

  • Ensure the effective use of the Football IP platform across the Education department, in line with established processes, expectations, and reporting requirements.

  • Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual reports, as required, demonstrating progress and outcomes against the Academy strategy.

What are we looking for:

  • Postgraduate Certificate in Education (PGCE) and Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) essential for this role.

  • Degree level education or equivalent essential

  • Knowledge and experience of delivery of a Core Subject (Desirable)

  • Experience of Safeguarding/Safeguarding role desirable

  • Demonstrable experience of secondary education teaching along with successful completion of probation period.

  • Experience of working in an elite sporting environment

  • Sound organisational skills, able to prioritise and manage own workload.

Forest For Everyone

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred.
